title:サイレントナイト:
A film noir starring veteran actor Shun Sugata, who also provided the original story. Set against the scenic backdrop of Otaru, Hokkaido, the film depicts a man who has spent his life in the underworld fighting to protect a fragile love.

Keizo Kuno once belonged to the world of the yakuza. Now living quietly in a corner of Otaru after abandoning his past, he sends annual Christmas gifts to Ayaka—the daughter of his former underling, Mitsumura—under the guise of being her uncle. Ayaka, a high school student, lives a peaceful life despite suffering from a memory disorder. With graduation approaching, Ayaka visits Kuno—believing him to be her mother’s brother—to ask about the whereabouts of the mother she barely remembers. In reality, Ayaka is Kuno’s biological daughter, a truth he has been unable to reveal for a specific reason. Amidst this, a conflict in the underworld intensifies due to Kuno’s past ties, forcing him to take a stand to protect Ayaka’s future.

Yuka Yano, selected through an audition, plays the role of Ayaka, joined by a supporting cast including Sosuke Takaoka, Shigemitsu Ogi, Hidekazu Akai, Atsushi Arai, Daisuke Nagakura, Kohei Otomo, Tetsu Watanabe, Miyoko Yoshimoto, and Sanae Miyata. Director Kenichi Fujiwara, who previously teamed up with Shun Sugata for *Korou no Mure*, helms the film.
title:サナトリウム: Screening at EU Film Days 2026 (Tokyo: May 16–29 at Theater Image Forum, May 19–24 at the National Film Archive of Japan; Nagoya: June 6–19 at Nagoya Kinema Noi; also held in Hiroshima, Kyoto, and Fukuoka).
title:サムライ（1967）: A film noir masterpiece from French director Jean-Pierre Melville starring Alain Delon, depicting the life of a lone wolf hitman. Clad in a fedora and trench coat, the solitary killer Jef secures an alibi from his call-girl lover, Jane, before heading out on a hit. Jef successfully assassinates his target—a nightclub owner—but as he flees the scene, his face is seen by the club's singer, Valérie. Jef is hauled in during a police sweep, but he is released after Valérie provides false testimony during the lineup. Nevertheless, the suspicious detective puts a tail on him. Co-starring François Périer of "Nights of Cabiria" and Nathalie Delon, who was married to Delon at the time.
title:サヨナラの引力: Summer 2008, Seoul. University students Uno and Jeong-won meet fatefully on a long-distance bus. Uno, who dreams of becoming a game creator, and Jeong-won, who aspires to be an architect. Supporting each other through their urban days filled with dreams and anxieties, they eventually fall in love, deeply and truly. However, faced with the harshness of reality that youth cannot resist, they choose to part ways. Ten years later, in the summer of 2024, they coincidentally reunite on a flight to Seoul. As they look back on their memories, Uno asks Jeong-won a question he has kept buried deep in his heart: 'What if, back then...'
title:サンキュー、チャック: A human mystery film adaptation of Stephen King's 2020 short story "The Life of Chuck," directed by Mike Flanagan of "Doctor Sleep." As massive natural and man-made disasters strike the Earth one after another, the world is nearing its end. With no internet or social media, mysterious advertisements suddenly appear everywhere on street signs, TVs, and radios, reading: "Thanks to Charles Krantz. For 39 great years, thanks, Chuck." When high school teacher Marty rushes out of his house to see his ex-wife Felicia, the deserted city is filled with Chuck's ads. As Marty and Felicia, who have safely reunited, gaze at the stars, feeling the apocalypse approaching, and hold hands, the scene shifts to the perspective of the man in the ads, Chuck, and a story tracing his life unfolds through beautiful imagery. Tom Hiddleston of the "Avengers" series plays the protagonist Chuck, with Chiwetel Ejiofor of "12 Years a Slave," Karen Gillan of the "Guardians of the Galaxy" series, Jacob Tremblay of "Wonder," and Mark Hamill of the "Star Wars" series co-starring. Mandy Moore, choreographer of "La La Land," choreographs the dance scenes. It won the Audience Award, the top prize, at the 2024 Toronto International Film Festival.
title:サンタクロースたちの休暇:
The first theatrical feature from director Keiichi Shibuya—leader of the independent film unit "Sangazu" and winner of the Special Jury Prize at the 3rd Horror Film Awards for his short "Kodoku."

Aiko, having lost both parents, survives by collecting spare change left in city vending machines. Her solitary life is interrupted when a runaway woman named Agatha moves in. They are soon joined by Bob, a man harboring a desperate yearning, and the three begin their winter days together. As they lean on one another, each carrying their own burdens and prayers, a Santa Claus who has finished his Christmas duties watches over them.

Themed as "a winter vacation movie set in Japan," the film captures the preciousness of "time spent cherishing someone"—a feeling so easily forgotten—through quirky characters and a whimsical, offbeat atmosphere. The film received the Tomoyuki Furumaya Prize (Special Jury Prize) at the 29th Ueda Jokamachi Film Festival’s 23rd Independent Film Contest and the Theater Seven/Nanagei Prize at the Juso Shitamachi Film Festival 2025.
title:ザッケン！: A youth story based on the manga 'Zakken!' (published by Shogakukan), which was developed from a real club activity, the 'Weed Research Club,' at Tokyo Metropolitan Hibiya High School, by screenwriter and film director Naho Uemura and the scenario creation team 'Monogatari Lab,' with Uemura herself writing and directing the film adaptation. It delicately and freshly depicts a teenage girl lost and unsure of herself, who discovers her own identity through the weeds growing at her feet, which she had never paid attention to before. Spring of her first year of high school. Sugano Yukari, an ordinary girl who isn't passionate about anything and just goes through the motions, meets her classmate Tokuda Mimi, nicknamed 'Dokudami-chan,' who loves weeds and is fascinated by their vitality. Slightly eccentric but with a straightforward and pure heart, Yukari gradually opens up to her. Dokudami-chan dreams of reviving the 'Zakken,' or 'Weed Research Club,' and Yukari, while hesitant about her enthusiasm, begins activities with her aimed at reviving the club, but... Luna Nakajima, who has starred in films like 'A Town of Old Houses' and 'Tore!' and won the Japan Academy Prize for Newcomer for 'Tokyo Taxi,' plays Sugano Yukari, and Miyu Oshima, known for the NHK morning drama 'Omusubi' and the drama 'Bokutachi nchi,' plays Tokuda Mimi, taking on the lead roles.
title:ザ・コラール 希望を紡ぐ歌:
Starring Ralph Fiennes (*Conclave*), this moving human drama follows a choir on the brink of collapse during wartime as they find new hope through an unprecedented endeavor. 

Set in Northern Yorkshire during World War I, a choir decimated by conscription attempts to rebuild by welcoming local youth and townspeople. Dr. Henry Guthrie, a physician who had been practicing in enemy Germany, is appointed as their conductor. Burdened by prejudice and suspicion, he confronts a ragtag ensemble of veterans, prostitutes, devout volunteers, and boys awaiting the draft, working to restore lost connections and hope. Together, they embark on a daring, world-first challenge. However, as new conscription notices arrive, their hard-won peace is once again threatened by the shadows of war. 

Ralph Fiennes portrays Dr. Henry Guthrie, embodying the complex inner life of a strict yet eccentric man. He is joined by a talented British supporting cast including Roger Allam and Mark Addy. Directed by Nicholas Hytner (*The Madness of King George*).
title:ザ・スーパーマリオギャラクシー・ムービー: The second film in the series of "The Super Mario Bros. Movie", which animated the world of Nintendo's "Super Mario" game series and became a massive hit in 2023, grossing over $13 billion worldwide. Twin plumbers Mario and Luigi, while helping Princess Peach in the Mushroom Kingdom, take care of the captured King Koopa and solve everyone's problems. One day, they meet a new partner, Yoshi. Then, triggered by Princess Peach's birthday party, they embark on a new adventure across space to thwart the evil ambitions of Koopa's son, Bowser Jr. In addition to familiar faces from the first film like Mario, Luigi, Princess Peach, Koopa, and Toad, new characters from the original game series appear, including Yoshi, Rosalina, and Bowser Jr. Produced jointly by Chris Meledandri of Illumination (known for the "Minions" and "Sing" series) and Nintendo's Shigeru Miyamoto. Directors Aaron Horvath and Michael Jelenic, and screenwriter Matthew Fogel return, along with the original voice cast including Chris Pratt, Anya Taylor-Joy, Charlie Day, and Jack Black, as well as the Japanese dub cast including Mamoru Miyano, Ayasa Shida, Yu Hatakeyama, Kenta Miyake, and Tomokazu Seki.
title:ザ・セル: The Campbell Institute on the outskirts of Chicago. Young psychologist Catherine is researching technology to enter the human subconscious and dreams. She receives a request to look inside the mind of a serial killer who derives sexual pleasure from watching a woman drown while trapped in a glass cell.
title:ザ・フー アメイジング・ジャーニー:
Produced in 2007, this music documentary chronicles over 40 years of the legendary British rock band The Who. After debuting in 1965, The Who shot to stardom as the definitive icons of the Mod movement, and in 1969, they pioneered the "rock opera" genre with their landmark double concept album *Tommy*. Yet, behind the scenes, the band grappled with internal strife, creative pressure, and substance abuse, eventually facing the threat of dissolution following the death of genius drummer Keith Moon in 1978.

Directed by Murray Lerner (*Message to Love: The Isle of Wight Festival 1970*), the film examines the band from multiple perspectives, looking back on their tumultuous career through testimonies from members, family, and associates. It features rare archival material, including the earliest known live footage from just before their debut and previously unreleased performances from the classic *Live at Leeds*. Renowned musicians such as Sting, Eddie Vedder (Pearl Jam), Noel Gallagher (Oasis), The Edge (U2), and Steve Jones (Sex Pistols) also appear to speak passionately about the enduring impact of The Who.
title:ザ・レイジ: A revenge action film starring Thai action star Tony Jaa, known for 'Ong-Bak' and 'Tom-Yum-Goong'. It depicts a man who lost his family confronting a massive conspiracy, packed with powerful Muay Thai-based hand-to-hand combat and high-speed, hard-hitting action. After his wife and daughter are killed by a mysterious organization, Bai An heads to the Republic of Parivina to uncover the truth and exact revenge. As he investigates on his own, he discovers a giant corporation secretly controlling the drug trade, but behind it swirls a vast conspiracy involving the military and police. The situation becomes intricately tangled with a mad drug lord, corrupt military police, and unexpected trials involving the only daughter of the corporation's owner. Bai An is tossed about but continues to battle the enemies closing in on him. Directed by Cheung Sui-yee. Co-stars include Xing Yu from 'Master Z: Ip Man Legacy', Philip Keung from 'Goldfinger', and Jason Han from 'Overheat: The Final Sanction'.
title:シケモクとクズと花火と:
Set in Hiroshima Prefecture, this mysterious youth drama depicts the encounter and journey of self-discovery between three individuals of different ages, backgrounds, and values. Sueko Sugiyama, a part-timer at the Hiroshima izakaya "Mamesuke," leads a lackluster life with no dreams or romantic prospects, venting her daily frustrations by bitterly critiquing those around her and society at large. Her world is disrupted by the arrival of a new part-timer, Sakuto Yamane. A university student and handsome influencer with exceptional social skills, Sakuto secretly feels a sense of emptiness behind his bravado and superficial relationships. With polar opposite personalities and worldviews, Sueko and Sakuto clash from the moment they meet. However, their lives take a bizarre turn when they accidentally witness a group of elderly people in wheelchairs lynching a young man. As they flee in confusion, a mysterious girl named Ako appears before them.

The film stars Yumi Endo (*For Family*) as Sueko, On Nakano (*BLUE FIGHT*) as Sakuto, and Miu Mori (*Teacher Maria’s Revenge Counseling*) as Ako, with veteran actress Chizuru Azuma co-starring as the izakaya’s proprietress. Directed by Kentaro Yamagishi—known for the short film *Tokyo Stateless Girl*, which was later adapted into a feature by Mamoru Oshii—the screenplay is penned by Sakiko Yashige (*30,000,000*).
title:シネマ歌舞伎 京鹿子娘二人道成寺: The third installment in the "Cinema Kabuki" series, which brings live Kabuki stage performances to the big screen. This film is a digital cinema adaptation of the legendary February 2006 performance of "Kyokanoko Musume Ninin Dojoji" (The Maiden at Dojoji Temple) at the Kabuki-za, starring Bando Tamasaburo and Onoe Kikunosuke. At Dojoji Temple in Kii Province, a dedication ceremony for a new temple bell is being held. The temple’s original bell was destroyed by Kiyohime, who, consumed by her intense passion for her lover Anchin, transformed into a giant serpent and incinerated the bell that had hidden him. A beautiful shirabyoshi dancer named Hanako appears and is granted permission to join the service on the condition that she performs a dance. However, her true identity is the vengeful spirit of Kiyohime.
title:シネマ歌舞伎 女殺油地獄（2011）: The 13th installment of the "Cinema Kabuki" series, which presents digital screenings of live Kabuki stage performances. The film depicts the pathos and madness of Yohei, the son of the Kawachiya oil merchant in Tenma, Osaka, who leads a dissolute life due to a complex family environment. It portrays his feelings for Okichi, the wife of fellow merchant Teshimaya Shichizaemon, as well as the deep affection of his stepfather Tokubei and biological mother Osawa. Based on a joruri play by Chikamatsu Monzaemon, this production was staged in June 2009 as part of the farewell performances for the fourth-generation Kabuki-za.
title:シネマ歌舞伎 曽根崎心中:
Chikamatsu Monzaemon’s masterpiece "The Love Suicides at Sonezaki," a tragic tale based on a real-life incident, has long been a staple of both puppet theater and Kabuki. This iconic play, which also featured in a pivotal scene of the blockbuster film "National Treasure," is now brought to the big screen as part of the "Cinema Kabuki" series—digital screenings of live Kabuki performances. This production captures the April 2009 performance at the Kabukiza Theatre, starring Living National Treasure Sakata Tojuro IV, who portrayed the courtesan Ohatsu more than 1,400 times in his lifetime, alongside his eldest son Nakamura Ganjiro (who also served as the Kabuki consultant for the film "National Treasure") as her lover Tokube.

The courtesan Ohatsu and the merchant Tokube are deeply in love. One day, Tokube is betrayed by a friend and swindled out of the money he was meant to return to his uncle. As Tokube falls into despair over his tarnished honor, Ohatsu’s faith in him never wavers. While Tokube hides beneath the floorboards, Ohatsu asks him if he is prepared to prove his innocence with his very life. Tokube responds with a firm resolve to die. To clear their names and be united in the afterlife, the two lovers slip away under the cover of night toward the woods of Sonezaki.
title:シネマ歌舞伎 歌舞伎NEXT 朧の森に棲む鬼 幸四郎版:
"Kabuki NEXT: Oboro no Mori ni Sumu Oni" (Demons in the Oboro Forest), which was performed at the Shinbashi Enbujo in November and December 2024 and at the Hakataza in February 2025, comes to the big screen as part of the "Cinema Kabuki" series, allowing audiences to enjoy the spectacle of the Kabuki stage in movie theaters. Based on Shakespeare’s *Richard III*, the production is a Kabuki reimagining of Gekidan Shinkansen’s stage play of the same name, depicting a man at the mercy of his own lies and unbridled ambition. The stage production featured a double-cast for the protagonist Rai: Matsumoto Koshiro, who starred in the original Shinkansen version under his former name Ichikawa Somegoro, and Onoe Matsuya, who led the Shinkansen production *Metal Macbeth*. Cinema Kabuki will release both versions.

Driven by greed and a silver tongue, Rai swindles women and money until he enters the Oboro Forest—a place where those who set foot are said to turn into monsters—and strikes a forbidden pact with a demon. In exchange for his own lifeblood, he is promised the throne of the kingdom. As he leaves a trail of sacrifice in his wake, Rai steadily ascends toward the crown, but his rise to power also signals his ultimate destruction.

This "Koshiro Version" features Matsumoto Koshiro in the lead role of Rai. Supporting him is a distinguished cast including Bando Yajuro, Nakamura Tokizo, Bando Shingo, Onoe Ukon, Ichikawa Somegoro, and Onoe Matsuya. As with the original Shinkansen production, the script is by Kazuki Nakashima and the direction is by Hidenori Inoue.
title:シネマ歌舞伎 歌舞伎NEXT 朧の森に棲む鬼 松也版:
"Kabuki NEXT: Oboro no Mori ni Sumu Oni" (Demons in the Oboro Forest), which was performed at the Shinbashi Enbujo in November and December 2024 and at the Hakata-za in February 2025, is now coming to the big screen as part of the "Cinema Kabuki" series. Based on Shakespeare’s *Richard III*, the production is a kabuki reimagining of the Gekidan Shinkansen play *Oboro no Mori ni Sumu Oni*, which depicts a man at the mercy of his own lies and desires. The stage production featured a double-cast lead, with the protagonist Rai played by Matsuya Onoe (who starred in Shinkansen’s *Metal Macbeth*) and Koshiro Matsumoto (who starred in the original Shinkansen version under his former name, Somegoro Ichikawa). Cinema Kabuki will release both versions.

Driven by insatiable greed, Rai swindles women and money with his silver tongue. In the forbidden Oboro Forest—a place where those who enter are said to become monsters—he strikes a forbidden pact with the forest’s demons: in exchange for his own lifeblood, they will grant him the throne. While Rai steadily ascends toward the crown through a trail of sacrifice, his rise also signals his inevitable destruction.

This "Matsuya Version" features Matsuya Onoe in the lead role of Rai, supported by a cast including Bando Yajuro, Nakamura Tokizo, Bando Shingo, Onoe Ukon, Ichikawa Somegoro, and Matsumoto Koshiro. As with the original Shinkansen production, the script was written by Kazuki Nakashima and directed by Hidenori Inoue.
title:シネマ歌舞伎 鰯賣戀曳網: The 37th installment of the "Cinema Kabuki" series, which brings digital screenings of Kabuki stage performances to movie theaters. This film captures the January 2009 stage production at the Kabuki-za, performed as part of the "Kabuki-za Farewell Performances" with a cast led by Nakamura Kanzaburo and Bando Tamasaburo. The play is the second Kabuki work written by Yukio Mishima, following "The Hell Screen." Sarugenji, a sardine seller, falls in love at first sight with the high-ranking courtesan Hotarubi after spotting her at Gojo Bridge. Smitten, he loses the vigor in his signature sales cry. His father, Ebina Naamidabutsu, devises a plan to disguise Sarugenji as a feudal lord and the horse trader Rokurozaemon as his chief retainer so they can go to meet Hotarubi. With Kanzaburo as Sarugenji and Tamasaburo as Hotarubi, a stage filled with laughter unfolds. In addition to the main feature, the screening includes a special interview with Tamasaburo.
title:シネマ歌舞伎『曽根崎心中』: Ohatsu, a courtesan, and Tokube'e, a merchant, are deeply in love. However, Tokube'e is betrayed by a friend and swindled out of the money he was meant to return to his uncle. Desperate and with his honor tarnished, Tokube'e finds solace in Ohatsu, who remains steadfast in her belief in him. When Ohatsu asks Tokube'e—who is hiding beneath the floorboards—if he is prepared to prove his innocence with his life, he signals his resolve to die. To be united in the afterlife, the two slip away under the cover of night toward the woods of Sonezaki.
title:シネマ歌舞伎『歌舞伎NEXT 朧の森に棲む鬼』松也版: An era of endless war. Deep within the "Oboro Forest" of a certain island nation, a lone man scavenges through mountains of corpses like a stray dog. His name is Rai. As he plunders valuables from the dead in his hunt for fallen warriors, the "Oboro Demon" appears, awakening the dark desires buried deep within him.
title:シネマ歌舞伎『歌舞伎ＮＥＸＴ 朧の森に棲む鬼』幸四郎版: An era of endless war. Deep within the "Forest of Oboro" on a certain island nation, a lone man scours through mountains of corpses like a stray dog. His name is Rai. While scavenging valuables from the bodies of fallen warriors, a "Monster of Oboro" appears before him, awakening the desires buried deep within his soul.
title:シムシャー: Screening at EU Film Days 2026 (Tokyo: May 16–29, 2026 at Theater Image Forum, May 19–24 at the National Film Archive of Japan; Nagoya: June 6–19 at Nagoya Kinema Noi; also to be held in Hiroshima, Kyoto, and Fukuoka).
title:シャオ・メイ ローマ大決戦: Italian visionary director Gabriele Mainetti, who gained international acclaim for *They Call Me Jeeg*, delivers an Italian kung fu action film depicting a Chinese woman’s quest for revenge against a criminal organization in the Roman underworld. Xiao Mei, a young Chinese woman who travels to Rome to search for her missing sister, ventures into a dangerous immigrant district where prostitution and human trafficking are rampant. After meeting Marcello, a local diner owner, Mei enlists his help to take on a ruthless trafficking ring headquartered in a high-end Chinese restaurant called "The Forbidden City." Liu Yaxi—who served as the lead stunt double in Disney’s live-action *Mulan* and performed stunts in numerous action films such as *Detective Dee: The Four Heavenly Kings* and *Vanguard*—makes her feature film starring debut, portraying the protagonist Xiao Mei with extraordinary physical prowess. The film co-stars Marco Giallini (*Perfect Strangers*, *God Willing*) and features stunt supervision by Yang Liang (*Deadpool & Wolverine*). It won Best Feature Film in the Orbita section at the 2025 Sitges Film Festival and Best Director at the Italian Golden Globes.
title:ショパン、ショパン！: Screening at the "Polish Film Festival 2025" (November 14–20, 2025 / YEBISU GARDEN CINEMA). Screening at "EU Film Days 2026" (Tokyo: May 16–29, 2026 at Theater Image Forum, May 19–24 at National Film Archive of Japan; Nagoya: June 6–19 at Nagoya Cinema Neu; also held in Hiroshima, Kyoto, and Fukuoka).
title:ショージとタカオ: Shoji Sakurai and Takao Sugiyama were convicted of a 1967 robbery-murder in Fukawa, Ibaraki Prefecture (the Fukawa Incident) and released on parole after 29 years in prison. Director Yoko Ide, who honed her documentary filmmaking skills under Sumiko Haneda, stays close to these two victims of a miscarriage of justice, thoughtfully portraying how they rediscover the joys of life.
title:ショート・パルス 5つの鼓動: This anthology brings together five short films by world-renowned directors at the forefront of contemporary cinema. The collection features: *The Realist* (2025 / Japan-China / 11 min), directed by Neo Sora (*Happyend*) and based on illustrator Momoe Narazaki’s short story "I Will Go Ahead," which won the Pardino d'oro for Best International Short
title:シラート: This road movie, blending a fantastical story with cool dance music, follows a father and son's journey through a desert rave party in search of a missing daughter, sparking buzz across Spain and Europe. Luis drives with his son Esteban from the Moroccan mountains deep into the desert to find his daughter, who disappeared after attending a desert rave. They reach an outdoor rave site where reality and hallucination blur, but she is not there. The father and son chase a group of ravers, heading to the next rave site where they believe she went. Sergi López ("Pan's Labyrinth") plays father Luis. Directed and written by Oliver Laxe ("Fire Will Come"), the film is produced by renowned Spanish master Pedro Almodóvar. The title "Siraat" means "path" in Arabic and, in a religious sense, symbolizes the narrow bridge over heaven and hell on Judgment Day. Screened in the Competition section of the 78th Cannes Film Festival in 2025, it won four awards including the Jury Prize. It was nominated for the Academy Awards for Best International Feature Film and Best Sound at the 98th Academy Awards.
title:シルビアのいる街で【リバイバル上映】: This film follows a young aspiring painter wandering through places of memory, searching for traces of Sylvia, a woman he loved six years ago. It constructs an obsessive love story reminiscent of Alfred Hitchcock's 'Vertigo' (1958) with meticulously calculated sound and imagery, resulting in a groundbreaking work unlike anything seen before. The film was shot entirely on location in Strasbourg, France, an ancient city where medieval streetscapes and cutting-edge railways coexist without dissonance, creating a stateless atmosphere. The masterful sound design, which orchestrates the city's noises—the murmur of people, the passing of trams—like a symphony, and the beautiful, luminous chain of images captured through glass reflections and tram windows, transport the viewer into an unknown, otherworldly space.
title:シング・ストリート 未来へのうた: A semi-autobiographical work by director John Carney of "Begin Again" and "Once," this youth drama depicts the love and friendship of a boy who forms a band to impress a girl he likes, set to 1980s British sounds. In 1985 Dublin, Ireland, struggling through a severe recession, 14-year-old Conor is forced to transfer to a rough public school after his father loses his job. At home, his parents constantly fight, pushing the family to the brink of collapse. Conor's only solace in his miserable days is watching music videos from neighboring London on TV with his music-obsessed older brother. One day, captivated by the mature charm of a girl named Raphina he sees on the street, Conor invites her to appear in a music video for his band. Hurriedly forming a band, Conor begins intense training to create a video that will amaze the London music scene...

A semi-autobiographical work by director John Carney of "Begin Again" and "Once," this youth drama depicts the love and friendship of a boy who forms a band to impress a girl he likes, set to 1980s British sounds. In 1985 Dublin, Ireland, struggling through a severe recession, 14-year-old Conor is forced to transfer to a rough public school after his father loses his job. At home, his parents constantly fight, pushing the family to the brink of collapse. Conor's only solace in his miserable days is watching music videos from neighboring London on TV with his music-obsessed older brother. One day, captivated by the mature charm of a girl named Raphina he sees on the street, Conor invites her to appear in a music video for his band. Hurriedly forming a band, Conor begins intense training to create a video that will amaze the London music scene...
title:シンシン アンド ザ マウス: A human drama based on a story from Banana Yoshimoto's short story collection 'Mitten and Fubin', co-produced by Japan and Taiwan. It quietly depicts a woman carrying loss who, through encounters in a foreign land, gradually finds renewal. Chizumi is a woman living each day with deep grief after losing her mother. As time passes without filling the void in her heart, she is invited by a friend to visit Taiwan. There, she meets Shin-shin, a young man with a Taiwanese mother and a Japanese father. The unfamiliar cityscapes and the accumulation of casual conversations slowly begin to move her frozen heart, and Chizumi, while still carrying her lingering sense of loss, discovers small warmth. Yukino Kishii ('Small, Slow but Steady', 'Just the Two of Us') plays the protagonist Chizumi, and popular young Taiwanese actor Tseng Jing-hua (known for 'The Soul of the Prisoner', 'Your Name Engraved Herein') plays Shin-shin, the young man she meets in Taiwan. The cast also includes Tokio Fujiwara, Seina Nakata, Tokio Emoto, Kayo Ise, Kisuke Iida, and Kimiko Yo. Directed and scripted by Yukinori Makabe ('I Am a Monk.', 'Scoop!').

title:シンプル・アクシデント 偶然: A suspense thriller by Iranian master Jafar Panahi, winner of the Palme d'Or at the 78th Cannes Film Festival in 2025. It thrillingly and humorously depicts people wrongfully imprisoned seeking revenge. Vahid, once unjustly imprisoned, accidentally encounters a man he believes was his torturer guard. He forcibly restrains the man and digs a hole in the wilderness to bury him, but the man's ID card shows a different name. The man claims it's a case of mistaken identity. Blindfolded during imprisonment, Vahid never saw his torturer's face. Unsure if this is the right man, Vahid pauses revenge and visits a friend who was also tortured by the same guard. Panahi, banned from filmmaking by the Iranian government for opposition activities, drew inspiration from his own two imprisonments and the real voices of cellmates. Having won the Golden Lion at Venice for 'The Circle' and 'No Bears', and the Golden Bear at Berlin for 'Taxi', Panahi achieved the feat of winning top prizes at all three major festivals with this film. A French co-production, it was France's entry for Best International Feature Film at the 98th Academy Awards and received a nomination.

title:シーシュポスたちのまなざし: A youth suspense film depicting the struggles and growth of a university student working on a documentary about an incident that occurred in a certain local city. University student Mayu Kuroda is tasked with creating a documentary for a class project based on her own high school experience. Back then, rumors spread that a male teacher, Nitta, had engaged in inappropriate sexual acts with her senior in the broadcasting club, Nojima, whom she admired. Articles in weekly magazines and social media posts drastically changed Nojima's life. Feeling this situation was unjust, Mayu intended to create a work that would serve as a warning about the information society by reflecting on that time. However, as she proceeds with research and filming alongside her university classmates, she is confronted with the reality that the local community is not welcoming the reopening of the case. Furthermore, facts she didn't know at the time and the various intentions of those involved and related parties come to light. Director Hiroki Inoue, highly acclaimed domestically and internationally for the short film 'Aza' and the VR live-action film 'Nagisa ni te', depicts social issues such as bullying, reputational damage via social media, and the insularity of local communities through an original script. Luna Toyota, in her first lead film role, naturally and delicately portrays the protagonist Mayu. Co-stars include Koshu Hirano from the special effects drama 'Ultraman Z', Kohei Yamashita from 'Toritsukushima', Yu Takaoka from the short film 'Tsunagaru', and Yuri Some no from 'Keep Your Hands Off Eizouken!'.
title:ジェイムズ・ブッカー 愛すべきピアノ・ジャンキー: Real name: James Carroll Booker III. The solitary genius who taught organ to Dr. John, prompting the latter to call him "the best black, gay, one-eyed junkie piano genius New Orleans ever produced." A virtuoso whose technique effortlessly bridged classical, jazz, R&B, and rock, he was as much a gifted vocalist as he was a master of the keys. Yet, he was also a man of many burdens—a minority figure struggling with drug and alcohol addiction, his sexuality, and mental illness. With a litany of eccentric rumors and a criminal record to his name, he was an indisputable wreck of a human being. But the moment he sat at the piano, his performance radiated a divine brilliance that transcended all boundaries. His playful personality showed not a trace of the pathos usually found in self-destructive souls. Turning his handicap into a signature style, his look—always sporting a sharp eyepatch—is just one of his many lovable charms.
title:ジェイムズ・ブッカー／愛すべきピアノ・ジャンキー:
If the music is great, that alone is enough. This is the untold "human" non-fiction story of a brilliant, drug-addicted pianist. While New Orleans has produced countless legendary artists, the name James Booker remains relatively unknown to many. Born James Carroll Booker III, he was the solitary genius who taught the organ to Dr. John—the man who famously described him as "the best black, gay, one-eyed junkie piano genius New Orleans ever produced."

Despite being a virtuoso who effortlessly bridged classical, jazz, R&B, and rock, and a gifted vocalist to boot, Booker was a man plagued by demons: drug and alcohol addiction, mental illness, and the struggles of his identity. With endless rumors of eccentric behavior and a history of institutionalization, he was, by all accounts, an undeniable mess of a human being. Yet, the moment he sat at the piano, his playing radiated a divine brilliance that transcended genre with ease. His mischievous personality showed none of the tragic gloom typically associated with self-destructive souls. Turning his physical handicap into a trademark, his look—always sporting a stylish eyepatch—became one of his most endearing charms.

This eccentric musical "human" non-fiction uncovers the life of this obscure, singular musician who dedicated his short 43 years to his hometown of New Orleans, featuring a wealth of emotional performance footage. He may not have had a flashy, chart-topping career, but this film makes you believe from the bottom of your heart: "If the music is great, that alone is enough."
title:ジェニー・ペンはご機嫌ななめ: A psychological thriller set in a care home that should be a place of peace, depicting elderly residents driven into a nightmare with no escape by a cruel resident who dominates them. Stefan Mortensen, a principled and proud judge who has worked for years upholding the law, is forced into a wheelchair by illness and enters a suburban care home. There, he encounters the evil resident Dave Creeley, who uses a finger puppet named 'Jenny Pen' for doll therapy to dominate the elderly through insidious bullying. Stefan, opposing him, becomes a target, and Dave's unreasonable, humiliating harassment escalates. Having fought for justice all his life, Stefan throws himself into one final, brutal battle. John Lithgow ('Conclave') plays the dominating Dave, and Geoffrey Rush ('The King's Speech') plays the former judge Stefan who confronts him. Both won Best Actor awards together at the 57th Sitges Film Festival in 2024. Paul Lewis, the puppet creator behind 'M3GAN', designed Jenny Pen.
title:ジャパン・ロボット: A featured film of "Indian Movie Week 2020" (September 11 – October 9, 2020, at Kineka Omori; from September 25, 2020, at Shinjuku Piccadilly).
title:ジャンヌ・ディエルマン ブリュッセル1080、コメルス河畔通り23番: A masterpiece drama by Belgian female director Chantal Akerman, who left many works earnestly examining women's lives in society and daily life, carefully capturing a housewife's frustrations and details while tracing how cracks emerge in ordinary routine. Jeanne lives alone with her adolescent son in a Brussels apartment. Boiling water, peeling potatoes, going shopping—she leads an "ordinary" life, but... Starring Delphine Seyrig, known for "Last Year at Marienbad" and "The Discreet Charm of the Bourgeoisie." Screened at the "Chantal Akerman Film Festival" (April 29 - May 12, 2022, Human Trust Cinema Shibuya).

title:ジュンについて:
This documentary follows Junichiro Shimada, the man behind Natsuhasha, a one-person publishing house based in Kichijoji, Tokyo. Founded in 2009 with the mission to create "books to be read over and over again," Natsuhasha publishes about three literary titles a year, ranging from reprints of forgotten Showa-era masterpieces to essays by bookstore owners. From editing and accounting to packing and shipping, Shimada handles every aspect of the business alone. Despite starting with no prior experience in publishing, he has sustained this work for 15 years.

Shimada spent a difficult youth struggling to find his place; he aspired to be a writer until age 27, but after facing setbacks and failing to adapt to conventional employment, he felt adrift. His life finally began to move forward following the death of his cousin in his hometown of Kochi. Finding solace in a single poem during his grief, he decided to publish it himself as a gift for his cousin’s parents. That book, *After the Farewell*, went on to become Natsuhasha’s signature publication. Having once been saved by books himself, Shimada now seeks to give back to the world of books, bookstores, and the communities that surround them.

Filmed over 580 days, the documentary captures Shimada’s daily life intertwined with books. Director Ryutaro Tano (*Children’s Summer: Chernobyl and Fukushima*) personally handled everything from production to distribution, with actor Shohei Uno providing the narration.
title:ジョン・クランコ: A film about the life of genius choreographer John Cranko, who elevated the Stuttgart Ballet from a small regional company in Germany to world-class status, made with the full cooperation of the ballet company. It depicts the untold story behind the creation of his masterpiece "Onegin" and his true face, cut short by an untimely death at the age of 45, all colored by spectacular dance performances by current star dancers. John Cranko, an up-and-coming choreographer active in England, is prosecuted for homosexual acts after a police sting operation. Forced to leave London in 1960, he becomes a guest artist with the Stuttgart Ballet through connections. Finding a place in the company that accepts him without prejudice, he becomes artistic director the following year in 1961, creating works and a company that express beauty and passion with free-thinking ideas. In 1969, the ballet company is invited to the Metropolitan Opera House in New York and rises to the top of the world overnight. Sam Riley, known for "Maleficent" and "Control," stars, passionately portraying Cranko, a man overflowing with passion and innovative talent but who sometimes hurts others due to being too pure in his pursuit of art. Directed and written by Joachim A. Lang, known for "The Man Who Produced Hitler" and who has covered the Stuttgart Ballet for many years.

title:ジーンシアタースタジアム: Geneheart Co., Ltd. operates GeneTheater, a Japanese subscription service specializing in short films, and the mini-theater and indie film information site Nihon Eiga Online, alongside its theatrical distribution business. Launched in October 2025, GeneTheater Stadium is a program that screens three independent short films together for a limited one-week engagement. Under the banner "Movies aren't just for watching. It's time to nurture them!", the project implements a new form of film screening centered on three keywords: audience participation, discovering your "oshi" (favorites), and short films.
title:スカーフェイス: A violent action film starring Al Pacino from 'The Godfather' series, depicting the rise and fall of a man climbing Miami's criminal underworld in the 1980s, with extreme violence. Directed by Brian De Palma, written by Oliver Stone, it is a modern remake of Howard Hawks' classic gangster film 'Scarface'. In 1980, many criminals flood into America among Cuban refugees. Tony Montana, an anti-Castro exile arriving in Miami, takes on a hit at a refugee camp for Frank, a Miami drug lord. Tony gains trust through drug deals and murders for Frank, while also falling for Frank's mistress Elvira. As Tony rises in the underworld, his arrogance and insatiable greed drive him toward destruction. Al Pacino embodies Tony's madness and desire with intense performance. Steven Bauer plays Tony's right-hand man Manny, Robert Loggia plays drug lord Frank, and Michelle Pfeiffer plays Frank's mistress Elvira. With domestic screening rights ending at the end of June 2026, a 4K revival screening is held.
title:スター・ウォーズ マンダロリアン・アンド・グローグー: The first theatrical feature film in about seven years from the globally popular sci-fi saga "Star Wars". It depicts on a grand scale the story of the lone bounty hunter Mandalorian and the young Force-sensitive being Grogu, as portrayed in the drama series "The Mandalorian". Set in the galaxy after "Star Wars: Return of the Jedi", the era is chaotic, with the New Republic's rule incomplete and outlaws and Imperial remnants running rampant. Amidst this, the orphan Grogu, who possesses immense Force power, is pursued by those who covet his strength. The bounty hunter Din Jarin, aka the Mandalorian, decides to protect him, and as they travel through a dangerous galaxy, they gradually develop a father-son bond. The film shows a grown Grogu using the Force powers he honed under Luke Skywalker's training, and features intense, fast-paced battles against Imperial remnants, delivering the large-scale action unique to the "Star Wars" series. A new character, Colonel Ward, is played by the renowned actress Sigourney Weaver. Dave Filoni, Lucasfilm's Chief Creative Officer, serves as executive producer, and Jon Favreau directs, bringing together the creators behind "The Mandalorian" series.

title:スティング: A blockbuster hit from director George Roy Hill, who reunited with stars Paul Newman and Robert Redford after 'Butch Cassidy and the Sundance Kid.' Chicago in the 1930s. Young con man Hooker, whose partner was killed by a powerful gangster, teams up with gambler Gondorff to pull off the ultimate scheme for revenge. A brilliant crime drama with a twist-filled plot and crisp pacing. Won 7 Academy Awards in 1973, including Best Picture, the most of any film that year.
title:ストップ・メイキング・センス: A live documentary of the rock band Talking Heads. Capturing their 1983 stage performance at the Pantages Theatre with various camera angles, it conveys the raw energy and excitement directly.

title:ストム・ソゴー作品集:
"Films must be as filthy and insane as possible, so that everyone flees the theater and begins to desire something better from life... My films are visual candy for the psyche; they taste sweet at first, but then they trigger a seizure." (Stom Sogo)

Born and raised in Osaka, Stom Sogo (1975–2012) moved to New York around 1993, where he continued his creative practice while working as a projectionist at Anthology Film Archives. His unique style—defined by the frequent use of re-photography and the juxtaposition of violently flickering light with home video footage—exerted a profound influence on his contemporaries. This program features a selection of works restored by Anthology Film Archives.
title:ストレンジ・ダーリン:
Set in a town gripped by the terror of a serial killer, this thriller depicts a chance encounter between a man and a woman that spirals into unpredictable territory, told through a masterfully non-linear six-chapter structure. As a series of murders sends shockwaves through the public, a car pulls up in front of a motel. Inside are a man and a woman who have only just met at a bar. Before long, the woman, "The Lady," finds her life targeted by the man, "The Demon," and she flees in desperation from his gun...

Willa Fitzgerald (*Reacher*, *Pulse*) stars as "The Lady," and Kyle Gallner (*Smile*) plays "The Demon," with supporting performances by Madisen Beaty (*The Clovehitch Killer*), Steven Michael Quezada (*Breaking Bad*), Ed Begley Jr. (*She-Devil*), and Barbara Hershey (*Black Swan*). The film is written and directed by J.T. Mollner, who has garnered significant attention for this work and is also penning the screenplay for the film adaptation of Stephen King’s *The Long Walk*. Actor Giovanni Ribisi, known for his roles in *Cold Mountain* and *Avatar*, serves as both producer and cinematographer.
title:スノードロップ: Naoko lives with her mother, who has dementia, and her father, who is unemployed due to a worsening chronic illness. The family begins to consider applying for public assistance, but... A drama based on a real-life incident involving "a certain choice."
title:スパイダーマン2: THE RIVER, one of Japan's largest overseas pop culture media outlets, celebrates its 10th anniversary in 2026. "REVIVAL by THE RIVER" is a new project expanding the community of online film fans into the real-world space of movie theaters. THE RIVER brings the films we once longed for back to the big screen. THE RIVER reunites films with their audiences! The commemorative first screening is 'Spider-Man 2'! Two years after the fierce battle with the Green Goblin, college student Peter Parker struggles with part-time jobs and classes while fighting for justice, leading a hectic life. Torn between his love for MJ and his friendship with Harry due to his identity as Spider-Man, Peter accepts his fate. A new enemy, Doctor Octopus, stands in his way. The most powerful action entertainment ever, surpassing its predecessor and achieving historic box office records. Flat rate of 1,600 yen (free tickets, invitation tickets, and various discount services not applicable). Online/TCG members: June 23 (Tue) 18:00~. General sale: June 23 (Tue) 21:00~. Box office sales begin June 24 (Wed). Screenings: July 3 (Fri) ~ July 9 (Thu), one screening per day at 18:10.
title:スパイ・ゲーム: Brad Pitt and Robert Redford, the duo from 'A River Runs Through It', reunite. A story of the passionate friendship between CIA spies and a desperate rescue mission.
title:スマッシング・マシーン: The untold story of mixed martial artist Mark Kerr, who rose to fame during the early days of the "PRIDE" tournament that captivated all of Japan, is brought to film by Dwayne Johnson—also known as the wrestler The Rock—who stars and produces. Making his MMA debut in 1997, Mark Kerr rose undefeated to the top. After consecutive wins in the UFC, he also made a stunning run in Japan's PRIDE, becoming feared as "the strongest man in the hominidae family," but the pressure quietly eroded his mind. Kerr gradually became dependent on painkillers, and his relationship with his girlfriend Dawn deteriorated. After experiencing his first defeat, he finally confronts his own weakness and decides to step back into the ring to rebuild his life. Dwayne Johnson, inspired by the 2002 documentary of the same name, personally secured the film rights and carefully portrays the vulnerable side of a tough man. Emily Blunt plays Kerr's girlfriend Dawn, and Japanese actors including Tadanobu Asano, Satoshi Ishii, Yasuko Mitsuura, and Tomoyasu Hotei also appear. Benny Safdie, highly acclaimed for his co-directed works with his brother Josh such as "Uncut Gems," makes his solo directorial debut with this film, winning the Silver Lion for Best Director at the 82nd Venice International Film Festival in 2025. A team led by Japanese makeup artist Kazuhiro Tsuji handled the special effects makeup, earning a nomination for the Academy Award for Best Makeup and Hairstyling at the 98th Academy Awards.
title:スマラグダ: Screened at "EU Film Days 2026" (Tokyo: May 16–29, 2026 at Theater Image Forum, May 19–24 at National Film Archive; Nagoya: June 6–19 at Nagoya Kinema Noi; also to be held in Hiroshima, Kyoto, and Fukuoka).
title:スムース・トーク: Produced in 1985, this film marks Laura Dern’s first starring role. Based on a short story by Joyce Carol Oates, this coming-of-age drama explores the perils and awakenings of adolescence, capturing the ambiguous and precarious boundaries of girlhood. Fifteen-year-old Connie spends her days hanging out at the mall with friends and losing herself in music, all while testing the limits of her own charm and freedom. At home, she is in constant conflict with her conservative mother, grappling with the loneliness and frustration unique to her age. One summer day, a mysterious young man named Arnold Friend appears. His honeyed words and unsettling presence begin to quietly and decisively transform Connie’s world. The film was directed by Joyce Chopra, a veteran documentarian making her narrative feature debut. Laura Dern stars as Connie, with Treat Williams (*Prince of the City*) playing Arnold. The cast also features Mary Kay Place as her mother, Katherine, and Levon Helm of the rock band The Band as her father, Harry. The film won the Grand Jury Prize at the 1986 Sundance Film Festival.
title:スリ: Michel, a poor university student, discovers by chance that he has a talent for pickpocketing. Though once caught by a detective, he is released due to lack of evidence and soon targets others' wallets again. Eventually, his methods become organized as he brings in accomplices. In 'A Man Escaped,' Bresson realistically and thrillingly depicted a prison break; here, he turns his focus to pickpocketing, introducing actual techniques while portraying a lonely young man distrustful of others. A gripping masterpiece where the realism born from amateur actors and the suspense created by various pickpocketing scenes blend seamlessly.
title:スリ（1959）: A suspense drama centered on the theme of pickpocketing by director Robert Bresson, following his work *A Man Escaped*. Michel, a poor university student with a natural manual dexterity, eventually begins to make a living as a pickpocket. Though initially caught by the police, he is released due to insufficient evidence, and his crimes gradually become more organized. Meanwhile, Jeanne, who lives in the room next to his mother’s apartment, finds herself drawn to him... The film depicts Michel, a young man who believes that superior individuals have the freedom to break the law, as he becomes captivated by the craft of pickpocket
title:スーパーガール: A DC Universe film following James Gunn's 2025 "Superman," this hero action movie centers on Supergirl / Kara Zor-El, the cousin of Superman / Clark Kent. In a world after Superman saved Earth, Kara Zor-El, who lost her home planet Krypton, lives quietly with her beloved dog Krypto, her only emotional anchor. One day, a mysterious enemy named Krem suddenly appears and poisons Krypto. To obtain the antidote, Kara embarks on a grand cosmic battle alongside Lucy, an alien girl whose family was also taken by Krem, and a vicious bounty hunter robot. Millie Alcock, the young Australian actor who gained attention for the TV series "House of the Dragon," reprises her role as Supergirl / Kara Zor-El from "Superman." Evey Ridley (Netflix's "3 Body Problem") plays the alien girl Lucy Mary Noelle, and Jason Momoa ("Aquaman," "A Minecraft Movie") co-stars as the bounty hunter robot. Superdog Krypto, who appeared in "Superman," also returns. Produced by James Gunn's DC Studios following "Superman," the film is directed by Craig Gillespie ("I, Tonya," "Cruella").
title:センチメンタル・バリュー: Swedish director Joachim Trier, who gained international attention with "The Worst Person in the World," crafts a family drama centered on the tangled bonds of love and hate inherent in the parent-child relationship. Nora, an actress thriving in Oslo, and her sister Agnes, who chose family life and lives quietly with her husband and son. One day, their father Gustav, a film director who abandoned the family when they were young and has been out of contact for years, reappears and offers Nora the lead role in his first autobiographical film in 15 years. Filled with anger and disappointment toward her father, Nora firmly refuses, and soon the popular young American actress Rachel is cast instead. When Nora learns that the film will be shot at the family's old home, a place filled with memories, uncontrollable emotions surge within her once again. Renate Reinsve, who also starred in "The Worst Person in the World," plays the protagonist Nora, with acclaimed actor Stellan Skarsgård as her father Gustav. Inga Ibsdotter Lilleaas plays sister Agnes, and Elle Fanning plays the popular American actress Rachel. The film won the Grand Prix at the 78th Cannes Film Festival in 2025. At the 98th Academy Awards, it received nine nominations across eight categories, including Best Picture, and won the award for Best International Feature Film.
title:セーラー服と機関銃: The boss of a small yakuza gang called Medaka-gumi, who has only four underlings, dies leaving a will stating that his successor must be a blood relative. Around the same time, high school girl Izumi Hoshi is saying her final goodbye at the crematorium to her father Takashi, who died after being hit by a car in front of Narita Airport. Izumi's mother passed away long ago, leaving her truly alone. When Izumi returns to her apartment, a woman named Mayumi is there, carrying a letter from her father that says, 'If I die, please take care of Izumi.' The next day, a crowd of men in black suits lines up in front of her school. Ignoring her friends Tomoki, Tetsuo, and Shuhei, who try to stop her, Izumi heads toward the school gate. The man from the crematorium steps forward and says, 'You're Izumi Hoshi, right?' This man, named Sakuma, takes her to a shabby office and asks her to succeed as the fourth-generation boss of the Medaka-gumi.
title:ソイレント・グリーン: Directed by Richard Fleischer of "Fantastic Voyage" fame, this 1973 near-future sci-fi film adapts Harry Harrison's novel "Make Room! Make Room!" and depicts various social issues such as overpopulation, extreme weather, food shortages, resource depletion, ecological collapse, and poverty. In 2022, New York City is suffering from explosive population growth, leaving people homeless and food shortages commonplace, while rapid climate change has subjected the city to heat waves. In a world of extreme inequality, most people spend their days idly waiting for the weekly government ration of the nutrient food "Soylent." Amidst this, a murder occurs: Simonsohn, an executive of the Soylent Corporation who just announced the new product "Soylent Green" as the ultimate nutrition, is killed. Homicide detective Thorn takes on the investigation... Charlton Heston of "Ben-Hur" stars as Detective Thorn, with Edward G. Robinson of "Little Caesar" co-starring. A digitally remastered version was revived in theaters in May 2024.
title:ソング・サング・ブルー: A musical drama starring Hugh Jackman and Kate Hudson in their first collaboration, based on the true story of a married couple who performed as a tribute band to American national singer Neil Diamond. Mike, who once dreamed of a music career, now can only get on stage by imitating someone else's singing, hitting rock bottom in life. One day, he meets Claire, a woman with the same passion, and they form a tribute band to their beloved Neil Diamond. Starting from a small garage, their voices gradually capture the hearts of the people in their town. But then, a sudden tragedy strikes them. Jackman and Hudson deliver powerful performances of Neil Diamond's classic songs, including 'Sweet Caroline.' The cast includes Michael Imperioli from 'The Sopranos,' Ella Anderson from 'The Glass Castle,' and singer-songwriter King Princess. Based on the 2008 documentary of the same name, Craig Brewer, director of 'Hustle & Flow,' wrote and directed the film. Hudson was nominated for Best Actress at the 98th Academy Awards.
title:ゾンビ 1/2 Right Side of the Living D:
A unique zombie comedy set in a post-pandemic world, following the new chaos sparked by a protagonist living as the world's only "half-zombie" who retained his sanity.

Ryoma Shingu, an ordinary office worker, is the sole remaining zombie after humanity triumphed over the undead threat. As a "half-zombie" who can maintain his reason despite being bitten, he has been living a quiet, mundane life accepted by society. Ryoma wants nothing more than to live peacefully without making waves, but when he accidentally bites Uzame, a college intern at his company, a new zombie pandemic erupts. Although Ryoma knows he must stop the chaos, his deep-seated introverted nature gets in the way, making it difficult for him to take action...

Sojiro Yoshimura of "PARALLEL" stars as Ryoma, alongside Seina Nakata, Koki Tanaka (SUPER★DRAGON), Shunsuke Daito, and Kiyobumi Kaneko. The screenplay is written by Moral, known for "Crayon Shin-chan the Movie: Our Dinosaur Diary" and the anime "Hiroshi Nohara's Lunch Style." The film was produced as the second installment of "M CINEMA," a project by production company Media Mix Japan (MMJ) that provides opportunities for young employees in their 20s and 30s to plan and produce theatrical films.
title:ゾンビ1/2 〜Right Side of the Living D:
"Zombie 1/2: Right Side of the Living Dead" is the second production in the M CINEMA series presented by MMJ. Featuring an introverted office worker who has become the world's only zombie as its protagonist, 24-year-old rookie director and zombie geek Erika Ota delivers a brand-new sensation in zombie horror-comedy like you've never seen before!

Humanity has triumphed over the zombie threat, leaving only one zombie left in the world. This "last zombie" is the protagonist of our story. Having maintained his sanity even after being bitten, he lives an ordinary life as an office worker, accepted by society as a "half-zombie."

However, after he instinctively bites an intern named Uzame, a new zombie pandemic erupts! Dragging in his crush, Eruko-senpai, and the zombie researcher Dr. Horafukida, a mysterious man named Hiiringu—who operates in the shadows of a facility called the "Healing Half-Zombie House"—also appears...

Can our hero save the world and everyone in it—!?
title:タリーと私の秘密の時間: Marlo, a mother of three including a newborn, is given a night nanny by her brother. Initially hesitant, she soon bonds deeply with Tully, a nanny who is thoughtful, surprising, and at times challenging.
title:タービュランス 絶空16,000フィート: A situational survival thriller set in the inescapable space of a floating hot air balloon, depicting the threats of nature and human conflict. To repair his relationship with his wife Amy, who is grieving a miscarriage, ambitious CEO Zach joins a hot air balloon tour crossing the Italian Dolomites with her. A mysterious woman named Julia joins them, and the flight with the three passengers begins. But high in the sky, Julia suddenly reveals that she had a secret meeting with Zach the previous day, accusing him of infidelity. Zach denies it, but suspicion swirls, and Julia suddenly pulls a knife. During the struggle, the pilot falls out, and the balloon goes out of control. With the radio dead and the balloon reaching an oxygen-thin altitude of 16,000 feet, battered by turbulence and storms, the three are forced into extreme choices with no escape. Directed by Claudio Fae of 'Air Lock: Underwater Emergency Shelter,' with a screenplay by Andy Mason, who wrote and produced 'Air Lock: Underwater Emergency Shelter' and '47 Meters Down.' The cast includes Hera Hilmar of 'Mortal Engines' as Amy, Jeremy Irvine of 'War Horse' as Zach, and Olga Kurylenko, known as a Bond girl from 'Quantum of Solace,' as Julia.
title:ダイナソーJr. フリークシーン: A documentary chronicling the history of the American band Dinosaur Jr., a central force in the alternative rock scene from the late 1980s through the 1990s. Formed in Massachusetts in 1984 by members directly impacted by the 80s US hardcore/punk scene, Dinosaur Jr. gained immense support for their unique sound, wrapping melancholic and nostalgic melodies in harsh, roaring noise. Despite lineup changes and hiatuses, they continue to create new music today. Focusing on the relationship between the three original members—guitarist/vocalist J Mascis, bassist Lou Barlow, and drummer Murph—the film traces their roughly 30-year trajectory through rare past footage and testimonies from musicians close to them. Produced by the band themselves, it is directed by music video filmmaker Philipp Reichenheim, who is related to J Mascis by marriage.
title:ダイヤモンド 私たちの衣装工房: A humorous human drama set in a 1970s Rome costume workshop, depicting the lives of the seamstresses, which became a hot topic in Italy. Directed by Ferzan Özpetek ("Bitter Coffee," "Tomorrow's Pasta is Al Dente"), the film is inspired by his memories of the people he met at a historic Roman costume workshop during his time as an assistant director, paying homage to the artisans who supported the golden age of Italian cinema. In 1970s Rome, at the costume workshop run by the Canova sisters, the seamstresses work busily. Behind the scenes of glamorous costume creation, each woman has her own troubles: Paolina, a single mother in charge of hats, and Nicoletta, a seamstress afraid of her violent husband. One day, a request for a new creation comes from a world-renowned costume designer. To meet their high demands, they strive to create a supreme, one-of-a-kind garment unlike anything seen before... Starring Luisa Ranieri ("Parthenope"), Jasmine Trinca ("The Son's Room"), and Stefano Accorsi ("The Starting Line"). Costumes are designed by Stefano Ciamitti, who also designed the costumes for the closing ceremony of the 2026 Milan-Cortina Winter Olympics. The film won the Audience Award at the 70th David di Donatello Awards in 2025.
title:ダウントン・アビー: Set in early 20th-century Britain, this is the final chapter of the masterpiece drama depicting the intricate human relationships and changing times of the aristocratic Crawley family and their servants living in a magnificent mansion.
title:ダブル・クラッチ: Centered on the bond between a young man (Go) who dreams of becoming a racer and his older sister (Matsuzaka), who works as a station vendor by day and a hostess by night to support him and fulfill his dream. The story also unfolds a passionate love affair between the sister and a teacher (Chii), as well as a gentle romance between the young man and the teacher's sister-in-law (Morishita). However, one day, a tragic event strikes the close-knit siblings. The teacher, whom the sister trusted, turns out to be married; he impregnates her and ultimately murders her. Enraged for his sister, the young man seeks revenge, double-clutching his car into a deadly car chase against the teacher.
title:チェイサーゲームW 水魚の交わり: A film version serving as a sequel to the TV dramas 'Chaser Game W: My Ex-Girlfriend is My Harassing Boss' and 'Chaser Game W2: The Beautiful Celestial Maidens,' which delicately portrayed the realities of the game industry and a romance between women. Set seven years after the drama, it depicts the relationship evolving over time and the two women confronting life choices. Itsuki and Fuyu live in Ito City, Shizuoka Prefecture, with their daughter Tsuki, now a middle school student. As they become consumed by housework, childcare, and work, their time together becomes routine. Over the seven years, their relationship shifts from lovers to family, and they gradually begin to drift apart. Though they maintain a peaceful home while being disturbed by each other's casual words and attitudes, their daughter Tsuki senses the unease between her parents. One day, Tsuki gets into trouble and is helped by a taxi driver named Kozue. This encounter prompts Itsuki and Fuyu to confront each other's true feelings for the first time and re-examine the form of love they have lost sight of. Continuing from the drama series, Sugai Yuka stars as Itsuki, Nakamura Yurika as Fuyu, Okamoto Mirai as their middle-school-aged daughter Tsuki, Ito Ayumi as taxi driver Kozue, and Kurotani Tomoka as Department Chief Ro. Directed by Ota Isamu, who also worked on the drama series, with a screenplay by Asada Atsushi.
title:チェチェンへ アレクサンドラの旅: Director Alexander Sokurov (*The Sun*, *Taurus*) presents a profound human drama filmed on the actual front lines of the Chechen conflict. World-renowned Russian opera singer Galina Vishnevskaya makes her cinematic debut, delivering a masterful performance as the protagonist, Alexandra. Eighty-year-old Alexandra travels to the front lines of the war in Chechnya to visit her grandson, Denis. Concerned for her grandson, a soldier whose profession is to kill, Alexandra...
title:チャオ・パンタン: A French noir directed by Claude Berri in 1983, known for 'The Old Man and the Child' and 'Jean de Florette'/'Manon des Sources,' which became a huge hit in France attracting nearly 4 million viewers. Set in the Parisian underworld, it vividly portrays the loneliness and sorrow of those cast out from the city through a tale of friendship and revenge between a lonely middle-aged man and a young drug dealer. In the 18th arrondissement of Paris, one night, a young man named Bensoussan, of Jewish and Arab descent, flees into the gas station where Lambert, an alcoholic middle-aged man, works. Bensoussan begins visiting Lambert frequently, and Lambert starts looking after him. However, Bensoussan, a drug dealer, is killed by two men on a motorcycle. Lambert swears revenge, takes a gun, and heads out into the night. French national comedian Coluche plays the protagonist Lambert, and Richard Anconina, known for 'The Pistol and the Boy,' plays Bensoussan. At the 9th César Awards, Coluche won Best Actor, and Anconina won Best Supporting Actor and Most Promising Actor. Based on the novel by Alain Page, known for 'The Sun Knows,' the screenplay was co-written by Page and director Berri. Scheduled for a revival release in Japan in July 2026 in a 4K digital version.
title:チャップリン:
The first documentary officially authorized by the Chaplin family: a new story exploring the roots of Charlie Chaplin.

Charlie Chaplin captivated the world with humor-filled works that masterfully blended slapstick comedy with the pathos of the common man and social satire. Dressed as the "Little Tramp"—with his trademark toothbrush mustache, baggy pants, oversized shoes, cane, and bowler hat—he was beloved for his
title:ツイッギー: A documentary exploring the life and allure of Twiggy, the legendary British model who captivated the world in the 1960s. Debuting at age 16 in 1965, Twiggy quickly rose to stardom, and with her famously slender, twig-like figure and unique fashion sense, she overturned conventional standards of beauty. Becoming an icon of the Swinging London youth culture, she revolutionized the fashion world, sparking a global miniskirt boom. Later, pursuing her own forms of expression, she also found success as an actress and singer, notably starring in Ken Russell's 1971 musical film "The Boy Friend," which drew significant attention. Through Twiggy's own words, rare archival footage, and interviews with those connected to her—including Brooke Shields, Dustin Hoffman, Paul McCartney, and Sienna Miller—the film portrays her life as a woman and mother, her struggles, and her choices. The director is actress Sadie Frost, who also helmed the documentary "Mary Quant: The Legend of Swinging London."
title:テレビショッピングの女王 青池春香の事件チャンネル:
The first installment in the "2-Hour Suspense THE MOVIE" series, this film is inspired by the "2-hour suspense drama"—a genre produced and broadcast by commercial networks from the Showa to Heisei eras that became an iconic staple of Japanese television culture beloved by audiences. Starring Yuko Natori, a veteran lead of numerous 2-hour suspense dramas, and comedian Tomochika, the story follows TV shopping presenters as they pursue the truth behind a murder that occurs during a live broadcast.

Haruka Aoike, a legendary navigator and charismatic buyer boasting the highest sales in TV shopping history, and Yoshie Nagano, the "Queen of Live Demonstrations" whose featured products fly off the shelves, find themselves embroiled in a murder case during a live sales showdown. Though the two are clashing rivals, they unite under the common goal of uncovering the truth, using their wit and insight to close in on the heart of the mystery. Natori plays the legendary Haruka while Tomochika portrays the demonstration queen Yoshie, showcasing a perfectly synchronized and witty rapport.
title:ディスタンス: Four men and women, all family members of the perpetrators of a murder case committed by a cult three years earlier, meet once a year to pay their respects at the lake where the ashes were scattered. That year, their car goes missing as they try to return from the lake. Stranded, they end up spending the night at a lodge where the cult members once lived, along with a former cult member who also lost his motorcycle. Directed by Hirokazu Kore-eda of "After Life" fame. Starring ARATA, Yusuke Iseya, Susumu Terajima, Tadanobu Asano, and others.
title:ディッシュアップ: This drama depicts a chef with communication difficulties and a free-spirited Korean woman who comes to learn Japanese cuisine. As they repeatedly try to revitalize the restaurant, they gradually break free from their rigid values. It is the feature-length debut of director Harumi Ikemoto, whose short film 'The Hunt' won the Excellence Award in the short film category at the 2023 SKIP City International D-Cinema Festival. Three years after losing his father, George Uehara took over the restaurant 'Yurie.' Although his cooking skills are solid, he is forced to accept the reality that the restaurant has recently seen fewer customers. Then Kim Juri, who came to Japan from Korea to learn Japanese cuisine, appears and starts working part-time at the restaurant. Despite clashing due to their differing values, they gradually grow closer and try various ideas to boost the restaurant's business. Sho Aoyagi, a member of 'Gekidan EXILE' active in films and dramas, plays George, a chef who struggles to express his thoughts and feelings and has some communication difficulties. Yeon-su Ha, who moved her base of operations from Korea to Japan and appeared in the NHK morning drama 'The Tiger's Wing,' plays Kim Juri, the part-time worker who initially keeps her distance from George due to her free-spirited nature. Yusuke Mikawa, known for 'Cloud,' co-stars as Iwakura, another part-time employee who watches over the two.
title:デイヴィッド・ブルックス作品集: Appointed executive director of the Film-Makers’ Cooperative (founded by Jonas Mekas) at the age of 18, David Brooks (1944–1969) was a central figure in the New York underground film scene, producing brilliant works until his death at the young age of 24. In his major films *The Night Fountain / Day Star* and *Winter 64–66*, fragments of daily life captured by an unrestrained camera are collaged with soundtracks like free jazz, creating a lyrical and fantastical cinematic world. This program also features four short films, including his early work *Jerry* and his final film *Eel Creek*.
title:デジモンアドベンチャー: The first theatrical film in the "Digimon" series. From a midnight computer screen, a strange creature named "Botamon" is born! While Tai is uneasy, his little sister Kari is overjoyed. Botamon evolves into Agumon! Suddenly, the Digital World, home to digital monsters, appears. A bird-like monster charges at Agumon. But then, another change occurs in Agumon's body... Evolution into the giant monster "Greymon" begins! Two colossal monsters clash—what will be the outcome of this fierce battle?
title:デスストーカー: From Steven Kostanski, the mad genius director of "Psycho Goreman" (2020) and member of Canada's notorious effects collective Astron-6, who has contributed special effects to Hollywood blockbusters like "Resident Evil: Retribution" (2012) and "Pacific Rim" (2013). His two latest films, "Frankie Freako" and "Deathstalker," will be released sequentially in Japan starting July 3rd at Cinemart Shinjuku and other theaters nationwide. Kostanski, who wrote and directed both films, is known for his unique creature designs reminiscent of classics like "E.T." (1982), "Gremlins" (1984), and "The Goonies" (1985), blending 80s-style monster panic with absurdist black humor, creating a devoted fanbase. These new films bring his signature style to Japan. "Deathstalker" is a reboot of the 1984 cult classic "Deathstalker" (executive produced by Roger Corman). It reconstructs the sword-and-sorcery world with Kostanski's signature nightmarish horror and gore, infused with comedy and darkness. Daniel Bernhardt ("The Matrix Reloaded," "John Wick") stars as the titular Deathstalker. Slash, guitarist of Guns N' Roses, contributes to production and music. Synopsis: In a chaotic world ruled by sword and sorcery, the kingdom of Abraxion suffers under attacks from the sudden appearance of the crimson knight order, the Dread Knights, and is in decline. Unsettling rumors spread that this war is a precursor to the resurrection of the ancient sorcerer Necromemnon. Amidst this, the insolent wandering warrior Deathstalker comes into possession of a cursed amulet, making him a target for the Dread Knight's assassins. To break the curse and repel the approaching evil, Deathstalker embarks on a perilous journey, eventually being drawn into a battle that will decide the fate of the world.
