Following his passing on January 15 last year (2025), director David Lynch—often hailed as the "King of Cult" for his one-of-a-kind style and beloved by a fervent global fanbase—will be honored with an all-night screening event titled "David Lynch Night," featuring three of his iconic works in a single night.

Mulholland Drive (4K Restored Edition)
Mulholland Drive: a midnight mountain road shrouded in darkness. One night, a car crash occurs, leaving a beautiful woman as the sole survivor, though she has lost her memory. She hides in the home of a famous actress while the owner is away, only to be discovered by Betty, an aspiring young actress. Lacking any memory of her identity, the woman impulsively calls herself Rita...
2001 | USA | 146 min (PG12)
Director/Screenplay: David Lynch
Cast: Naomi Watts, Laura Harring, Ann Miller, Justin Theroux, Dan Hedaya, Mark Pellegrino, Brian Beacock, et al.

Twin Peaks: Fire Walk with Me (4K)
The theatrical film of the U.S. TV series that sparked a global phenomenon. It serves as a prequel to the serial murder mystery set in the rural town of Twin Peaks. "Twin Peaks" became a cultural sensation in Japan, even entering the popular lexicon, and was a massive hit with 2 billion yen in distribution revenue.
1992 | USA | 135 min
Director/Screenplay: David Lynch
Cast: Sheryl Lee, Ray Wise, Dana Ashbrook, Kyle MacLachlan, David Bowie, Kiefer Sutherland

Lost Highway (4K)
Fred, a saxophonist, lives an ordinary life with his wife until one day, a mysterious videotape arrives. It contains footage of his wife’s dismembered body, leading to his imprisonment... A terrifying "Lynchian world" where reality dissolves, this was his seventh feature film and his first in five years.
1997 | USA | 135 min
Director/Screenplay: David Lynch | Screenplay: Barry Gifford
Cast: Bill Pullman, Patricia Arquette, Balthazar Getty, Robert Blake, Robert Loggia, Jack Nance
title:トイ・ストーリー5: The fifth installment in Disney and Pixar's beloved 'Toy Story' series, which has always explored the bond between toys and children. It depicts Woody and Buzz joining forces once again to face an unprecedented threat from modern technology. Buzz, Jessie, Forky, and the others living with Bonnie are enjoying their usual daily life. However, everything changes when the latest electronic tablet, the 'Lilypad,' arrives. Seeing Bonnie absorbed in the multi-functional device, the toys begin to doubt their own purpose. As anxiety spreads that 'toys are no longer needed,' Woody receives an SOS from his friends and returns to Bonnie's side, reuniting with Buzz. The legendary duo stands up to a new threat to protect the place of toys. Directed and written by Andrew Stanton, known for 'Finding Nemo' and 'WALL-E,' who has also worked on the 'Toy Story' series as a story and scriptwriter, bringing a new story as a creator who has supported the series. The co-director is Kena Harris, who directed the Pixar short 'Alberto's Letter.' The Japanese dub features the familiar cast including Toshiaki Karasawa as Woody, George Tokoro as Buzz, Yumi Kusaka, and Ryo Ryusei.
title:トイ・ストーリー５: The fifth installment in Disney and Pixar's beloved 'Toy Story' series, which has always explored the bond between toys and children. It depicts Woody and Buzz joining forces once again to face an unprecedented threat from modern technology. Buzz, Jessie, Forky, and the others living with Bonnie are enjoying their usual daily life. However, everything changes when the latest electronic tablet, the 'Lilypad,' arrives. Seeing Bonnie absorbed in the multi-functional device, the toys begin to doubt their own purpose. As anxiety spreads that 'toys are no longer needed,' Woody receives an SOS from his friends and returns to Bonnie's side, reuniting with Buzz. The legendary duo stands up to a new threat to protect the place of toys. Directed and written by Andrew Stanton, known for 'Finding Nemo' and 'WALL-E,' who has also worked on the 'Toy Story' series as a story and scriptwriter, bringing a new story as a creator who has supported the series. The co-director is Kena Harris, who directed the Pixar short 'Alberto's Letter.' The Japanese dub features the familiar cast including Toshiaki Karasawa as Woody, George Tokoro as Buzz, Yumi Kusaka, and Ryo Ryusei.
title:トゥインクル・トゥインクル・キラー・カーン: The directorial debut of William Peter Blatty, known as the author of 'The Exorcist,' who adapted his own novel. Blatty wrote, directed, produced, and scripted this unique human drama set in an old castle used as a psychiatric hospital. In a remote mountain castle serving as a sanatorium, soldiers driven insane by the Vietnam War are gathered and treated. Among them is astronaut Billy Cutshaw, who was committed after going mad just before a rocket launch. One day, Navy psychiatrist Hudson Kane arrives at the facility. Kane listens sympathetically to the patients, but Cutshaw is defiant, and Kane soon begins to be plagued by nightmares. Won the Golden Globe for Best Screenplay. Stars Stacy Keach of 'Roadgames' and 'Escape from L.A.' Although never theatrically released in Japan, it will have its first theatrical screening in 2026 as part of the 'Shinjuku Hardcore Masterpiece Selection 2' special screening (April 17 - May 21, 2026, at CineMart Shinjuku).
title:トゥギャザー:
A horror film that thrillingly depicts a couple in a stagnant relationship pushed to their limits by supernatural physical mutations, infused with a healthy dose of black humor. Marking the feature debut of Australian director and screenwriter Michael Shanks, the film blends the body horror subgenre with themes of romantic codependency.

Long-time partners Tim, an aspiring musician, and Millie, an elementary school teacher, leave the city to start a new life in a house in the countryside. However, after getting lost in the woods and spending a night in an eerie underground cave, their peaceful routine takes a dark turn. Tim begins to suffer from mysterious symptoms—sudden lapses in consciousness and a body that acts of its own accord—straining his already drifting relationship with Millie. Soon, Millie begins to experience the same symptoms. Drawn together as if by an invisible magnetic force, the phenomenon begins to erode the love they’ve built and every aspect of their lives.

Dave Franco (*Now You See Me*) and Alison Brie (*Promising Young Woman*) star as Tim and Millie. Real-life partners, the duo brings a raw realism to this exploration of the deep-seated psychology of love.
title:トニー滝谷: A love story adapted from Haruki Murakami's short story of the same name, directed by Jun Ichikawa of 'Tokiwa: The Manga Apartment' and 'Tsugumi,' starring Issey Ogata and Rie Miyazawa. Tony Takitani, born as the son of a trombonist, loses his mother shortly after birth and grows up carrying loneliness. After working at a design company, he becomes an independent illustrator, falls in love with a woman, and marries her. But their happy days are short-lived; his wife dies in an accident. Feeling his loneliness, he hires a woman who closely resembles his late wife as an assistant and tries to get used to her death by having the assistant wear the vast collection of clothes his shopaholic wife left behind... Issey Ogata plays the protagonist Tony Takitani and his father, Rie Miyazawa plays Tony's wife and the woman who resembles her, with Hidetoshi Nishijima providing narration. The music is composed by Ryuichi Sakamoto. The film won the Special Jury Prize, the FIPRESCI Prize, and the Youth Jury Award at the 57th Locarno International Film Festival in 2004. A 4K remastered version was re-released in 2026.
title:トラベラー: The feature-length debut of Iranian master Abbas Kiarostami, made in 1974, this human drama freshly depicts the funny yet poignant adventures of a boy struggling desperately to watch a soccer match. Gassem, a 10-year-old boy attending elementary school, is obsessed with soccer, often neglecting his homework and classes, earning constant scolding from his teacher and mother. Determined to go see an important match held in the capital, Tehran, he tries every trick to get money for transportation and a ticket, including stealing from home and deceiving his friends... A digital remastered version was screened as part of the special program "And Kiarostami Continues" (from October 16, 2021, at Eurospace in Tokyo and other venues).
title:トランジット・イン・フラミンゴ:
A slightly mysterious and warm road movie about three strangers who set out on a journey to find a "flamingo." Set in Nara, this human drama depicts the emotional turbulence and rebirth of young people harboring feelings with nowhere to go. It is written and directed by Yuki Horiuchi, who has garnered attention in the indie film scene for works such as *At the Dawn* and *Festival Day*.

Sae moved to the area with her lover only to be abandoned; Ryutaro spends his days unable to leave his hometown; and Akari arrives carrying a refrigerator on her back, searching for memories of her best friend. After a chance encounter, the three strangers find themselves on a quest for a "flamingo." As they wander aimlessly, stopping at public baths and supermarkets, the hidden emotions of each begin to surface, and their stalled lives slowly start to move forward again.

The film stars Rio Yamashita (*Yukiko a.k.a.*), Gaku Hosokawa (*Sasaki in My Mind*), and Kilala Inori (*Yamabuki*, *HAPPYEND*), with Kotone Furukawa providing a voice performance. Naomi Kawase—the Nara-based filmmaker internationally acclaimed for works such as *Suzaku* and *True Mothers*—serves as executive producer. The music is by singer-songwriter Yujiro Kudo.
title:トレインスポッティング: A youth film that portrays the cheerful yet miserable lives of young people addicted to drugs, becoming an iconic work of 1990s British pop culture. Renton, a heroin addict living in Edinburgh, Scotland, spends his aimless days hanging out with fellow heroin addicts Sick Boy and Spud, and the violent, alcoholic Begbie. One day, after being arrested for shoplifting, Renton decides to reform, moves to London, and gets a job. However, Begbie and Sick Boy, on the run after a robbery, show up one after another, and Renton gets fired. When they return home, they attend the funeral of their friend Tommy, who turned to drugs after a breakup. Amid overwhelming despair, Renton and the others take a big gamble to change their lives... This is Danny Boyle's second directorial work and the breakout film for Ewan McGregor and Robert Carlyle.
title:トロフィー: The protagonist is Sohui, a 14-year-old Zainichi Korean girl. She attends a Korean school and devotes herself to Korean dance in her club activities. One day, at an exchange event with a Japanese school, she becomes friends with a Japanese girl named Mirai over their shared love of K-Pop, and Sohui gradually connects with the outside world. To earn money for tickets to their favorite K-Pop idol's concert, the two decide to sell unused items from Sohui's house on a flea market app. Surprisingly, the item that sells for a high price is a North Korean CD owned by Sohui's father, Sanju, who is the principal of the Korean school. Emboldened, Sohui and her friend even sell a "medal" awarded to Sanju by his homeland, North Korea.
title:ドゥリム パレス: Set in a newly built apartment complex in South Korea, this drama exposes the distortions of modern capitalism through the struggle of a woman caught between construction defects and neighborly conflict. After losing her husband in a workplace fire, Hye-jung spent years protesting against the company to uncover the truth. Exhausted by the long battle, she eventually accepts a settlement and moves into the "Dream Palace" complex with her middle-school son, Dong-wook. Her hope for a fresh start is short-lived when she discovers serious structural defects in her unit. The real estate company refuses
title:ドライブ・マイ・カー: Inheriting the original story of a man's loss and hope after losing his wife, this is a remarkable narrative where the story and the play within the film resonate contrapuntally, boldly incorporating theatrical elements from timeless works like 'Uncle Vanya' and 'Waiting for Godot.' It won four awards including Best Screenplay at the 74th Cannes Film Festival and won the Academy Award for Best International Feature Film at the 94th Academy Awards.
title:ドライブ・マイ・カー濱⼝⻯介監督特集上映突然、偶然、必然: Inheriting the original story of a man's loss and hope after losing his wife, this is a remarkable narrative where the story and the play within the film resonate contrapuntally, boldly incorporating theatrical elements from timeless works like 'Uncle Vanya' and 'Waiting for Godot.' It won four awards including Best Screenplay at the 74th Cannes Film Festival and won the Academy Award for Best International Feature Film at the 94th Academy Awards.
title:ドランクヌードル:
Set against the urban backdrop of Brooklyn and the forests of Upstate New York, this four-chapter tale is woven with poetic imagery that blends daily life, memory, and fantasy. Adnan, a young art student, arrives in Brooklyn for the summer to housesit at his uncle’s sophisticated residence. He begins an internship at a gallery, only to discover that the featured works are by an eccentric embroidery artist he encountered the previous summer. As past and present intersect, a series of encounters between sensuality and creativity begin to blur the contours of Adnan’s reality.

Written, directed, and edited by Lucio Castro—an up-and-coming Argentine filmmaker and fashion designer based in New York—the film draws inspiration from the work of American embroidery artist Sal Salandra, known for depicting humorous sexual motifs through traditional needlepoint. The film is peppered with vibrant, playful imagery of embroidery art throughout. The title, *Drunk Noodle*, refers to the Thai dish Pad Kee Mao; one theory behind the name is that its intense spiciness is enough to sober up a drunk.
title:ドリームオン／ドリームオフ: Screened at EU Film Days 2026 (Tokyo: May 16–29, 2026 at Theater Image Forum, May 19–24 at National Film Archive of Japan; Nagoya: June 6–19 at Nagoya Kinema Noi; also held in Hiroshima, Kyoto, and Fukuoka).
title:ナショナル・シアター・ライブ「ウォレン夫人の職業」: One of the National Theatre Live series, which films and screens selected acclaimed stage productions from the UK's Royal National Theatre in cinemas. This recording captures 'Mrs. Warren's Profession', featuring five-time Laurence Olivier Award winner Imelda Staunton performing alongside her real-life daughter Bessie Carter. Vivie Warren is a young woman with progressive ideas. Her mother, however, while upholding the old patriarchal system, has built a fortune by exploiting that very system. But a heavy price lies hidden behind it all. This play by Irish playwright George Bernard Shaw, known for 'Pygmalion' and a Nobel laureate in Literature, is directed by Dominic Cooke, who has also worked on screen productions such as the BBC series 'The Hollow Crown' and the film 'The Memory of Justice'. The cast also includes Kevin Doyle from 'Downton Abbey' and Robert Glenister from 'Into the Sky'.
title:ナショナル・シアター・ライブ「ハムレット」: One of the 'National Theatre Live' productions, where the UK's Royal National Theatre films selected acclaimed stage performances for cinema screenings. This recording features 'Hamlet' starring Sri Lankan-born actor Hiran Abeysekara, who won the Laurence Olivier Award for Best Actor for his performance in 'Life of Pi' at the Royal National Theatre. Surrounded by power and privilege, the young Prince Hamlet wavers between duty and doubt. He confronts the ultimate question: 'To be, or not to be.' Directed by Robert Hastie, who became Associate Artistic Director of the Royal National Theatre in January 2025, offering a contemporary perspective on Shakespeare's masterpiece. Co-stars include Alistair Petrie, known for 'The Bank Job' and 'Rush,' Ayesha Dharker, known for 'Star Wars: Episode II – Attack of the Clones,' and Francesca Mills, known for the Netflix series 'The Witcher: Blood Origin.'
title:ナースコール: A social human drama that depicts the relentless hard work and unexpected troubles constantly falling on nurses in an understaffed, full hospital ward, which became a huge hit in Switzerland. Directed by Swiss screenwriter and filmmaker Petra Volpe, it realistically and thrillingly portrays the urgent, universal problem of hospital realities. Florie, a dedicated and highly professional nurse working in a state hospital, faces an even busier late shift than usual because a colleague is out sick. The ward is full, and she also has to train nursing students. Despite the situation, Florie treats patients with anxiety and loneliness sincerely, but she falls into an unmanageable situation and eventually faces a major trial. Leonie Benesch, known for 'The Teachers' Lounge' and 'September 5,' stars.
title:ニッポン狂想曲: Directed by Takafumi Ota, who has tackled social issues head-on in works such as *The House of the Rising Sun* and *Okinawa Rhapsody*, this documentary attempts to uncover the truth behind numerous incidents that shook the world but remain shrouded in mystery. Planned by Professor Emeritus Akira Kimura of Kagoshima University, the film features prominent intellectuals—including Taro Yamamoto, Ukeru Magosaki, Kazuhiro Haraguchi, Peter Kuznick, and Yukio Hatoyama—as they conduct a thorough investigation into subjects such as the assassination of former Prime Minister Abe, the attempted assassination of Donald Trump, the U.S. Capitol attack, the hidden struggles of the Hatoyama administration, the connection and vested interests between the Noto Peninsula earthquake and the Osaka Expo, and the COVID-19 vaccine controversy.

title:ヌーヴェルヴァーグ: From the director of "Boyhood" and the "Before" series, Richard Linklater, comes a film that goes behind the scenes of Jean-Luc Godard's "Breathless"—a landmark work of the French New Wave, the revolutionary film movement that emerged in the late 1950s. It depicts the young people who sparked a revolution in film history, along with their vibrant interactions with the leading filmmakers of French cinema. In 1959, France. Jean-Luc Godard, a 28-year-old critic writing for the film magazine "Cahiers du Cinéma," begins production on his feature directorial debut, "Breathless," starring French up-and-coming actor Jean-Paul Belmondo and American starlet Jean Seberg. Those around him are thrown off by Godard's innovative and freewheeling shooting methods, but the set, fueled by a shared passion for filmmaking, is filled with energy. Following the style of "Breathless," the film is shot in black and white in the Academy ratio (1:1.37), almost entirely in French, and the cast, except for Zoey Deutch as Jean Seberg, is made up of mostly unknown actors. Guillaume Marbeck, who worked as a photographer and model, was cast as the protagonist Godard. The film was selected for the Competition section of the 78th Cannes Film Festival in 2025.
title:ネタニヤフ調書 汚職と戦争: A documentary that delves into the corruption allegations against Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. Following the October 7, 2023, attack on Israel by the Islamic fundamentalist organization Hamas, the Israeli military began its assault on the Gaza Strip, leading to the seemingly endless Gaza-Israel conflict with massive loss of life. A key figure in this conflict is Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, a charismatic leader whose hardline political stance is controversial. He is also the first sitting Israeli prime minister to be criminally indicted. In 2017, as the corruption investigation progressed, parts of police interrogation records of Netanyahu and his associates were secretly leaked to the film's production team. These records documented collusion with business and media circles, bribery, and provision of benefits. The film features testimonies from former Israeli Prime Minister Ehud Olmert, a former head of the domestic intelligence agency Shin Bet, Netanyahu's former spokesperson, and prominent investigative journalists. It exposes how corruption led to national decay, and how Netanyahu colluded with far-right forces to maintain his long-term rule and avoid conviction, pushing democracy into crisis. Netanyahu himself sought to stop the film's release and threatened legal action; it was banned from screening in Israel. Alex Gibney, known for 'Taxi to the Dark Side' and 'Enron: The Smartest Guys in the Room,' served as executive producer, and Alexis Bloom, director of 'Anita: Speaking Truth to Power,' directed the film.
title:ノスタルジア（1983）:
The sixth feature film by Russian master Andrei Tarkovsky, shot in Italy. Depicting the journey of a Russian poet who visits Italy to trace the footsteps of a musician who committed suicide, the film captures his travels with overwhelming visual beauty and won the Best Director award, the FIPRESCI Prize, and the Prize of the Ecumenical Jury at the 36th Cannes Film Festival in 1983.

Andrei, a Russian poet following the trail of 18th-century Russian musician Pavel Sosnovsky, arrives in the Tuscany region of Italy accompanied by his interpreter, Eugenia. Andrei is suffering from an illness, and his journey is drawing to a close. One morning, he encounters Domenico, an old man treated as a madman by those around him. Believing in the end of the world, Domenico entrusts Andrei with a single candle, asking him to carry it across a square without letting the flame go out.

In January 2024, to commemorate the 40th anniversary of its original Japanese release, the 4K restored version, "Nostalghia 4K Restoration," was released.
title:ハッピーアワー: Starring four women with no acting experience, this film portrays the anxieties and worries of ordinary women in their late 30s through a tense 317-minute drama. Directed by Ryusuke Hamaguchi, known for challenging works like the 4-hour-plus epic "Intimacies" (using film school students) and the Tohoku documentary trilogy ("The Sound of the Waves," "Voices from the Waves," "Singing in the Dark"), the film won the Best Actress award for its four leads at the 68th Locarno International Film Festival in Switzerland. Akari, Sakurako, Fumi, and Jun, all in their late 30s, thought they were best friends who could tell each other anything. However, it is revealed that Jun had been hiding her year-long divorce negotiations. Shaken by this, the four women take a trip to Arima Onsen for a brief escape and enjoy a fun time together, but...
title:ハッピーアワー(1部: Akari, Sakurako, Fumi, and Jun, now in their late 30s, believed they were close friends who could share anything—until they discovered Jun's secret. Born from a citizen-participation improvisational acting workshop in Kobe, this three-part film features mostly first-time actors and was created through unprecedented methods. It won the Best Actress award at the 68th Locarno Film Festival.
title:ハマーショルド 平和への闘志: Screening at EU Film Days 2026 (Tokyo: May 16–29 at Theater Image Forum, May 19–24 at the National Film Archive; Nagoya: June 6–19 at Nagoya Cinema Neu; also held in Hiroshima, Kyoto, and Fukuoka).
title:ハムネット: A drama by Chloé Zhao, director of "Nomadland," that blends fiction with the tragic love story behind the creation of Shakespeare's classic play "Hamlet." Based on the 2020 novel of the same name by Northern Irish author Maggie O'Farrell, which won the Women's Prize for Fiction and the National Book Critics Circle Award. In a small 16th-century English village, Agnes Shakespeare, who possesses knowledge of herbs and mysterious powers, lives with her three children while her husband William works as a writer in London. Agnes struggles to protect her children during a plague outbreak, but tragedy strikes when her 11-year-old son Hamnet dies, plunging the family into deep grief. Jessie Buckley ("Women Talking") plays Agnes, and Paul Mescal ("Aftersun") plays William, with Emily Watson ("Breaking the Waves") and Joe Alwyn ("The Brutalist") co-starring. Steven Spielberg and Sam Mendes are among the producers. Nominated for eight Academy Awards at the 98th ceremony, including Best Picture, Jessie Buckley won the Best Actress award.
title:ハリー・スミス作品集: Harry Smith (1923–1991) was a singular talent who pioneered the psychedelic era, traversing not only creative fields like painting and film but also American roots music research and cultural anthropology. This program screens *Number 11: Mirror Animations*, an alchemical animation work of freely collaged cut-out materials; *Number 14: Late Superimpositions*, a pioneering superimposed film layering footage of New York butcher shops and the Kiowa people; *Number 15*, featuring close-ups of North American Seminole patchwork; and *Number 19*, restored by Anthology in 2025.
title:ハード・トゥルース: Pansy is constantly irritable and at odds with everyone around her. Through her interactions with her cheerful younger sister and a visit to her mother’s grave, her hidden feelings are laid bare. A human drama that questions the true nature of family and happiness.
title:ハード・トゥルース 母の日に願うこと: British master director Mike Leigh, known for such masterpieces as *Naked*, *Secrets & Lies*, and *Vera Drake*, reunites with *Secrets & Lies* star Marianne Jean-Baptiste for this human drama. Through a protagonist perpetually simmering with irritation and anger, the film explores the essence of humanity, family, and happiness. Pansy lives in London with her plumber husband and their unemployed son in his twenties. Constantly nagging and at odds with her family, she lives in a state of perpetual agitation, frequently clashing with those closest to her. In contrast, Pansy’s sister, Chantelle, possesses a cheerful disposition. A single mother working as a hairdresser, Chantelle lives with her two daughters in a home filled with laughter. One Mother’s Day, after reluctantly agreeing to Chantelle’s suggestion to visit their late mother’s grave, Pansy is forced to confront her own hidden emotions.
title:バカンスは始まったばかり: Satoshi Kimura, director of 'Strange Lovers from Another Planet' and 'The Melancholic After-School of Yoyogi Johnny', takes on the classic French genre of 'vacation film' with this dialogue-driven drama. At the start of summer, Yuka, freshly divorced from Haruki after three years together, visits a seaside town on vacation with her best friend Shina and Shina's boyfriend Dazai. Yuka and Dazai were once in love, and reuniting with him rekindles her feelings. Meanwhile, Shina finds herself drawn to Tenma, a poet living in the seaside town. The film creates '1:1' scenes where characters enter the frame in pairs, unfolding the story through a chain of different combinations. The emotion of 'liking' determines each character's formation, shifting relationships as they cross paths. Yu Imari ('Soirée', 'A Janitor') plays Yuka, Ei Adachi ('If Tokugawa Ieyasu Became Prime Minister') plays Dazai, Yuki Shinho ('YOUNG&FINE') plays Shina, Takeo Yamaguchi ('BADBOYS THE MOVIE') plays Tenma, and Ryo Igarashi ('Before Dawn') plays Haruki.
title:バナ穴 BANA_ANA: The second installment of the omnibus film 'The Bastard and the Beautiful World,' released in 2018 and starring Goro Inagaki, Tsuyoshi Kusanagi, and Shingo Katori of 'New Map.' Directed and written by Kenji Yamauchi, who also participated in the previous film and is known for his work in theater and commercials, as well as directing films like 'I Like My Friend's Dad' and 'Unique Countries of Asia.' In an age where information and answers are instantly available and people try to find meaning in everything, this film invites Inagaki, Kusanagi, and Katori into a story that runs counter to 'meaning,' with the concept of enjoying not knowing things as they are. The cast includes First Summer Uika, who is active not only in variety shows but also in films and taiga dramas; Shuri, who starred in the NHK morning drama 'Boogie Woogie'; and veteran actors such as Kanji Furutachi, Seiyo Uchino, and Mitsuru Fukikoshi.
title:バルタザール〜: The 7th feature film by master director Robert Bresson, known for "L'Argent," "Pickpocket," and "The Trial of Joan of Arc," released in 1966. Inspired by an episode from Dostoevsky's novel "The Idiot," it portrays the strange fate of a donkey and a young girl. In a small Pyrenean village, little Marie names a newborn donkey Balthazar and cherishes him. Ten years later, Balthazar is used for hard labor by a blacksmith but escapes the suffering and returns to Marie. The grown Marie rejoices at their reunion and takes Balthazar with her, but Gérard, who has feelings for her, becomes jealous and torments the donkey. Through the silent perspective of the donkey, the film calmly depicts human folly and ugliness, winning the Special Jury Prize at the Venice International Film Festival and earning acclaim as a masterpiece. Starring Anne Wiazemsky, who later appeared in many Godard films including "La Chinoise," in her film debut. First theatrically released in Japan in 1970, and again in 1995 distributed by France Eigasha. Revived in October 2020 in a 4K restored digital remaster. Also revived in 2026 as part of "Robert Bresson Masterpiece Selection."
title:バルタザールどこへ行く: The 7th feature film by master director Robert Bresson, known for "L'Argent," "Pickpocket," and "The Trial of Joan of Arc," released in 1966. Inspired by an episode from Dostoevsky's novel "The Idiot," it portrays the strange fate of a donkey and a young girl. In a small Pyrenean village, little Marie names a newborn donkey Balthazar and cherishes him. Ten years later, Balthazar is used for hard labor by a blacksmith but escapes the suffering and returns to Marie. The grown Marie rejoices at their reunion and takes Balthazar with her, but Gérard, who has feelings for her, becomes jealous and torments the donkey. Through the silent perspective of the donkey, the film calmly depicts human folly and ugliness, winning the Special Jury Prize at the Venice International Film Festival and earning acclaim as a masterpiece. Starring Anne Wiazemsky, who later appeared in many Godard films including "La Chinoise," in her film debut. First theatrically released in Japan in 1970, and again in 1995 distributed by France Eigasha. Revived in October 2020 in a 4K restored digital remaster. Also revived in 2026 as part of "Robert Bresson Masterpiece Selection."
title:バレンと小刀 時代をつなぐ浮世絵物語: A documentary following the craftsmen at the Adachi Institute of Woodcut Prints, who carry on Edo-period ukiyo-e techniques into the modern era, as they take on a project to transform works by contemporary artists into woodblock prints. Ukiyo-e flourished in the Edo period and greatly influenced Impressionist painters like Van Gogh. Founded in 1928, the Adachi Institute has preserved ukiyo-e print techniques, reproducing classic Edo masterpieces as a publisher and delivering them both domestically and internationally. In recent years, the institute has undertaken a project to create new contemporary ukiyo-e by inviting 38 globally active artists—including Yayoi Kusama, Ayako Rokkaku, Nick Walker, and Antony Gormley—as painters. Over about five years, they produce 86 works, aiming for presentation at the "Ukiyo-e Modern" exhibition at the Tokyo National Museum in spring 2025. The carvers and printers, daunted by worldviews and diverse expressions different from classical ukiyo-e, struggle under the artists' sharp critiques yet, driven by craftsman pride, tenaciously draw out the beauty of the original art, repeatedly experimenting in pursuit of higher heights. Directed by Takako Matsumoto, known for "≒Yayoi Kusama: I Love Me" and "Ice Fireworks: Sayoko Yamaguchi."
title:バレンタイン一揆: Child labor is a serious issue in Ghana, Africa, a region renowned for producing the cocoa used in chocolate. This documentary follows three ordinary young Japanese people who, upon learning the truth, travel to Ghana’s cocoa-growing regions to take action against child labor. University student Kotoko Fujita and high school students Maho Umeda and Arika Shiga met through ACE, an international NGO dedicated to the abolition and prevention of child labor. Visiting Ghana as representatives of the ACE Youth Academy, they witness the harsh reality of children forced to work on cocoa plantations instead of attending school. Moved by their experience, the three organize "Valentine Ikki" (Valentine Uprising), an initiative held on Valentine’s Day—when chocolate consumption is at its peak—to encourage people to choose fair-trade chocolate.
title:バース・デイ劇場版 余命1年のシングルマザー 天才相撲少年への遺言: Birth Day The Movie: Shin with One Year to Live... Watch related works: Minding the Gap, Flee, The Biggest Little Farm, The Act of Killing, Navalny, Citizenfour, Assassins, Documentary of Baby Assassins, The Ghost's Grandson, The Unnameable Dance.
title:パドレ・プロジェクト 父の影を追って: Comedian Takeshi Takeuchi, also known as "Book Samurai," makes his directorial debut with this documentary, which records his personal journey to Italy to find the father he was separated from as a young child. Born to a Japanese mother and a Cameroonian father, Takeuchi grew up in Japan as a "hafu." His parents met and fell in love in Italy but separated when he was two years old, after which his mother returned to Japan to raise him alone. From his mother’s memories, the image of a father with a creative spirit who once aspired to be a film director began to take shape. As if following his father’s shadow, Takeuchi worked in the entertainment world as a comedian, but the 2020 global pandemic made him realize he might never get the chance to meet his father, leading him to resolve to travel to Italy. However, with travel hurdles high under a state of emergency and his mother suffering from dementia, the information he can glean is shockingly sparse. Armed only with a 40-year-old photograph and facing the daunting task of finding his father within a limited 10-day stay, Takeuchi continues his desperate search while confronting his own upbringing...
title:パリから来た殺し屋: A crime suspense film co-produced by France, Italy, and the United States, starring the renowned French actor Jean-Louis Trintignant, known for "A Man and a Woman" and "The Conformist." Lucien, a French hitman, arrives at Los Angeles International Airport. Checking into a Beverly Hills hotel and concealing a pistol, Lucien drives to the upscale residential area where his target, a crime boss, lives. After efficiently eliminating the target, Lucien returns to the hotel only to find that someone has checked him out and his passport and plane ticket are gone. As Lucien becomes paranoid, a hail of bullets suddenly rains down on him from an unknown assassin. Alongside Trintignant as Lucien, the film features a cast of distinctive French, Italian, and American actors including Ann-Margret from "The Hunter" and Roy Scheider from "The French Connection." Directed by Jacques Deray, known for the two "Borsalino" films and "Flic Story." The screenplay is by Jean-Claude Carrière, who worked on numerous masterpieces such as "The Unbearable Lightness of Being" and "The Discreet Charm of the Bourgeoisie." After more than half a century since its production in 1972, it receives its first Japanese release in 2026 in a 4K remastered version.
title:パリに咲くエトワール: Set in early 20th-century Paris, this animated film delicately and vividly portrays the struggles of two Japanese girls pursuing their dreams in a foreign land. In Paris at the turn of the century, two girls who came from Japan live there. One is Fujiko, who dreams of becoming a painter despite being expected to become a good wife supporting her husband. The other is Chizuru, born into a samurai family and a master of the naginata, but drawn to ballet. The two, who met once in Yokohama, reunite after five years when Chizuru helps Fujiko out of trouble. Learning of Chizuru's dream, Fujiko discovers that Olga, the mother of a young man named Ruslan living in the same apartment building, is a former Russian ballerina and arranges lessons for Chizuru. Meanwhile, Fujiko's guardian uncle goes missing. Ami Touma voices the protagonist Fujiko, who dreams of being a painter; Rina Arashi voices Chizuru, who aspires to be a ballerina; and Taichi Saotome voices Ruslan, the young man who meets Fujiko. Directed by Goro Taniguchi of "ONE PIECE FILM RED" and the "Code Geass: Lelouch of the Rebellion" series, with original character designs by Katsuya Kondo, who worked on character design and key animation for Studio Ghibli films like "Kiki's Delivery Service." The screenplay is by Reiko Yoshida of "The Colors Within" and "Violet Evergarden."
title:パリのランデブー: Three stories about love and chance, all centered around a date in Paris.
title:パリタクシー: A human drama about a taxi driver who, while driving an elderly lady preparing for the end of her life, gets swept up in a journey across Paris exploring her past. Charles, a grumpy taxi driver on the verge of losing his license with no money or days off, is in the biggest crisis of his life. Then he agrees to drive 92-year-old Madeleine to the opposite side of Paris. Madeleine, who is preparing for her final affairs, asks Charles to make one detour after another. The streets of Paris where she lived her life hold many secrets, and with each detour, Madeleine's surprising past is revealed. This drive gradually transforms both their lives. Dany Boon plays Charles, and French chanson legend Line Renaud plays Madeleine. The film is directed and written by Christian Carion.
title:パンダのすごい世界:
Nominated for Best Documentary/Educational Film at the 38th Golden Rooster Awards—the most prestigious honor in Chinese cinema.

With their iconic black-and-white markings, round figures, and endearing behavior, giant pandas have captivated hearts worldwide. In Japan, they have been cherished for half a century since their first arrival in 1972.

This documentary takes an intimate look at the life of the panda. Following pandas of various ages living in Sichuan Province, Beijing, and Hong Kong, the film portrays their journey from birth and growth to rewilding training, international cultural exchange, and their twilight years. In addition to revealing little-known aspects of their daily lives, the film explores breeding and conservation efforts, as well as the 8-million-year history of the panda, often referred to as a "living fossil." It is a valuable visual record capturing the unique ecology of these extraordinary creatures.
title:ヒア・アンド・ゼア:
A human drama from up-and-coming Spanish director Antonio Méndez Esparza that realistically portrays family bonds and the underlying sense of loss through the eyes of a father returning home after years of working abroad. Pedro, a Mexican man who has been working in the United States, returns to his home village for the first time in several years. Though bewildered by the emotional distance from his family and the changing ways of the village, he attempts to slowly rebuild his connections with them—but...

Featuring a cast largely composed of actual villagers, the film is told in a unique style where fiction and documentary intersect. The songs in the film were written and performed by Pedro himself. The film won the Grand Prix at the 65th Cannes Film Festival’s Critics' Week in 2012. In Japan, following a screening in the "WORLD CINEMA" section of the 25th Tokyo International Film Festival in 2012, it will receive its first theatrical release in 2025 as part of the special program "The Films of Antonio Méndez Esparza."
title:ヒポクラテスの盲点: A documentary that explores the impact of COVID-19 vaccine aftereffects from a multifaceted perspective. Five years have passed since the government issued the first state of emergency during the spread of the coronavirus, and two years have gone by since its classification under the Infectious Diseases Act was downgraded to Class 5. While national infectious disease measures have evolved through this unprecedented crisis, reports have begun to surface regarding the damage caused by aftereffects of the COVID-19 vaccine (mRNA gene product)—a new technology distinct from conventional vaccines. The approval and distribution of this unprecedented "new drug" encapsulated deep-seated issues within Japanese society: not only medical blind spots and limitations but also data manipulation designed to obscure inconvenient facts, and the anticipatory compliance of academia and the media toward the government. Amidst these circumstances, a group of doctors sought to scientifically investigate the impact of these vaccine aftereffects. By capturing the perspectives of people from diverse backgrounds—including patients, bereaved families, and vaccine proponents of the time—the film aims to unveil the truth based on science and facts.
title:ヒロシマ、モナムール: An actress, once condemned for having an affair with an enemy soldier in a French village under German occupation, visits Hiroshima for a film shoot and indulges in a one-day affair with a Japanese architect. Through this, she learns of Hiroshima's tragedy. The date is August 6th. Against the backdrop of the anti-nuclear movement, their lonely conversation continues. The city, miraculously rebuilt from the ashes, can never forget the shadow of death.
title:ビッグ・リボウスキ: A comedy directed and written by the Coen brothers (Joel and Ethan), who won the Academy Award for Best Original Screenplay for 'Fargo,' about a man mistaken for a millionaire with the same name and caught up in a kidnapping plot. Los Angeles, 1991. The Dude, an unemployed middle-aged man living a carefree, day-to-day existence, is mistaken for millionaire Jeffrey Lebowski and threatened by two thugs for a debt. Angered, the Dude barges into Lebowski's mansion to demand compensation but is turned away. A few days later, summoned by Lebowski, the Dude is asked to deliver the ransom for Lebowski's kidnapped wife, Bunny. The cast features an ensemble of distinctive actors, including Jeff Bridges in the lead role, John Goodman, and Steve Buscemi.
title:ビトゥーカ ミルトン・ナシメント フェアウェルツアー: Called the 'Voice of Brazil,' Milton Nascimento, affectionately known as Bituca, led MPB (Brazilian popular music post-bossa nova) alongside contemporaries Gilberto Gil, Caetano Veloso, and Chico Buarque, and collaborated with countless international musicians. This documentary film traces Milton's life and music while following his global farewell concert tour, announced upon turning 80 in 2022. In the first half, Milton's troupe tours Europe and the Americas, receiving ecstatic welcomes. Pat Metheny, Spike Lee, Quincy Jones, and Wayne Shorter speak about Milton, and there are scenes of collaboration with Esperanza Spalding and Herbie Hancock. Milton reflects on his childhood raised as an adopted son, converses with his own adopted child on the road, and shares memories of his benefactor, singer Elis Regina. The second half begins with the landscapes of Minas Gerais, the highland region of inland Brazil that is Milton's home and musical origin. Friends like Chico, Caetano, and Gil, collaborating poets like Márcio Borges and Ronaldo Bastos, and younger musicians who admire Milton, discuss the appeal and depths of his music. Inescapable negative histories, such as racism and Brazil's 20-year military dictatorship starting in 1964, are also revealed. Then, the farewell concert finale approaches: the concert at Mineirão, the football stadium in Belo Horizonte, the capital of Minas Gerais. Members of Clube da Esquina (Corner Club), the title of a landmark 1972 album and the name for the family of Minas musicians centered around Milton—Lô Borges, Beto Guedes, Wagner Tiso, and Toninho Horta—share behind-the-scenes stories and perform together.
title:ビューティフル・ガールGražuolė / The Beauty: What reality does a girl perceive once she steps out of the world of play? Nine-year-old Inga, who lives with her single mother, is a bright girl with a vivid imagination. In the "games" she plays with her friends, she is always at the center of the circle, dancing and being crowned the "beauty." However, a boy who has just moved into the neighborhood looks at these games with a cold, detached eye and begins to mock her appearance. Deeply hurt, Inga eventually begins to grasp the real world and starts to see her surroundings through a new lens. A masterpiece of Lithuanian cinema by Arūnas Žebriūnas, who left behind many works focused on children, including *The Girl and the Echo* (1964), winner of the Special Jury Prize at the Locarno Film Festival.
title:ビリー・アイドル パンク・ロッカーの反逆と代償: A music documentary depicting the turbulent life of Billy Idol, the British artist who took the 1980s American music scene by storm. After forming the punk band Generation X in 1976 and becoming a key figure in the UK punk movement, Idol moved to the United States alone to launch a solo career following the band’s dissolution in 1981. His 1984 album *Rebel Yell* sold over two million copies and earned a Grammy nomination, and with his 1987 single "Mony Mony" hitting number one in the U.S., he ascended to superstardom as a definitive icon of the MTV era. However, the relentless pace of life at the forefront of the industry took its toll; behind the scenes of his success, he was mentally and physically exhausted, battling alcohol and drug addiction. Featuring candid testimony from Billy Idol himself alongside archival TV and concert footage and interviews with family, friends, and associates, the film reflects on his tumultuous journey. Directed by Jonas Åkerlund (*Lords of Chaos*).
title:ビートルズがいた夏: A documentary set in New York City during the summer of 1965 when the Beatles arrived, depicting the city and its people from diverse perspectives. On August 13, 1965, the four Beatles landed in New York to perform the first stadium concert in music history. While hordes of ecstatic fans raced through the streets of Manhattan to catch a glimpse of them, a world's fair full of optimistic futures was taking place right next to the concert venue, Shea Stadium, and large-scale race riots were erupting on the West Coast. Jeffrey, a 17-year-old aspiring writer and son of the radio DJ who first played Beatles songs in New York, meets a girl who loves the Beatles and spends a few days of that summer with her. Directed by Romanian master Andrei Ujică, known for "The Autobiography of Nicolae Ceaușescu," who spent over a decade making this film. Composed of archival footage from news programs and personal 8mm films, it incorporates animation by French artist Yan Kébé, personal writings from protagonist poet Jeffrey O'Brien and Judith Christen (the model for the heroine), and voiceover using a poem Ujică himself wrote in 1972, imaginatively reviving fleeting, unforgettable moments that would otherwise fade from history.
title:ピザ 死霊館へのデリバリー: A featured film of "Indian Movie Week 2022 Part 1" (starting June 10, 2022, at Kinéka Omori and other theaters).
title:ファミリー・セラピー: Screening at EU Film Days 2026 (Tokyo: May 16–29, 2026 at Theater Image Forum, May 19–24 at National Film Archive; Nagoya: June 6–19 at Nagoya Cinema Neu; also held in Hiroshima, Kyoto, and Fukuoka).
title:ファンファーレ！: Conductor Thibaut is diagnosed with leukemia. While searching for a donor, he discovers the existence of a long-lost brother and recognizes his extraordinary talent. A moving human drama where a miraculous performance inspires deep emotion.
title:ファーゴ: An unconventional crime suspense film by the Coen Brothers, laced with black humor. In snow-covered Fargo, Minnesota, car salesman Jerry, drowning in debt, plots to have his wife Jean kidnapped to extort a ransom from her wealthy father. But when the two hired kidnappers shoot a police officer and a witness, the case spirals out of control. Winner of multiple film awards, including the Academy Awards for Best Original Screenplay and Best Actress.

title:フォー・トレイルズ 限界を超えてゆけ: A surprise smash hit that ranked in Hong Kong's box office top ten for eight weeks! Highly praised by Chow Yun-fat ("A Better Tomorrow" series)! An unimaginably grueling drama about runners! The Hong Kong Four Trails Ultra Challenge, commonly known as HK4TUC, requires runners to consecutively complete four trail courses in Hong Kong and reach the finish line within a time limit of 72 hours (3 days). The total course length is 298 km, comparable to the distance between Tokyo and Nagoya, with a cumulative elevation gain of 14,500 m, equivalent to seven full marathons or two ascents of Mount Everest. Furthermore, runners must procure their own water and food from shops along the way, and strict rules prohibit the use of poles (advantageous on undulating mountain paths) and portable music players, making it an event of extreme physical and mental hardship. This film captures 18 runners competing in the HK4TUC as they push their limits, set against the beautiful natural landscapes of Hong Kong rarely seen before.
title:フォー・トレイルズ 限界を超えてゆけ: The Hong Kong Four Trails Ultra Challenge, commonly known as HK4TUC, requires runners to consecutively complete four trail courses in Hong Kong and reach the finish line within a time limit of 72 hours (3 days). The total course length is 298 km, comparable to the distance between Tokyo and Nagoya, with a cumulative elevation gain of 14,500 m, equivalent to seven full marathons or two ascents of Mount Everest. Furthermore, participants must procure their own water and food from shops along the way, and strict rules prohibit the use of poles or portable music players, which would be advantageous on the undulating mountain paths. It is an event of extreme physical and mental challenge. This film captures 18 runners who took on the HK4TUC pushing their limits, set against the beautiful natural landscapes of Hong Kong, rarely seen before. The director is Robin Lee, a British director born and raised in Hong Kong. The film began a limited release in Hong Kong at the end of 2024, but word-of-mouth spread rapidly and the number of screens increased sharply. It gained further attention when the major star Chow Yun-fat, known for the 'A Better Tomorrow' series and 'Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon', highly praised it, saying 'every Hong Kong person should watch it'. Supported not only by sports enthusiasts but also by general film fans, it became the biggest surprise hit of 2025, attracting 150,000 viewers. Additionally, it has won numerous awards, including the Best New Director Award at the 43rd Hong Kong Film Awards, the Audience Award at the 22nd Hong Kong Asian Film Festival, the Recommended Film Award at the 31st Hong Kong Film Critics Society Awards, and the Jury Special Award at the 2025 Hong Kong Directors' Guild Awards, earning high praise as a documentary.
title:フジコ・ヘミング 永遠の音色【三回忌追悼上映】: Fuzjko Hemming passed away on April 21, 2024, at the age of 92. Renowned as the "Pianist of the Soul," she captured the hearts of audiences worldwide with her deeply emotive performances. This film offers the ultimate big-screen experience of Fuzjko’s artistry, featuring her breathtaking rendition of "La Campanella," numerous classical masterpieces, and original works by contemporary composers—including previously unreleased footage. What new truths will emerge from her interview clips, illustrated diaries, and the testimonies of her family, including her brother Wolf and half-sister Eva, whose existence is revealed in this work? Having overcome immense hardships to finally achieve recognition and become a beloved pianist in her 60s, her tumultuous yet brilliant life continues to inspire courage in us all. The film is narrated by actress Miho Kanno.
title:フジコ・ヘミング 永遠の音色:
A documentary about the world-renowned pianist Fuzjko Hemming, who passed away in April 2024 at the age of 92. Capturing the hearts of audiences both in Japan and abroad with her emotional and dynamic performances, she was known as the "Pianist of the Soul." Director Soichiro Komatsu, who has documented her life for 12 years—including in the 2018 film *Fuzjko Hemming: A Pianist of Silence & Solitude*—delves into her true character, portraying her soul-stirring music and way of life. 

The film features performance scenes including her breathtaking "La Campanella," numerous classical masterpieces, and rare original compositions, some of which are being premiered for the first time. It also includes interview footage of Fuzjko herself, her illustrated diaries, and testimonies from her actor brother Wolf and her half-sister Eva, whose existence is revealed in this film. The documentary looks back on her turbulent life: overcoming the childhood separation from her Swedish father, her mother’s rigorous lessons, the hardships of being stateless, a life of poverty while studying abroad, unforgettable love, and the loss of her hearing, before finally gaining recognition and becoming a beloved pianist in her 60s. Narration is provided by Miho Kanno, who portrayed Fuzjko in the 2003 special drama *The Trajectory of Fuzjko Hemming* and was a close personal friend.
title:フランキー・フリーコ: From Steven Kostanski, the mad genius director of "Psycho Goreman" (2020) and member of Canada's notorious effects collective Astron-6, who has contributed special effects to Hollywood blockbusters like "Resident Evil: Retribution" (2012) and "Pacific Rim" (2013). His two latest films, "Frankie Freako" and "Deathstalker," will be released sequentially in Japan starting July 3rd at Cinemart Shinjuku and other theaters nationwide. Kostanski, who wrote and directed both films, is known for his unique creature designs reminiscent of classics like "E.T." (1982), "Gremlins" (1984), and "The Goonies" (1985), blending 80s-style monster panic with absurdist black humor, creating a devoted fanbase. These new films bring his signature style to Japan. "Frankie Freako" is a monster freak comedy that extensively uses unique puppets to achieve a visual style straight out of a comic book, bursting with Kostanski's unique worldview. The cast includes fellow Astron-6 members Conor Sweeney and Adam Brooks. Synopsis: Connor, a workaholic, has a dilemma: he is respected by neither his boss, his colleagues, nor his wife. One night, he sees a commercial on a shady late-night show for a party hosted by Frankie Freako and impulsively calls the number. Suddenly, a goblin-like creature named Frankie and his troublesome friends invade his home, trashing the place. Connor struggles to stop Frankie and the rampaging monsters. However, this chaos unexpectedly leads him on a journey of self-discovery.
title:フレデリック・ワイズマン監督 緊急追悼上映: The monumental work of documentary master Wiseman, who passed away on February 16, 2026, now.
title:ブゴニア: The eccentric genius Yorgos Lanthimos, known for 'Poor Things' and 'The Favourite', directs this kidnapping suspense film starring Emma Stone in their fifth collaboration. Ari Aster, director of 'Welcome to Eddington' and 'Midsommar', serves as producer. It is a remake of the 2003 Korean film 'Save the Green Planet!'. Michelle, the charismatic CEO of a globally renowned pharmaceutical company, is kidnapped by Teddy, a conspiracy theorist who firmly believes she is an alien set on invading Earth, and his devoted cousin Don. They imprison her in a basement and demand she abandon her plans for Earth. Michelle dismisses their absurd demands and tries to talk her way out, but the tug-of-war takes unexpected turns. As Teddy's hidden past comes to light, the absurd kidnapping plot veers in unforeseen directions. Emma Stone appears with a shaved head, passionately playing Michelle. Jesse Plemons and newcomer Aiden Delvis, cast through auditions, play the two kidnappers. The film was presented in the competition section of the 82nd Venice International Film Festival in 2025 and was nominated for four Academy Awards at the 98th ceremony, including Best Picture and Best Actress.
title:ブドイと弟: The rural countryside of Zamboanguita, a town at the southern tip of Negros Island in the Philippines. Budoy is a young boy born and raised amidst the timeless landscapes of Asia. He has been eagerly looking forward to attending the annual festival with his family tomorrow. However, because both of his parents must work in the rice fields, he is instead ordered to stay home and look after his younger brother.
title:ブリング・ハー・バック: After their father dies, brother Andy and his visually impaired sister Piper come to live with foster mother Laura. Also living there is a boy named Oliver who does not speak. Andy feels uneasy about Laura's seemingly excessive affection, but a new life for the siblings begins under her care. From a certain day onward, unsettling events begin to occur one after another in the house. Furthermore, there are mysterious circular motifs scattered around the house, and the presence of Oliver. When these seemingly unrelated elements all connect, Laura's hidden 'terrifying wish' is revealed.

title:ブルームーン: From director Richard Linklater, known for the 'Before' trilogy beginning with 'Before Sunrise' and the six-time Oscar-nominated 'Boyhood,' this conversation piece stars his longtime collaborator Ethan Hawke and depicts a night spent at a party attended by legendary Broadway lyricist Lorenz Hart. On the evening of March 31, 1943, the night of the premiere of the musical 'Oklahoma!,' created by his longtime composing partner Richard Rodgers with a new collaborator, Lorenz Hart—the lyricist behind hits like 'The Lady Is a Tramp' and 'My Funny Valentine'—was invited to a party at the Broadway restaurant Sardi's. Over the course of that night, Hart confronts his own swirling emotions of love, jealousy, anxiety, and longing. Ethan Hawke plays Lorenz Hart, alongside Margaret Qualley as Elizabeth, the woman Hart pines for; Andrew Scott as his former partner Richard Rodgers; and Bobby Cannavale as Eddie, the bartender Hart trusts as a confidant. The film was screened in the competition section of the 75th Berlin International Film Festival in 2025, where Andrew Scott won the Silver Bear for Best Supporting Actor. It was nominated for Best Original Screenplay and Best Actor (Ethan Hawke) at the 98th Academy Awards.
title:ブーニン: Winner of the Chopin Competition at age 19, Stanislav Bunin was a genius who ignited a global frenzy. This documentary portrays the vista he reached after a journey of anguish and conflict, following a series of debilitating illnesses and injuries.
title:ブーニン 天才ピアニストの沈黙と再生: Featuring a complete recording of his latest performance at Suntory Hall in December 2025, this music documentary offers a supreme musical experience while delving deep into the inner world of Stanislav Bunin. Interweaving the bond with his wife, Eiko, who walked the path to his comeback by his side, and testimonies from renowned pianists who hold him in the highest esteem, the production team—who followed his journey of rebirth through intimate, long-term coverage—depicts the vista the genius pianist finally reached after a period of suffering and struggle. Including a selection of masterpieces handpicked by Bunin himself, the film invites you to experience his exquisite artistry on the big screen as he shares his heartfelt wish: "I want to give beautiful performances that move people."

In 1985, at the age of 19, he won the International Chopin Piano Competition, igniting a whirlwind of fervor with his breathtaking performance. Then, in 2013, he suddenly vanished from the spotlight.

Beset by illness, injury, paralysis of the left hand, and major surgery—trials that threatened his very life as a pianist—he has overcome years of suffering and inner conflict to return to the stage once more. This music documentary captures his latest performance at Suntory Hall in December 2025 in its entirety, delving deep into Stanislav Bunin’s inner world while offering a transcendent musical experience.

Interweaving the bond with his wife, Eiko, who walked the path to recovery alongside him, and testimonies from renowned pianists who hold him in the highest esteem, the production team—who followed his journey of rebirth with intimate access—paints a portrait of the vista this genius has finally reached after his long struggle. Featuring a selection of masterpieces handpicked by Bunin himself, we invite you to experience his exquisite artistry on the big screen as he pursues his simple wish: "I want to give beautiful performances that move people."
title:プシュパ 覚醒: A massive Indian blockbuster depicting the turbulent life of a man who rises through the ranks of the high-end timber smuggling trade and the fierce conflicts that erupt along the way. Pushpa, a young man working for a syndicate smuggling red sandalwood—a rare wood native only to South India—lives a life of poverty, oppressed by his half-brothers and forbidden from using a surname due to his status as the son of a concubine. Vowing to one day make a name for himself, Pushpa manages to outsmart the police and successfully transport red sandalwood worth hundreds of millions of rupees. His feat earns him the respect of the three Reddy brothers who lead the organization, and he is promoted to become the right-hand man of the eldest brother, Konda Reddy. Having finally acquired wealth, Pushpa decides to marry Srivalli, the woman he loves. However, his jealous half-brothers interfere, exposing the truth of his birth to his fiancée’s family. Directed by Sukumar (*Rangasthalam*) and starring Allu Arjun (*Ala Vaikunthapurramuloo*). The film was originally released in Japanese theaters in October 2023 as part of the "Hot Wind!! The World of South Indian Cinema" special screening lineup. With the sequel *Pushpa 2: The Rule* set for a January 2026 release, this film will return to theaters for a limited one-week revival screening.
title:プッシャー: Frank, a highly skilled drug pusher, makes money with his partner Tony by carrying out jobs for drug kingpin Milo. After taking a huge loan from Milo for a large deal, a police raid causes the deal to fail, and Frank loses the money, facing relentless pressure from his boss to repay the debt. A crime action drama that depicts a man spiraling into a hellish debt trap in the underworld of rampant drug trafficking, pushed to his absolute limits, all rendered in dark, stylish visuals. This is Nicolas Winding Refn's landmark debut film, hailed as the Danish film that first achieved worldwide success as a gangster movie.

title:プラダを着た悪魔2: A sequel to the 2006 hit film "The Devil Wears Prada," based on the bestselling novel of the same name by American author Lauren Weisberger, set 20 years later. Miranda rules the fashion world as the charismatic editor-in-chief of New York's top fashion magazine "Runway." Andrea, who was once hired as her assistant and endured grueling days under her strict perfectionism, now works as a news reporter. One day, learning that Miranda and her right-hand man Nigel are facing a crisis, Andrea returns to "Runway" as a features editor. She also reunites with her former assistant colleague Emily, who has become an executive at a luxury brand and holds the key to "Runway's" survival. As their dreams and ambitions clash, events take an unexpected turn. The cast reunites from the previous film, including Meryl Streep as Miranda, Anne Hathaway as Andrea, Emily Blunt as Emily, and Stanley Tucci as Nigel. David Frankel returns as director, and Aline Brosh McKenna as screenwriter.

title:プラハの春: 1960s Czechoslovakia. In the midst of the "Prague Spring," Soviet forces invade. They seize the radio station, but... A drama based on the true story of radio staff who risked their lives to continue broadcasting.
title:プリズン・サークル: This documentary was completed after six years of negotiating for filming permission and two years of unprecedented access inside a Japanese prison. The film focuses on the Shimane Asahi Rehabilitation Program Center, a modern public-private partnership facility and the only prison in Japan to implement the "TC (Therapeutic Community)" program—a system that encourages rehabilitation by exploring the root causes of crime through dialogue between inmates. Through this program, the inmates must confront not only their crimes—including theft, fraud, robbery causing injury, and manslaughter—but also the painful memories of their youth, such as poverty, bullying, abuse, and discrimination. The camera follows four young men as they serve their sentences, depicting their journey toward adopting new values and a different way of life through the TC. The film is directed by Kaori Sakagami, who has previously explored the lives of American inmates in works such as "Lifers" and "Talk Back Out Loud."
title:プリティ・クレイジー 悪魔が引っ越してきた（字幕）: A romantic comedy from director Lee Sang-geun, who previously scored a massive hit in Korea with 'EXIT' and reunites with Im Yoon-ah. It follows a woman possessed by a demon who shows completely different faces by day and night, and the kind-hearted young man who falls for her. On leave from work, Gil-gu falls in love at first sight with Seon-ji, a baker who moves in downstairs. But when he encounters her late that night, she is entirely different. Her father Jang-su explains that Seon-ji is gentle and bright by day, but at 2 AM a demon awakens, transforming her. Gil-gu agrees to Jang-su's odd request to watch over Seon-ji at night. She drags him out every night, running wild and selfishly bossing him around. Im Yoon-ah, a Girls' Generation member known for films like 'EXIT' and drama 'The King's Chef', plays Seon-ji. Ahn Bo-hyun, from the drama 'Spring Fever', plays Gil-gu. Song Dong-il, known for the 'Reply' series, plays Seon-ji's protective father Jang-su.

title:プロジェクト・ヘイル・メアリー: A film adaptation of the bestselling science fiction novel by Andy Weir, author of "The Martian" (the basis for the Oscar-nominated "The Martian"). It depicts a middle school science teacher entrusted with the fate of Earth on the brink of extinction, who encounters an unknown life form with the same purpose at the edge of the universe, and together they risk their lives to save their home planets. An unexplained anomaly occurs where the sun's energy is being drained. If this continues, Earth will freeze and humanity will perish. It is discovered that the same phenomenon is happening not only to the sun but to countless stars scattered across the universe, and a single intact star is found 11.9 light-years away. Humanity's only remaining option is to travel to that star in a spaceship and solve the mystery to save the sun and humanity. Sent into space for this "Hail Mary" project is Grace, a brilliant scientist who left academia and now works as a humble middle school teacher. Alone in the vastness of space far from Earth, he relies on his scientific knowledge to tackle the mission, where he meets Rocky, an alien also struggling to save his home planet. Despite their different forms and languages, the two use science as a common language to face challenges, developing a friendship along the way. Ryan Gosling of "La La Land" and "Barbie" plays the protagonist middle school teacher Grace, with Sandra Hüller of "Anatomy of a Fall" and "The Zone of Interest" co-starring. Drew Goddard, who also worked on "The Martian," wrote the screenplay, and Phil Lord & Christopher Miller, known for producing and writing the "Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse" series, directed.
title:ヘブンズベル:
A suspense-action film from director Kyoji Kamui, who continues to define a hard-boiled worldview in works like "Moonlight Diner" and "7WAYS." Triggered by a family massacre 20 years ago, the story depicts the intersecting fates of those seeking the lost truth within a lawless zone known as "Area 4."

Natsumi was only ten years old when she survived the massacre two decades prior. Aside from her, the only other survivor was a "third man" whose existence was officially erased, while the two perpetrators met mysterious deaths. Twenty years later, the adult Natsumi receives a photograph from an anonymous sender. Guided by clues written on the back, she heads to the extraterritorial city of Area 4. Meanwhile, Rinka, a woman working for a dark organization, is tasked with collecting slush funds using hired convicts. However, she is betrayed by the organization and finds herself marked for death. Rescued by escaped prisoners Yabuki and Fujikawa, Rinka enters Area 4—the site of the transaction—to launder the stolen cash.

The film stars Chiaki Hiratsuka, a regular in Kamui’s films since "Smoky and Bitter." She is joined by fellow regular Miko Nakagawa and Kazunari Moriwaki (formerly of the duo "Saruganseki"). Furthermore, reflecting Director Kamui’s own history of appearing in special effects (tokusatsu) dramas, the cast features a lineup of genre veterans, including Shiro Izumi (Kyoryu Sentai Zyuranger), Yasuhiro Ishiwata (Choushinsei Flashman), Matsuri Kamizato (Ohsama Sentai King-Ohger), Eri Tanaka (Kamen Rider Kuuga), and suit actors Kazutoshi Yokoyama and Ryoko Gomi.
title:ベイビー・ブローカー: A road movie that won two awards at the 75th Cannes Film Festival, featuring a Korean production team and cast. Two male brokers who kidnap an infant from a 'baby hatch' and the mother who once abandoned her child. Bound by a strange sense of solidarity, they journey to find adoptive parents, quietly pursued by two female detectives. This film returns to Kore-eda's signature theme of 'quasi-family,' depicting certain hope beyond the moral dilemmas surrounding the salvation of unwanted lives.
title:ペリカン・ブルー 自由への切符（チケット）: An animated film that visualizes an astonishing true story from 1990s Hungary in Eastern Europe, incorporating documentary materials. In 1990s Hungary, after the fall of the Iron Curtain opened the door to Western Europe, foreign travel was liberalized, and many people turned their eyes to the outside world. However, international train tickets were expensive and out of reach for ordinary people. Amidst this, three young men—intellectual Akos, fearless Pecha, and swimming enthusiast Laci—find a way to forge tickets. They dissolve the blue carbon ink "Pelikan Blue" from the company Pelikan, used on the tickets, with household detergent and rewrite the destinations. After enjoying overseas trips with forged tickets, they decide to distribute "tickets to freedom" to other young people in similar situations. The plan seems to go smoothly, but eventually, a police investigation begins, escalating into a major uproar that shakes the nation. Directed by László Csáki, known for his distinctive animation style, who conducted meticulous research over ten years and blends documentary materials like archival footage and interview audio with hand-drawn animation.
title:ホッテントットエプロン-スケッチ: An unconventional fantasy directed by Kei Shichiri, known for "Sleeping Princess" and "Marriage Ring." It follows a girl's inner journey through fantastical imagery, completely devoid of dialogue. Rika is a girl with an ugly birthmark in a hidden place. One day, she sees a piper in a mouse-colored hood and, drawn by his melody, wanders into a mysterious world. The heroine is played by Yuko Akune from "Heart and Body." The music is composed by Hidetoshi Wabi, who has long collaborated with director Shichiri.
title:ボタニスト 植物を愛する少年:
Set in a remote village in the Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region, this drama chronicles the coming-of-age of a boy who converses with plants, told through a lens of poetic visual beauty. In a small village nestled in the grasslands of northern Xinjiang, Arsin, a Kazakh boy living with his grandmother, spends his days observing and documenting plant life, earning him the nickname "The Botanist." For him, plants are more than just nature; they represent a worldview passed down by his missing uncle. One day, a Han Chinese girl named Meiyu arrives in the village. Her bright, free-spirited presence brings change to Arsin’s quiet life, but when she eventually leaves for Shanghai, Arsin is forced to confront his solitude once again. As reality and fantasy begin to blur, Arsin gradually discovers what it is he has truly been searching for.

Director Jin Yi, a native of Xinjiang, makes his feature debut with this film, drawing on his own childhood memories to create a unique cinematic world infused with magical realism. The cast features non-professional actors, including Yesul Jasere as Arsin, while the score was composed by the internationally acclaimed Iranian composer Peyman Yazdanian. The film was awarded the Grand Prix of the International Jury in the Generation Kplus competition at the 75th Berlin International Film Festival in 2025.
title:ボーイズ・ゴー・トゥ・ジュピター:
Acclaimed by media worldwide! "A memorable masterpiece," "A wonderfully chaotic experience."

Set in Florida as the end of the year approaches, Billy is a teenage high school dropout who spends his days chatting with friends or working a food delivery gig. This is the story of his desperate struggle to earn $5,000 and change his life. From encounters with strange creatures to being tossed about by suspicious rumors surrounding a famous corporation, Billy is forced to make difficult choices regarding love, friendship, and money amidst a series of completely unpredictable twists and turns.
title:ボーイ・ミーツ・ガール: The feature debut of French maverick Leos Carax, released in 1983. It depicts the encounter of two lonely souls wandering through the Paris night in beautiful black-and-white imagery, winning the Youth Prize at the 37th Cannes Film Festival and generating buzz at festivals worldwide. Alex, a young man whose best friend stole his girlfriend, has a fateful encounter with Mireille, a woman who just fought with her lover. Alex falls in love with Mireille at first sight, but they soon meet with an unexpected tragedy. The roles of Alex and Mireille were played by then-newcomers Denis Lavant and Mireille Perrier. The protagonist Alex, played by Lavant, later reappeared in transformed forms in 'Bad Blood' and 'The Lovers on the Bridge', forming what is known as the 'Alex Trilogy' along with this film. Jean-Yves Escoffier handled the cinematography and continued as cinematographer for the subsequent two films. In Japan, it was first theatrically released in July 1988, following the release of 'Bad Blood' in February of the same year. A 4K restored version was re-released in January 2026.

title:ポーラX: The fourth feature film by French wunderkind Leos Carax, released eight years after 'The Lovers on the Bridge.' An adaptation of the novel 'Pierre' by 19th-century American author Herman Melville, written the year after his masterpiece 'Moby-Dick.' Shifting the setting to modern-day Paris, it uses emotional imagery and sound to depict the intense, racing love of a man and woman swept up by fate and drawn into despair. Pierre, a young novelist living in a Norman castle, enjoys a wealthy, contented rural life with his mother Marie and fiancée Lucie. One day, Isabelle, a Bosnian refugee claiming to be Pierre's half-sister, appears. Drawn to Isabelle's charm, Pierre abandons everything and heads to Paris with her. Guillaume Depardieu, son of Gérard Depardieu, passionately plays Pierre, and Katerina Golubeva, known for 'Paris at Night,' plays Isabelle. Catherine Deneuve co-stars as Pierre's mother Marie. Cinematography is by Éric Gautier, known for 'My King,' and music is by singer-songwriter Scott Walker. A 4K restored version will be re-released in February 2026.
title:ポール・マッカートニー：マン・オン・ザ・ラン:
For the one-day-only global theatrical release on February 19, it has been confirmed that an exclusive special conversation between Paul McCartney and director Morgan Neville will be shown as a theater-exclusive bonus! Experience this rare music documentary, featuring many of Paul McCartney and Wings' most iconic songs, on the big screen.

After the breakup of the Beatles, the most important rock band in history, what path did Paul McCartney choose?

*Paul McCartney: Man on the Run* is the latest documentary that traces Paul McCartney’s journey as he forged a new path by forming Wings with his wife Linda following the dissolution of the Beatles, told from an unprecedentedly personal and intimate perspective. Academy, Emmy, and Grammy Award-winning director Morgan Neville meticulously follows the trajectory of Paul’s creative rebirth—producing works that would define a new decade while facing numerous challenges and conflicts—to reveal sides of his story that have never been told before.
title:マイ・ブラザーズ・ウェディング: A director's cut, completed in 2007 through re-editing, of Charles Burnett's second feature film from 1983. Burnett, an influential figure in American independent cinema who consistently depicts the daily lives and humanity of African Americans, presents a tragicomedy of a working-class young man torn between family, friendship, and identity. It quietly reveals class differences within the Black community, psychological gaps between generations, and the frustration of young people left behind by social success, all from the gaps in everyday life. Pierce, a 30-year-old helping his parents run their dry-cleaning shop, drifts aimlessly through his days with no clear future. His childhood friends are either in prison or already dead. When his brother, a lawyer, marries a woman from a wealthy family, Pierce's discomfort and feelings of inferiority grow. Around this time, Pierce reunites with his best friend Soldier, just released from prison, and finds himself caught between his sense of duty to his family and his loyalty to his friend, forced to make a choice. In Japan, this 4K restored version will have its theatrical premiere at the special screening series 'Charles Burnett: Everyday Blues' (from February 7, 2026, at Theater Image Forum).
title:マジカル・シークレット・ツアー: A crime drama about three women who have drifted through life, who deepen their bond through gold smuggling and reclaim their respective lives. Director Chihiro Amano ("Mrs. Noisy") was inspired by a real 2017 incident in which housewives were arrested for gold smuggling at Chubu Centrair International Airport. She co-wrote the original script with Madoka Kumagai, with whom she also worked on "Sato-san and Sato-san." Large-scale location shooting was conducted in Singapore, depicting the glamorous yet perilous journey of gold smuggling. Wakako, a mother of two living a peaceful life, learns that her husband has been fired from his company for embezzlement. To pay off her husband's debts, she becomes involved in gold smuggling in Singapore, where she meets Kiyoe, a non-regular researcher struggling with student loan repayments, and Mayu, an unmarried pregnant woman with zero savings. After successfully smuggling gold and getting a taste for it, the three decide to start smuggling on their own. For the first time, they gain money, freedom, and the joy of living authentically, spending a magical time together—but... Kasumi Arimura plays Wakako, the mother of two who learns of her husband's embezzlement; Haru Kuroki plays Kiyoe, the indebted researcher; Sara Minami plays Mayu, the unmarried pregnant woman; Akihisa Shiono plays Wakako's husband Takashi; Yuzu Aoki plays Kiyoe's colleague Shiina; and Takumi Saito plays Takashi's boss Tanoue.
title:マジンガーZ 対 暗黒大将軍: A theatrical version of the TV anime "Mazinger Z," featuring a piloted giant robot as the protagonist. Director Nobutaka Nishizawa heightened the drama by entrusting the robot with the protagonist's worries and pain, depicting the invincible Mazinger Z fighting while battered and broken. The surprise appearance of the successor Great Mazinger, ahead of the TV series, astonished children. "Mazinger Z" achieved strong revenue from merchandise licensing, sparking a trend of incorporating merchandising into projects from the planning stage onward.
