title:マスター 先生が来る！: Starring Indian superstar Vijay, known for "Bigil" and "Jilla," this action drama follows an unconventional teacher who confronts a ruthless gang to reform delinquent youths. JD, a professor at a prestigious university, is popular among his students for his toughness and proactive nature. However, after a riot breaks out during a student union election he advocated for, he is forced to take responsibility and resign. JD then takes up a new post at a juvenile detention center in a provincial town, only to find the facility controlled by a local gangster named Bhavani, creating a wretched environment where the boys are mired in crime and violence. JD stands up to fight for the boys' reformation. Vijay stars as JD, with acclaimed actor Vijay Sethupathi playing the role of Bhavani. The film is directed by Lokesh Kanagaraj, the director of "Kaithi."
title:マスターズ・オブ・ユニバース: A new live-action film adaptation of the popular "Masters of the Universe" series, based on the action figures created by Mattel in 1981, which have been expanded across comics, animation, and other media, and previously adapted into the 1987 live-action film "Masters of the Universe" starring Dolph Lundgren. Prince Adam of the planet Eternia is sent to Earth as a child to protect him from war, and grows up hiding his identity. Fifteen years later, guided by the legendary Power Sword he accidentally discovers, he returns to his homeworld and learns that Eternia is under the control of his archenemy Skeletor. To save Eternia and its people, Adam transforms into the warrior He-Man and plunges into a deadly battle against the forces of evil. Directed by Travis Knight ("Bumblebee", "Kubo and the Two Strings"), with a screenplay by Chris Butler ("Missing Link"). Nicholas Galitzine, who has gained attention for roles in "Red, White & Royal Blue" and "The Idea of You", plays the lead role of Adam/He-Man. Camila Mendes ("The Revenge Swap", "Upgraded") plays the warrior Teela, who fights alongside He-Man; Jared Leto ("Tron: Ares") plays the villain Skeletor; and Idris Elba plays Man-At-Arms, a father figure to He-Man, in a star-studded cast.
title:マダム・ソワ・セヴェンヌ: This documentary captures the revival in Japan of "Cévennes," the legendary Rococo-era silk said to have been loved by Marie Antoinette, after 300 years. Renowned as the world’s most beautiful silk, Cévennes is characterized by a divine whiteness, a rich luster, and a nature that is both light and strong. To carry its tradition and techniques into the future, the film spent three years documenting the efforts of Japanese and French sericulturists, silk reelers, weavers, dyers, researchers, and global fashion houses at the forefront of the silk industry. While exploring the current state of Japanese sericulture—once the highest quality in the world—and incorporating international perspectives, the film vividly portrays the artisans' handiwork and the brilliant colors achieved through natural dyes. The film is directed by Koichi Sato ("The Red Dye Maker," "The Best Cinema in the World"). Narration is provided by Kabuki actor and Living National Treasure Bando Tamasaburo, who possesses deep knowledge of Nishijin-ori and Tango Chirimen.
title:マテリアリスト 結婚の条件: A love story directed and written by Celine Song of 'Past Lives,' set in the modern marriage market, depicting a love triangle with beautiful imagery. Lucy, a matchmaker at a New York dating agency, is a professional at matching clients' high ideals and detailed conditions, and a materialist who judges love not only by emotion but also by asset value. Leading a busy, work-focused life, she receives a passionate approach from Harry, a wealthy investor she meets at the wedding of a couple she matched. Meanwhile, at the same reception, Lucy reunites with her ex-boyfriend John, who was working as a waiter. They had loved each other, but she couldn't endure the poor life with John, who was drifting between part-time jobs while pursuing his dream of becoming an actor. Lucy begins a relationship with Harry, who is perfect in family background, personality, and education, but her feelings for John, who hasn't given up on his dream, are rekindled. When a client gets involved in an incident, Lucy finds herself at a crossroads in both work and love. Dakota Johnson of the 'Fifty Shades' series plays protagonist Lucy, Chris Evans of the 'Captain America' series plays struggling actor John, and Pedro Pascal of 'Welcome to Eddington' plays investor Harry.

title:マリアの沈黙: Screening at EU Film Days 2026 (Tokyo: May 16–29 at Theater Image Forum, May 19–24 at the National Film Archive of Japan; Nagoya: June 6–19 at Nagoya Cinema Neu; also held in Hiroshima, Kyoto, and Fukuoka).
title:マリー・メンケン／マージョリー・ケラー作品集: Marie Menken (1910–1970) was a key figure of the New York underground who exerted a profound influence on the style of Jonas Mekas. Marjorie Keller (1950–1994) was described by film critic J. Hoberman as "the avant-garde’s most selfless champion." This program features a collection of their short films, which, after years of limited visibility, have been brought back to life through restoration by the Anthology Film Archives.
title:マルグリット・デュラスのアガタ: French writer Marguerite Duras, known for 'The Lover,' adapts her own book 'The Malady of Death / Agatha' into a film. Set in a dilapidated seaside hotel, this experimental work depicts the forbidden love between a brother and sister through lyrical imagery and Duras's own narration. Agatha, reuniting with her brother after eight months at the winter seaside villa Villa Agatha, decides to leave the next morning and part from him forever. The two reminisce about their forbidden love. The brother is played by Yann Andréa, Duras's lover who was 38 years her junior. In Japan, the film had its first theatrical release in 2003, 23 years after its 1981 release. It was re-released in 2012.
title:マルジェラが語る“マルタン・マルジェラ”【再上映】: Martin Margiela is a designer who has constantly challenged the aesthetic values of the era and continued to deconstruct the very concept of clothing. Throughout his career, he never appeared in public, refused all interviews and photographs, and maintained a steadfast anonymity. Director Reiner Holzemer (*Dries Van Noten: Dog, Flowers and Fabric*) won the trust of the seemingly impenetrable Margiela. Under the condition that it was "only for this documentary," Margiela reveals private records for the first time—including drawings, extensive notes, and Barbie doll clothes he made at the age of seven. From the influence of his dressmaker grandmother and his time as Jean-Paul Gaultier’s assistant to the birth of the iconic Tabi boots, his appointment as a designer for the global luxury brand Hermès, and his sudden retirement at age 51—Margiela himself speaks before the camera about the career and creativity he has never discussed before, resulting in an invaluable documentary.
title:マーク・アントニー: This Indian sci-fi action film comically and eccentrically depicts a gangster's son who obtains a phone that allows him to talk to people in the past and tries to rewrite fate. In 1975, mad scientist Chiranjeevi invents a telephone that can call people in the past. Using it, he can avert disasters about to befall his past self or loved ones, or make choices that lead to profit. However, Chiranjeevi gets caught in a gang war at a bar while celebrating, and the phone goes missing. Twenty years later, auto mechanic Mark stumbles upon the phone and learns its special abilities and how to use it. This phone eventually sparks a massive upheaval involving Mark's foster father, gang boss Jackie; Jackie's son Madan; and Mark's deceased father, Antony. In Japan, Vishal plays dual roles as mechanic Mark and his gangster father Antony, while S. J. Surya, known for "Jigarthanda Double X," co-stars as Antony's partner Jackie.
title:マーダレス: Screened at "EU Film Days 2026" (Tokyo: May 16–29 at Theater Image Forum, May 19–24 at National Film Archive of Japan; Nagoya: June 6–19 at Nagoya Kinema Noi; also held in Hiroshima, Kyoto, and Fukuoka).
title:マーティ・シュプリーム: A drama starring Timothée Chalamet, set in 1950s New York, inspired by the life of real-life table tennis player Marty Reisman. Marty Mauser, who dreams of becoming the world's number one table tennis player in America where the sport has low popularity, works at a relative's shoe store to raise funds to participate in the World Championships. After losing to Japanese player Endo at the World Championships held in London, Marty aims to compete in the next World Championships in Japan. With his mistress Rachel pregnant, his player eligibility revoked by the table tennis association, and his funds running out, Marty tries every possible way to raise money for the trip... Gwyneth Paltrow plays Kay, a retired famous actress; Grammy-winning artist Tyler Okonma, known as Tyler, The Creator, plays Marty's friend; Odessa A'zion plays Marty's girlfriend; Kevin O'Leary plays Milton, Kay's husband and president of an ink company; and Japanese Deaflympics table tennis representative Kōto Kawaguchi plays Japanese player Endo. Directed by Josh Safdie ("Uncut Gems," "Good Time"), the film was nominated for nine Academy Awards at the 98th ceremony, including Best Picture, Best Director, and Best Actor.

title:ミゲル・ゴメス アーリーワークス:
Portuguese filmmaker Miguel Gomes continues to pursue a unique, poetic cinematic world through a style that effortlessly transcends the boundaries between fantasy and reality, documentary and fiction. His early masterpieces will be screened on a daily rotating basis.

title:ミックスモダン: A human drama about a young man who could only feel himself through committing crimes, and how he finds meaning in life through his encounter with a couple running an okonomiyaki restaurant. Directed and written by Toshizo Fujiwara, who has acted in films such as "A Scene at the Sea," the film was selected for the Panorama section of the 75th Berlin International Film Festival in 2025. Hiroyuki and Sonoko Kiuchi, a couple running an okonomiyaki shop, hire former prisoners and juvenile detention center graduates to help them reintegrate into society. However, since an incident involving a former employee a year ago, they have been plagued by online harassment. During an interview at a juvenile detention center, the Kiuchis meet 18-year-old Yuto Nishimura, who pleads to start his life over, and they hire him as a new employee. Yuto begins working earnestly, but after a certain event, he reconnects with his old friends and becomes strongly drawn to Yukiha, a dancer he meets at a club. The script was written based on extensive research at various sites, including an okonomiyaki shop in Osaka that actually supports the employment of former prisoners and juvenile detainees, and incorporates Fujiwara's own experiences. Daiki Ido stars in his first leading role as Yuto, Fujiwara plays Hiroyuki, Rino Tsuneishi plays Sonoko, with supporting roles by Tomoko Fujita and Jiei Kabira.
title:ムー×ベルジネピクチャーズ 未確認アニメ夜話: UMAs, the future, memory, psychology, spiritualism, the cosmos, unknown interference... This collection of animated works has caused a quiet stir within the editorial department of *Mu*, long-time observers of the world’s mysteries. The works of Shoji Kohara present questions that may truly exist on the flip side of reality, delivered in the form of stories. Unexplained voids. A sense of unease where meaning remains fluid. A sensation that sparks deep speculation within the viewer. This program features a comprehensive screening of "liminal" animations—from past works to the latest—that resonate deeply with the interests of *Mu*. After the experience, the way you see the world may shift, if only slightly.

An omnibus collection of short animations by Director Seiji Ohara, who has earned high acclaim both in Japan and abroad for his hand-drawn works and unique worldview. Produced between 2011 and 2025 in collaboration with "Mu"—a cultural magazine dedicated to exploring the mysterious and the unknown—the collection features six films centered on enigmatic themes.

title:メモリィズ: Starring Tasuku Emoto, this drama explores themes of family memory and records. Yuta, who lives with his wife and daughter in Tokyo, travels to a rural town in Kyushu to care for his father-in-law Makoto, who has broken his leg, until he recovers. While helping out at Makoto's old-fashioned photo studio, Yuta exchanges videos taken on his smartphone with his wife and daughter back in Tokyo. Even without major events, the accumulation of daily trivial records and memories quietly and vividly reveals the long span of a family's life. Moka Kamishiraishi ("Shōgun," "Girl Encounters") plays Yuta's wife Yuki, who continues working and raising their child in Tokyo. Issey Ogata plays Makoto, the taciturn father-in-law, and Yū Kashii plays a character symbolizing precious family memories. Director Miu Sakanishi, who gained attention for short films while at Kyoto University of Art and Design and later worked as an assistant director for Yūya Ishii and a making-of cameraman for Yūichirō Doi, makes her feature-length directorial debut.
title:メリリー・ウィー・ロール・アロング: A filmed recording of the Broadway musical 'Merrily We Roll Along,' which won four Tony Awards, screened in theaters. Based on the play of the same name by George S. Kaufman and Moss Hart, this musical, which premiered in 1981, features music by the legendary Stephen Sondheim, creator of numerous masterpieces including 'Sweeney Todd.' The story depicts the tumultuous 30-year relationship between Frank, a successful Hollywood producer; Mary, a former best-selling author; and Charlie, a Pulitzer Prize-winning playwright, told in reverse chronological order. This recording captures the 2023–24 Broadway production starring Maria Friedman, which was a huge hit. Jonathan Groff, known for the Netflix series 'Mindhunter' and as the voice of Kristoff in Disney's 'Frozen,' plays producer Frank; Daniel Radcliffe of the 'Harry Potter' series plays playwright Charlie; and Lindsay Mendez, a veteran of numerous Broadway musicals, plays former best-selling author Mary. At the 2024 Tony Awards, the production won Best Revival of a Musical, Best Actor in a Musical (Jonathan Groff), Best Featured Actor in a Musical (Daniel Radcliffe), and Best Orchestrations.
title:メロスたち: This is the sequel to the 2022 documentary "Run! Run Run Melos," which followed four high school students in Shimane Prefecture as they discovered the joy of performing on stage. The drama club at the Kakeya Branch of Shimane Prefectural Mitoya High School had earned unexpectedly high praise for their original play "Run! Run Run Melos," based on Osamu Dazai’s classic novel "Run, Melos!" Since then, their advisor Mr. Yoshihiro Kameo, who first guided them into the world of theater, has transferred to another school, and the four members have moved into their final year of high school. As they each begin to decide on their future paths, Shogo Sota finds himself standing alone on stage at the Chugoku regional drama competition. The film captures the individual choices of the four students as they face graduation, grappling with loneliness, conflict, and anxiety. It also features footage of their March 2023 reunion just before graduation, where they performed a show titled "Graduation Ceremony" before large audiences in Shimokitazawa, Tokyo, and Matsue, Shimane.
title:メロディがいた季節: A documentary capturing Mark Lester and Tracy Hyde—stars of the 1971 British coming-of-age masterpiece *Melody*—as they attend fan events in Japan and revisit filming locations near London. In 2022, the Yokohama movie theater Cinema Novecento held a screening event to commemorate the 50th anniversary of the release of *Melody*. In addition to special screenings of *Melody* and the film *Graduation Journey* (which Lester starred in in Japan) using new 35mm prints, fan events featuring Lester
title:モディリアーニ！: Paris, 1916. Three tumultuous days that changed the life of the artist Modigliani. While on the run from the police, Modigliani longs to end his career and leave Paris behind. His fellow painters Maurice Utrillo and Chaïm Soutine, as well as his muse Beatrice Hastings, attempt to dissuade him. He seeks counsel from his friend and art dealer Léopold Zborowski, but his mind remains in turmoil. Ultimately, he meets Maurice Gangnat, a collector who will change the course of his life forever.
title:モブ子の恋: Director Taichi Kazama, known for the TV drama "Silent," adapts manga artist Akari Tamura's comic into a live-action film, a love story about the first crushes of "supporting characters" who have quietly lived on the fringes of society. Shy and reserved college student Nobuko Tanaka identifies with the term "mob," meaning crowd, extra, or non-major character, and has lived her life watching from afar as other protagonists shine. Then, she notices Hiroki Irie, a young man working part-time at the same supermarket. Touched by Irie's natural thoughtfulness, Nobuko gradually becomes drawn to him. Through her encounter with Irie, she begins to struggle to break free from the shell that has bound her, and while sometimes confronted with harsh realities, she perseveres with the support of her coworkers. Meanwhile, Irie also notices Nobuko's quiet kindness and looks straight at her. The accumulation of small, everyday moments eventually gives them both the strength to take a step forward. Hiyori Sakurada ("The Diary of a Substitute Lie") plays Nobuko, aka Mobuko, and Taisei Kido ("Yukite Kaeranu") plays Hiroki Irie, the object of her first love. The cast also includes Ikoi Hayase as Nobuko's junior coworker Abe, Erika Karata as senior coworker Shinozaki, Takuya Kusakawa as fellow part-timer and Irie's friend Kaneko, Tsubasa Araki as new part-timer Ono, and Kanji Furutachi as store manager Orihara.
title:モロカイ・バウンド:
The second feature film by director Alika Tengan, a Native Hawaiian with roots in Okinawa, this drama explores the bond between a father and son in modern-day Hawaii. Among the Hawaiian Islands, Molokai remains largely untouched by tourism, a place where pristine nature and traditional culture endure. Kainoa, a Native Hawaiian who left Molokai to live on Oahu, is released on parole after serving time in prison. While struggling with the stigma of being an "ex-con," Kainoa sets out on a difficult path to reconnect with his estranged son, Jonathan, and reclaim his indigenous identity, but...

Based on Tengan’s 2019 short film of the same name, the director himself adapted the story into a feature-length production. The cast, led by Holden Mandrial-Santos as Kainoa, features friends who grew up with Tengan in Hawaii. The film won the Best Made in Hawaii Feature Film Award and the Kau Ka Hōkū Award (Emerging Filmmaker Award) at the 44th Hawaii International Film Festival in 2024, as well as the Pacific Islands Special Award at the 2nd Cinema at Sea: Okinawa Pan-Pacific International Film Festival.
title:モンテ・クリスト伯: Alexandre Dumas’ 19th-century masterpiece "The Count of Monte Cristo," a cornerstone of revenge literature also known in Japan as "Gankutsuou," has been adapted into a live-action film in France. Young sailor Edmond Dantès is on the verge of a promotion to captain and an upcoming marriage when he is imprisoned for a crime he did not commit due to a sinister plot. Losing his will to live in the depths of despair, Dantès finds hope again after meeting an old priest planning an escape. The priest provides him with an education and reveals the existence of a hidden treasure belonging to the Knights Templar. Fourteen years after his incarceration, Dantès miraculously escapes, acquires the vast fortune, and finally sets his plan for revenge in motion. Appearing in Parisian high society as the mysterious millionaire "The Count of Monte Cristo," he skillfully closes in on the three men who stole his life. Pierre Niney (*Yves Saint Laurent*) stars, delivering an elegant and delicate performance as the ill-fated avenger Dantès. He is joined by Bastien Bouillon (*The Night of the 12th*), Anaïs Demoustier (*The New Girlfriend*), and Anamaria Vartolomei (*Happening*). At the 50th César Awards in 2025, the film received a year-high 14 nominations and won for Best Production Design and Best Costume Design.
title:ヤマトタケル 白鳥伝説:
A puppet entertainment film based on the ancient hero Yamato Takeru, who appears in the "Kojiki" and "Nihon Shoki." The story unfolds based on the legend of Yamato Takeru, who, under the orders of the Yamato Court, embarked on an expedition to unify the Japanese archipelago and, after achieving victory, transformed into a white swan and returned to the heavens.

In Habikino City, Osaka, fourth-graders Yuya, Yuri, and Jiro are guided by a white swan soaring through the sky to the Yamato Takeru Shiratori-ryo (Mausoleum). Suddenly, they are enveloped in a dazzling light and transported back in time to an ancient land inhabited by puppets with souls. Now in puppet form, the three children are entrusted with the vital task of safeguarding
title:ユマカウンティの行き止まり: The feature-length debut of up-and-coming director Francis Galluppi, this black comedy crime thriller depicts a series of unpredictable worst-case scenarios unfolding at a desert diner. In the 1970s, in the desert region of Yuma County, Arizona. A salesman visits a diner that serves as the last gas station. When the fuel truck doesn't arrive on time, the salesman passes the time chatting with a waitress. A vicious bank robber shows up, taking the salesman and waitress hostage. However, because there's no gasoline, the bank robber can't leave the diner either. Unaware of the situation, a steady stream of quirky customers arrives at the diner: an elderly couple, an Indian chief, a hapless sheriff, and a couple aspiring to be criminals. Jim Cummings of "The Thunder Road" plays the salesman, Jocelin Donahue of "The House of the Devil" plays the waitress, and Richard Brake of "Barbarian" plays the bank robber. The film won the Best Picture award in the ORBITA section at the 2023 Sitges International Film Festival, which selects the best thrillers, suspense, and action films, earning high praise.
title:ユリイカ: Directed by Kiyoshi Aoyama of 'Helpless,' this human drama depicts the journey of recovery for people traumatized by a bus-jacking incident. It won the FIPRESCI Prize and the Ecumenical Jury Prize at the 53rd Cannes International Film Festival in 2000. A bus-jacking occurs in a regional city in Kyushu, and many passengers are killed. The only survivors are the driver, Sawai, and two siblings: junior high school student Naoki and elementary school student Kozue. All three are deeply scarred. Two years later, Sawai, who had disappeared leaving his family behind, returns to town. Around the same time, a series of murders occur in the area, and suspicion falls on Sawai. Learning that the siblings are living alone, Sawai visits their home and begins living with them. Joined by the siblings' cousin, Akihiko, the four set out on a journey in a bus driven by Sawai... Kōji Yakusho plays Sawai, while real-life siblings Shō Miyazaki and Aoi Miyazaki play Naoki and Kozue. Following director Kiyoshi Aoyama's death in March 2022, a digital master complete version was released in theaters that May as a memorial screening.
title:ユースフル・ゴースト: In Bangkok, Thailand, where dust pollution is severe, March (Wisarut Himmarat) spends his days in grief after losing his beloved wife Nat (Davika Hoorne) to a respiratory disease. One day, Nat's soul returns, inhabiting a vacuum cleaner, and the two reaffirm their love. Meanwhile, at the factory run by March's family, the spirit of a deceased employee possesses the machinery, bringing operations to a halt. Rejected by family troubled by the spirit and by society, Nat tries to prove her true love for her husband and her own existence as a 'useful ghost' by helping with the factory's exorcism...
title:ユートピアの力: A documentary about Chandigarh, the planned city built in India by Le Corbusier, the master of modernist architecture who left behind numerous legendary buildings. In 1947, India and Pakistan gained independence, and Punjab was divided between the two countries. With the state capital Lahore belonging to Pakistan, India needed to build a new capital. Prime Minister Nehru wanted a city symbolizing faith in the future and democracy, entrusting Le Corbusier with designing the planned city of Chandigarh. Born in the wilderness at the foot of the Himalayas, the "Shining City" of Chandigarh aimed to be a human-centered utopia where natural order and modern technology were in perfect harmony, symbolizing a new India. How has this city transformed 70 years after its birth? The film traces the buildings and their history, while residents—architects, urban activists, and artists—discuss the challenges Chandigarh faces and its enduring charm. Screened as part of the special program "Le Corbusier and Doshi: Modernism in India" (from May 1, 2026, at Eurospace in Tokyo and other theaters nationwide).
title:ライオンにいてほしい: To be screened at EU Film Days 2026 (Tokyo: May 16–29, 2026 at Theater Image Forum, May 19–24 at National Film Archive; Nagoya: June 6–19 at Nagoya Cinema Neu; also to be held in Hiroshima, Kyoto, and Fukuoka).
title:ライフセーバー！: A youth ensemble drama set on Wakasa Wada Beach in Takahama Town, Fukui Prefecture, the first beach in Asia to receive the international environmental certification "Blue Flag," depicting a young man lost and without dreams who meets lifeguards and grows through challenging trials. Yuki Otomo, a university junior, has no motivation for job hunting and is lost in life. Plagued by loneliness at being left behind by those around him and a sense of futility about the future, he is invited by his uncle to spend summer vacation in Fukui. One day, Yuki tries to save a drowning person but ends up drowning himself, and is rescued by members of the "Wakasa Wada Lifesaving Club." Witnessing their love for the sea and their courage to act for others, a passionate feeling begins to stir in the apathetic Yuki's heart. Deciding to become a lifeguard, Yuki trains hard alongside his peers, but... Model and actor Nose Rin, who made his screen debut in "About a Place in the Kinki Region," makes his film lead debut as Yuki. Satoshi Tokushige plays the leader of the Wakasa Wada Lifesaving Club, Hina Irei plays a club member, Toru Kazama plays Yuki's uncle, and Tokuma Nishioka plays the chairman of the Takahama Town Water Rescue Association. Directed and written by Yoshihisa Kodama, known for "Oshorin," with the ending theme performed by singer-songwriter Hana Sekitori.
title:ライフテープ:
This is the first documentary from director and actor Ryo Anraku, who has previously crafted feature films based on his own experiences, such as *Halfway Through a Dream* and *Dance of One*. The film tenderly captures the precious daily lives of Anraku’s close friend, street dancer and artist Ryuichi, his wife Ayaka, their son Haku—who lives with Menkes disease, a rare condition said to affect only one in 120,000 people—and their cat, Figaro.

In October 2022, after being asked by his childhood friend Ryuichi to "film my family," Anraku began documenting their lives. Their newborn son, Haku, has Menkes disease, a congenital metabolic disorder caused by a copper deficiency that leads to various health complications. While the life shared by the family and Figaro is filled with smiles, Ayaka’s diary—written between Haku's birth and his diagnosis—contains the raw, poignant words of a couple struggling to accept their reality. As they continue to weave their daily lives while confronting inescapable loneliness and anxiety, they reach a major turning point: the decision for Haku to undergo a tracheostomy. This theatrical version has been re-edited from the edition screened at the 16th Za-Koenji Documentary Festival in 2025.
title:ライブビューイング ミュージカル『⼑剣乱舞』 〜静かなる夜半の寝ざめ:
[Original Concept] Based on "Touken Ranbu ONLINE" (DMM GAMES/NITRO PLUS)
[Director] Isamu Kayano
[Script & Lyrics] Sayaka Asai
[Music Director] YOSHIZUMI
[Choreography & Staging] Shinnosuke Motoyama, TETSUHARU, Ryosuke Sakuragi, REX
[Presented by] Musical "Touken Ranbu" Production Committee (Nelke Planning, Nitro Plus, DMM GAMES, Euclid Agency)
title:ラプソディ・ラプソディ: Actor Tsuyoshi Rishu, who has directed films such as 'Chloe' and 'Goodbye Debussy', takes the director's chair for a feature film for the first time in 13 years, with Issei Takahashi in the lead role. This human drama humorously depicts a man who has avoided social interactions, whose life takes an unexpected turn when he discovers he has been unknowingly registered as married to a woman he doesn't know. Mikio Natsuno, a slightly naive man who never gets angry, goes to get a copy of his family register to renew his passport and is shocked to find the words 'Relationship: Wife' for a woman he has absolutely no memory of. Learning that a woman named 'Shigeko' has registered herself as his wife without his knowledge, Mikio begins searching for this mysterious woman. He eventually finds Shigeko at a small flower shop on a street corner, but she is an unconventional woman who destroys everything she touches. Though Mikio is tossed around by Shigeko, this strange encounter gradually brings unexpected changes to both their lives. Issei Takahashi plays the kind-hearted and sensitive protagonist Mikio, and Kumi Goshima (NHK morning drama 'Manpuku') plays the enigmatic heroine Shigeko who bewilders everyone around her. Okihiko Serizawa and Chizuru Ikewaki co-star, and director Rishu also appears as a key character. World-renowned jazz pianist Junko Onishi provides the music.
title:ラベンダー・ヒル・モブ: A crime comedy that depicts, with ironic humor, how two men's gold bullion heist plan takes an unexpected turn. One of the 'Ealing Comedies,' a series of comedy films produced at Ealing Studios in the UK from the late 1930s to the mid-1950s, directed by Charles Crichton, who was later nominated for an Academy Award for Best Director for 'A Fish Called Wanda.' Henry, a serious man who has worked as a bank security guard for 20 years, conspires with his friend Pendlebury, a souvenir shop owner, to steal a shipment of gold bullion. After successfully pulling off the heist, they process the gold into miniature Eiffel Towers to smuggle it abroad, but in a lounge at the Eiffel Tower in Paris, they accidentally sell them to a group of schoolchildren on a trip from England... Alec Guinness of 'Star Wars' fame plays Henry, and Stanley Holloway of 'My Fair Lady' plays Pendlebury. A young Audrey Hepburn appears in a single scene. The film won the Academy Award for Best Original Screenplay at the 25th Academy Awards in 1953. This film is part of the special screening series 'The Golden Age of British Ealing Comedies' (June 20–July 17, 2026, at Shinjuku K's Cinema).
title:ラルジャン: The 13th feature film by French master director Robert Bresson, who left behind masterpieces such as "Resistance: From the Prisoner's Diary" and "Mouchette." Bresson, already over 80 at the time of filming, passed away in 1999, making this his final work. Based on the novella "The Forged Coupon" by Russian literary giant Leo Tolstoy, it depicts the life of Yvon, a young fuel delivery man who, after unknowingly using a counterfeit bill that falls into his hands, triggers a family massacre and spirals downward. The title "L'argent" means "money" in French. First released in Japan in 1986. Revived in 2011 as part of "Cinema Masterpiece Selection III: The Art of Robert Bresson" with new prints. In 2026, it will be revived again in a 2K restored version as part of "Robert Bresson Masterpiece Selection."
title:リアム・ギャラガー ライブ・アット・ネブワース2022: A live film documenting the solo outdoor concert performed by Liam Gallagher, the legendary voice of the British rock band Oasis, at Knebworth Park in 2022. Ever since Oasis drew 250,000 people there in 1996, Knebworth has been revered as the "holy ground" of the band. Having established himself as a solo artist following the group's 2009 split, Liam returned to the Knebworth stage for the first time in 26 years, performing for 170,000 ecstatic fans over two days. The film captures the 16-song set—featuring 10 Oasis anthems such as "Wonderwall," "Champagne Supernova," "Live Forever," and "Stand By Me"—alongside the liberating atmosphere and sense of pure joy unique to an outdoor festival. The encore also features a guest appearance by former Stone Roses guitarist John Squire.
title:リプライズ: The feature directorial debut of Joachim Trier, a Danish director distantly related to Lars von Trier who studied film in Denmark and England, released in 2006. This is the first work of the "Oslo Trilogy," which also includes his later films "Oslo, August 31st" and "The Worst Person in the World." Philip and Erik are childhood friends who have dreamed of becoming writers since they were kids. One day, they both send manuscripts to a publisher, but only Philip's is accepted. Philip becomes a suddenly famous author, but soon begins to suffer mental instability. Meanwhile, Erik continues writing novels without giving up... Anders Danielsen Lie, who stars in all three films of the "Oslo Trilogy," plays Philip. Selected as Norway's entry for the 79th Academy Awards for Best Foreign Language Film, it received high praise, winning the Grand Prix (Best Film), Best Director, and Best Screenplay at the Amanda Awards, Norway's equivalent of the Academy Awards. It received its first theatrical release in Japan as part of the special screening series "Joachim Trier: The Oslo Trilogy" (starting February 13, 2026, at Bunkamura Le Cinéma Shibuya Miyashita and other venues in Tokyo).
title:リモート・コントロール: Screened at the 2nd Japan-Mongolia Film Festival (March 14–27, 2026, at K's cinema).
title:リー・ミラー 彼女の瞳が映す世界:
Starring and produced by Kate Winslet, this film dramatizes the extraordinary life of Lee Miller, the real-life figure who transformed from a top fashion model into one of the 20th century's most iconic photojournalists. In 1938, while vacationing in the South of France with a circle of artist friends, Lee meets and falls in love with the artist Roland Penrose. Before long, the looming threat of World War II changes their lives forever. Securing work as a photographer, Lee teams up with David Scherman, a photojournalist and editor for the American magazine *LIFE*. In 1945, serving as a war correspondent and photographer, Lee captures a series of historic scoops. On the day of Hitler's suicide, she signals the end of the war by photographing a portrait of herself in the bathtub of Hitler's Munich apartment. The sights she witnessed remained etched in her mind, haunting her for many years after the war.

Kate Winslet’s performance as Lee Miller earned her a Golden Globe nomination for Best Actress in a Motion Picture – Drama. The film features a supporting cast including Marion Cotillard as Lee's friend Solange d'Ayen, Alexander Skarsgård as her lover Roland Penrose, and Andy Samberg as David Scherman. Ellen Kuras, the acclaimed cinematographer of *Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind*, makes her feature directorial debut.
title:ルオムの黄昏:
Winner of the Best Film Award in the Competition Section of the 30th Busan International Film Festival.

The traces of a lost lover, and a path that recedes the more you search—another time flowing through Luomu, an ancient town in Sichuan Province.

A postcard arrives from Wang, a lover who vanished without a trace three years ago, bearing only the words "Twilight in Luomu." Bai, who worked as a dancer in a theater troupe, follows this single clue to an inn in the ancient town of Luomu, Sichuan. There she meets Liu, the inn's proprietress; Huang, who has harbored feelings for Liu for twenty years; and a stream of passing travelers. In this town, once prosperous from trade and now flowing with quiet time, what she encounters is not Wang himself, but the traces of the time he left behind. The faint sound of a distant whistle echoes, and before Bai, who wanders the ancient town, Wang appears and disappears like a phantom. One day, Bai learns that a man resembling Wang was reportedly seen at a mountain temple—

Released simultaneously with its sister film "Chunshu," shot with the same cast prior to this work.
title:レオ ブラッディ・スウィート: Director Lokesh Kanagaraj (Kaithi, Vikram) reunites with superstar Vijay following their collaboration on Master for this high-octane crime action film. In the quiet North Indian town of Theog, Parthiban, a Tamil animal rescuer and cafe owner, lives a peaceful life with his wife and two children. However, their tranquility is shattered when a gang led by Shanmugam rampages through the town and breaks into his cafe. Though Parthiban initially tries to settle the matter by handing over the cash, he is forced to act when his daughter and female staff are threatened, taking down five attackers in an instant with extraordinary physical prowess. As the incident makes national headlines, various underworld factions begin to target him—including mysterious men who insist on calling him "Leo." Trisha Krishnan (Ponniyin Selvan: I & II) stars as Parthiban's wife, with Sanjay Dutt (K.G.F: Chapter 2, PK) appearing as the gangster hunting for Leo.
title:レネットとミラベル 四つの冒険: An omnibus of four short episodes by director Eric Rohmer, chronicling the curious encounters of two contrasting young women, Reinette and Mirabelle. In the first episode, "The Blue Hour," the two—who met after a flat bicycle tire—strive to experience the moment of absolute silence that occurs just before dawn. The second episode, "The Waiter," depicts their interactions with a peculiar cafe server after they begin living together in Paris. The third episode, "The Beggar, the Kleptomaniac, and the Swindler," features a series of dialogues concerning crime and conscience. The film concludes with the fourth episode, "Selling the Painting," in which they scramble to sell one of Reinette’s artworks to cover their rent. Rohmer conceived the project based on the personal anecdotes of Joëlle Miquel, who plays Reinette, and filmed it on 16mm with a minimal crew.
title:レンタル・ファミリー: Brendan Fraser, winner of the Academy Award for Best Actor for "The Whale," stars in this human drama shot entirely in Japan. Directed by Japanese filmmaker HIKARI, who gained attention for her feature debut "37 Seconds" and the drama series "Beef," the film follows a down-on-his-luck actor living in Tokyo who rediscovers himself through working for a rental family service. Philip, an American actor who once dominated toothpaste commercials but has since been largely forgotten, lives in Tokyo, eking out a living in the acting world and blending into the city. One day, he is hired by Tada, who runs a rental family company. The job involves playing the role of a cherished "family member" for clients in exchange for payment. Initially hesitant about delving into others' lives, Philip begins to change as he interacts with the people he meets through his work. Takehiro Hira plays Tada, the rental family company owner; Mari Yamamoto plays Aiko, an actress working for the company; and Akira Emoto plays Kikuo, an aging actor.
title:ロスバンド: A Norwegian youth music road movie. Grim, the drummer, who is heartbroken by his parents' discord, and his best friend Aksel, the guitarist and vocalist, practice daily to compete in a Norwegian rock competition. Grim is bothered by Aksel's lack of singing ability but can't bring himself to tell the truth. They manage to get tickets for the long-awaited competition, but they have no bassist, and the event is held in Tromsø, a town at the northern tip. They form "Los Band" after adding Tilda, a 9-year-old cello player who comes to the bassist audition, and set off on a journey in a car driven by their neighbor Mattin, a skilled driver... Director Kristian Land, known as a master of children's films, portrays their struggles and cooperation towards their dreams against the backdrop of rich Nordic nature.
title:ロックンロウル: The first feature film directed by Yu Yamada, who gained attention with short films "An Exhibition of Your Substitute" and "Perry (Just Dropped In)." Set in the world of small-theater stage productions, this ensemble drama powerfully and forcibly depicts people overcoming various forms of loneliness. Four days before the performance, actors Mina and Kosei are suddenly told by director Atsuzawa to stop rehearsals. Anxious Mina unilaterally vents to her live-in lover Tatsunori, while Kosei, harshly criticized for his acting, is dumped by his fiancée. Assistant director Momiji seeks to be needed by someone, and lighting staff Sho feels distant from those around him. Director Atsuzawa continues revising the script while bearing responsibility for the work. Each carries loneliness and anxiety as the performance day approaches. Seina Otaku, who starred in Yamada's "An Exhibition of Your Substitute," plays protagonist Mina; Chihiro Kabaki, who starred in "Perry (Just Dropped In)," plays assistant director Momiji. Also appearing are Yuho Fukui and Kimihito Omae from the comedy unit "Suzume People," who shine in theater productions by Yamada's creative group "Shinagawa Shinashirazu," and Takuma Ishii, who actively performs mainly in small theaters.
title:ロッコク・キッチン: A documentary that observes people's lives and the present state of Fukushima through the dining tables of those living along National Route 6, commonly known as "Rokkoku," where areas still remain designated as difficult-to-return zones.
title:ロビー！ 4000億円を懸けた仁義なき18ホール: Popular Korean actor Ha Jung-woo stars in and directs this comedy-drama depicting a young CEO’s struggle as he tackles his first-ever round of business golf to secure a massive national project. Chang-wook, the head of a small tech startup, begins lobbying efforts to save his company from the brink of bankruptcy. Although a brilliant engineer, he is clueless about the unwritten rules of the business world and a poor salesman. To get a piece of a 4-trillion-won national project, he finds himself playing a high-stakes game of golf with Director Choi, the man who holds the power over the bidding process. Chang-wook arrives fully prepared, even inviting Se-bin, a young pro golfer and Director Choi’s personal favorite. However, the day descends into total chaos when a rival CEO and the Minister—who happens to be both Choi’s boss and his wife—unexpectedly show up. The film features an ensemble cast including Kim Eui-sung (Train to Busan), Park Byung-eun (In Our Prime), Lee Dong-hwi (Extreme Job), Kang Mal-geum (Lucky Chan-sil), Choi Si-won of the boy band SUPER JUNIOR, and Kang Hae-lim (Netflix’s Somebody). Kim Kyung-chan (1987: When the Day Comes) co-wrote the screenplay alongside Ha Jung-woo.
title:ロブスター [プレ企画]シネマカリテと また逢える: "Singles" are detained and sent to a hotel. If they fail to find a partner within 45 days, they are transformed into an animal of their choosing and released into the woods. In such an era, David, having become single, is also sent to the hotel. There, a daily life of madness lay in wait.
title:ロングウォーク: The first-ever film adaptation of Stephen King's first novel, "The Long Walk," written while he was in college in the 1960s and published under the pseudonym Richard Bachman in 1979. In a near-future America divided by war, a national competition called "The Long Walk" is held as a beacon of hope for a struggling society. Fifty selected teenage boys challenge this contest, where the only requirement is to keep walking. The prize is a staggering sum of money and the fulfillment of one wish. The rules are simple: maintain a pace of 4.8 km/h, receive a warning if you slow down, be executed after three warnings, and keep walking until only one person remains. Surrounded by armored vehicles and under the threat of guns, the boys desperately continue walking in extreme conditions with no rest or sleep allowed... Starring Cooper Hoffman ("Licorice Pizza") and David Johnson ("Alien: Romulus") as the young participants, and Mark Hamill ("Star Wars" series) as the Major who oversees the competition. Directed by Francis Lawrence ("The Hunger Games" series) with a screenplay by J.T. Molner ("Strange Darling").
title:ロングウォーク（字幕）: The first-ever film adaptation of Stephen King's first novel, "The Long Walk," written while he was in college in the 1960s and published under the pseudonym Richard Bachman in 1979. In a near-future America divided by war, a national competition called "The Long Walk" is held as a beacon of hope for a struggling society. Fifty selected teenage boys challenge this contest, where the only requirement is to keep walking. The prize is a staggering sum of money and the fulfillment of one wish. The rules are simple: maintain a pace of 4.8 km/h, receive a warning if you slow down, be executed after three warnings, and keep walking until only one person remains. Surrounded by armored vehicles and under the threat of guns, the boys desperately continue walking in extreme conditions with no rest or sleep allowed... Starring Cooper Hoffman ("Licorice Pizza") and David Johnson ("Alien: Romulus") as the young participants, and Mark Hamill ("Star Wars" series) as the Major who oversees the competition. Directed by Francis Lawrence ("The Hunger Games" series) with a screenplay by J.T. Molner ("Strange Darling").
title:ロン・ライス作品集（1）: Ron Rice (1935–1964) passed away at the young age of 29, yet he is regarded as one of the most pivotal figures of 1960s underground cinema for his singular originality. His masterpiece, *The Flower Thief*, captures the sensibility of the Beat Generation in its purest form through cinematography that utilizes American landscapes and improvisational performances. Lead actor Taylor Mead, while active as a poet, appeared in numerous underground films, including those by Andy Warhol. Mead was later symbolically cast in Jim Jarmusch’s *Coffee and Cigarettes* (2003), a film profoundly influenced by these underground works.
title:ロン・ライス作品集（2）: In *Senseless*, a record of a trip to Mexico is poetically woven together, liberated from the constraints of conventional cinematic grammar. Meanwhile, *Chumlum* invites the audience into a fantastical and anti-normative atmosphere through a deluge of images created by multiple exposures and vivid colors. Feeling restricted in his work in the United States due to censorship and unfair undervaluation, Rice moved his base of operations to Mexico, only to die there shortly after. This screening features outtakes from *Chumlum*—including a brief glimpse of a figure resembling Taylor Mead, who was not intended to appear in the final version—alongside unfinished footage shot in Mexico for his next project.
title:ワンダフルライフ: A fantasy drama by Hirokazu Kore-eda of "Maborosi" fame, depicting the seven days between death and reaching heaven. Twenty-two deceased people arrive at a facility shrouded in mist. The staff waiting for them instruct them to choose the single most important memory from their lives within the seven days before they go to heaven. Some choose a memory immediately, while others struggle to decide. But the final day, when a screening will be held, steadily approaches. Starring ARATA in his film debut.
title:ワールド・ブレイカー: An sci-fi survival action film starring Milla Jovovich of the "Resident Evil" series and Luke Evans from the live-action "Beauty and the Beast." In the year 20XX, invaders from another world descend upon Earth. With governments and militaries collapsed, the few remaining survivors live in constant terror across a desolate wasteland. After the men are defeated in the struggle against the invaders, the fate of humanity is entrusted to the women. Ella, who had been living a quiet life in a mountain shelter with her beloved husband and daughter, takes up a sword to protect her family. Entrusting her daughter to her husband, she throws herself into the heart of the brutal conflict. Directed by Brad Anderson ("The Machinist," "The Call") from a screenplay by actor Joshua Rollins. Screened as part of "Unexperienced Zone Movies 2026" (starting January 23, 2026, at Human Trust Cinema Shibuya).
title:ヴァリドマン:
This original tokusatsu (special effects) film was produced by the Kuno Laboratory at Bunkyo Gakuin University, led by film producer and director Professor Tsutomu Kuno, whose research focuses on content creation, management, and marketing for industrial renovation. The project was driven by a group of kaiju-loving students passionate about the genre, who collaborated with professional staff, voice actors, and cast members to bring the film to life.

On the day of her father’s funeral, a young girl named Miku takes a part-time job traveling around Tokyo in a mascot costume of Bunkyo City’s character, "Kattan." However, the being inside Kattan is actually an ancient inhabitant of the lost continent of Mu. Sensing that the Fierce Beast Taifu—the creature that once destroyed Mu—is about to awaken from its seal, Kattan pleads with Miku to become the warrior Validman and fight. Just as Miku begins to bond with Kattan and his yokai followers, Taifu finally resurrects. Kattan grows to a giant size to engage in a fierce battle, but is ultimately defeated. In that moment of dire peril, Miku transforms into the giant hero Validman.

The voice of Kattan is performed by popular voice actor Tomokazu Sugita, famous for his roles as Gintoki Sakata in "Gintama" and Gyomei Himejima in "Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba." Chie Koujiro, known for "Obocchama-kun," also makes a special appearance.
title:ヴィヴァルディと私: A drama based on the true story of composer Vivaldi's appointment as a violin teacher at the Ospedale della Pietà in Venice in the early 18th century, depicting the growth of a lonely girl whose talent blossoms under his guidance, and Vivaldi's inner ambition, craving recognition for his own genius. Venice, 1716, at the Ospedale della Pietà. Cecilia, raised without knowing her mother's presence or love, secretly slips out of bed every night to write letters to her mother with no address. To leave the Pietà and live in the outside world, her mother must come for her, or she must marry a nobleman. Amidst this, Antonio Vivaldi, arriving as a violin teacher, discovers Cecilia's exceptional violin skill and appoints her as the leader of the first violins. Under Vivaldi, Cecilia endures rigorous practice, hones her violin skills, and they gradually grow close. However, the officer the Pietà has chosen as Cecilia's husband returns from war, and an incident soon occurs. Tekla Insolia, noted for the Italian TV drama 'The Art of Joy,' plays Cecilia, and Michele Riondino of 'The Sleeping Beauty' plays Vivaldi. The film is directed and written by Damiano Michieletto, a leading Italian opera director who served as creative director for the opening and closing ceremonies of the Milan Cortina Winter Olympics.
title:万引き家族: Directed by Hirokazu Kore-eda of "The Third Murder" and "Our Little Sister," this human drama portrays human connections through the lens of a family that engages in petty crimes together. At the 71st Cannes Film Festival in 2018, it won the Palme d'Or, the top prize, for the first time for a Japanese film since "The Eel" in 1997. It also earned high praise overseas, including a nomination for Best Foreign Language Film at the 91st Academy Awards, the first for a Japanese film in a decade. At the 42nd Japan Academy Film Prize, it won eight awards, including Best Picture. In a working-class district of Tokyo, in an old one-story house seemingly left behind among high-rise apartments, live the homeowner Hatsue, the couple Osamu and Nobuyo, their son Shota, and Nobuyo's younger sister Aki, all dependent on Hatsue's pension. They make ends meet by shoplifting, living on the fringes of society, yet their days are filled with laughter. One winter day, Osamu brings home a little girl shivering on the balcony of a nearby apartment complex, and Nobuyo decides to raise her as a daughter. Triggered by an incident, the close-knit family begins to fall apart, revealing the secrets and desires each of them harbors. Alongside regular Kore-eda collaborators Lily Franky as the father Osamu, who repeatedly shoplifts with his son, and Kirin Kiki as Hatsue, the film marks the first Kore-eda works for Sakura Ando as Nobuyo and Mayu Matsuoka as Aki, Nobuyo's sister.
title:三人の⼥強盗: A selection of the "Ireland Film Festival 2026" (May 29 – June 11, 2026, at YEBISU GARDEN CINEMA).
title:三人の女強盗: A featured film of the Ireland Film Festival 2026 (May 29 – June 11, 2026, at Yebisu Garden Cinema).
title:三度目の殺人: Lawyer Shigemori (Fukuyama) takes on the defense of Misumi (Yakusho), who has been arrested on suspicion of murdering the president of the company where he worked. Misumi had previously been sentenced to life imprisonment for a robbery-murder committed 30 years ago and was on parole. Misumi's testimony shifts back and forth repeatedly. Eventually, an unexpected connection emerges between the victim's daughter, Sakie (Hirose), and Misumi... This film, framed as a courtroom suspense, questions ethical issues that lie outside legal judgment.
title:三角屋の交差点で: A documentary observing a 99-year-old woman and her son and daughter-in-law, who were affected by the Great East Japan Earthquake and the Fukushima Daiichi nuclear disaster and live in disaster recovery public housing, over a three-year period from 2018 to 2021. Seven years after the 2011 Great East Japan Earthquake and Fukushima Daiichi nuclear disaster, a family forced to evacuate from Namie Town, Fukushima, wavers between returning to their hometown and choosing a new life. Having closed their long-running printing business due to the disaster and living in disaster recovery public housing in Iwaki City, the roles and relationships within the family quietly change. Tetsu, the 99-year-old mother, clings to memories of her birthplace, Okuma Town, even as her memory fades. Her taciturn son Takemasa respects his mother but leaves most of her care to his wife Shigeko. Shigeko, who has continued to bear this role, begins to reexamine her taken-for-granted position within the family and her own way of living. Through the family's daily life in flux, the film questions what "home" is and what "I" is. Directed by Toru Yamada, who has continued making films in Fukushima since the Great East Japan Earthquake.
title:不屈の女たち 旧東ドイツ編: To be screened at EU Film Days 2026 (Tokyo: May 16–29, 2026 at Theater Image Forum, May 19–24 at the National Film Archive; Nagoya: June 6–19 at Nagoya Kinema Noi; also to be held in Hiroshima, Kyoto, and Fukuoka).
title:不思議惑星キン・ザ・ザ: A deadpan sci-fi comedy made in Soviet-era Georgia in 1986, which became a huge hit in the USSR at the time. One day, a student named Gedevan asks construction engineer Mashkov for help, looking troubled, saying, 'There are some men over there who claim to be aliens.' Mashkov, who doesn't believe in aliens, presses a button on a space travel device the men were holding, and in the next instant, Mashkov and Gedevan are warped to the planet Pluke in the Kin-Dza-Dza Nebula, far from Earth. There, for some reason, Earth matches are extremely valuable, and the two try to use the value of matches to somehow return to Earth... Culturally popular in Japan as well, it was first introduced at the 'Soviet SF Film Festival' held in Tokyo in 1989, later released in a new print in 2001 and a digital remaster in August 2016. In May 2021, to coincide with the release of the animated version 'Ku! Kin-Dza-Dza,' the live-action film had its fourth theatrical release.
title:不気味なものの肌に触れる濱⼝⻯介監督特集上映突然、偶然、必然: After losing his father, Chihiro is taken in by his half-brother, Togo. Togo and his girlfriend Satomi welcome Chihiro warmly, yet his loneliness remains. Chihiro finds solace in dancing with Naoya, a boy his own age. However, in the town where they dance with abandon, unsettling events soon begin to unfold... A singular work that serves as a pilot for the upcoming feature film *FLOODS*.
title:不貞の女: A suspense thriller from French master Claude Chabrol, a leading figure of the New Wave, starring his wife at the time, Stéphane Audran. Charles, an insurance executive, lives a happy life with his wife Hélène and their son, but one day he happens to catch Hélène answering a suspicious phone call. Suspecting her of infidelity, Charles hires a private detective and discovers that her lover is a writer named Pégala. Charles visits Pégala’s home to meet his wife's lover face-to-face. Though he initially maintains a facade of composure, he is gradually overcome by jealousy and rage... Highlights include the sophisticated visual beauty captured by cinematographer Jean Rabier (known for Agnès Varda’s *Le Bonheur* and Jacques Demy’s *The Umbrellas of Cherbourg*), the performances of a distinguished cast, and delicate psychological portrayals. Previously unreleased in Japanese theaters, the film will make its domestic theatrical debut as part of the "Claude Chabrol Masterpiece Selection" (starting February 13, 2026, at Cinema Rise, Morc Asagaya, and other venues), a retrospective featuring three of Chabrol’s suspense films released between the late 1960s and 1970.
title:世界が認めた栄冠のショート傑作選: Nine Academy Award-winning and nominated short films come together for a special event. A special theatrical screening has been confirmed, offering a chance to experience both live-action and animation on the big screen. Nine masterpieces, including Academy Award winners and nominees (four live-action and five animated shorts), will be presented in theaters as separate live-action and animation omnibus programs.
title:世界の果てまで3キロ: Screening at EU Film Days 2026 (Tokyo: May 16–29, 2026 at Theater Image Forum, May 19–24 at the National Film Archive of Japan; Nagoya: June 6–19 at Nagoya Kinema Noi; also held in Hiroshima, Kyoto, and Fukuoka).
title:両親が決めたこと:
STORY
Claudia (80), a stage actress in Barcelona, is suffering from terminal cancer. As the cancer metastasizes to her brain, bringing with it the threat of confusion, partial paralysis, and the loss of her sense of self, she chooses euthanasia. Claudia has always lived her life prioritizing the stage over motherhood. Her husband, Flavio, has supported his charming actress wife throughout her career and remains deeply in love with her. Bound by an eternal bond, the couple decides to undergo euthanasia together and reveals their plan to their three children. The children do not agree with their father’s decision, and the eldest daughter goes as far as to accuse her mother of manipulation, leading to a confrontation. However, the father’s resolve is firm. As the parents proceed with the necessary steps for their joint euthanasia, the departure for their final journey suddenly draws near...
title:丹下左膳 乾雲坤竜の巻: Master director Takashi Kato depicts the process by which Tange Sazen loses his right eye and right arm, with a realism unprecedented in conventional sword-fighting films. Based on the original story by Fumio Hayashi. Ordered by Soma clan lord Nakamura Daizen to steal the famous swords Ken'un and Konryu, Sazen sneaks into the dojo of Onozuka Tessai but only manages to take Ken'un, losing his right eye to Tessai's blade. Hearing this, Daizen abandons Sazen and plots to gather men to attack the dojo again. Enraged by his master's cold treatment, Sazen storms the dojo once more to seize Konryu.
title:丹下左膳 乾雲坤龍の巻: Master director Takashi Kato depicts the process by which Tange Sazen loses his right eye and right arm, with a realism unprecedented in conventional sword-fighting films. Based on the original story by Fumio Hayashi. Ordered by Soma clan lord Nakamura Daizen to steal the famous swords Ken'un and Konryu, Sazen sneaks into the dojo of Onozuka Tessai but only manages to take Ken'un, losing his right eye to Tessai's blade. Hearing this, Daizen abandons Sazen and plots to gather men to attack the dojo again. Enraged by his master's cold treatment, Sazen storms the dojo once more to seize Konryu.
title:丹下左膳余話 百万両の壺: Known as a masterpiece by early Showa period master Tomu Uchida, who died at just 28, this period drama stars Denjiro Okochi as the ronin Tange Sazen. Tange Sazen, a ronin living at an archery range and working as a bodyguard, and the proprietress Ofuji take in Chobian, the son of a man stabbed to death at the shop. Chobian carries a certain pot around carefully, using it as a goldfish bowl, but it actually contains a hidden map to a million ryo. This is one of only three surviving films by Uchida, most of whose original prints have been lost. It was remade in 2004 as "Tange Sazen: The Million Ryo Pot" starring Etsushi Toyokawa.
title:丹下左膳餘話 百萬兩の壺: A commotion over a pot that reveals the hiding place of a large sum of money draws in the swordsman Sanzen... A delightful gem showcasing the talent of Yamanaka, who lightly and skillfully portrays Daigoro's signature role of Sanzen.
title:主人公: Directed, written, and scored by the Indian master Satyajit Ray, this drama skillfully critiques the issues within the Bengali film industry through the crisis and introspection of a movie star. Arindam, a popular actor in Bengali cinema, is scheduled to attend an awards ceremony in Delhi, but after failing to secure a flight, he makes the journey by sleeper train. On board, he is recognized by all the passengers, including an eccentric old man who disapproves of his drinking habits and a mother and daughter who are fans. During the trip, Arindam is interviewed by Aditi, a female journalist who happens to be on the same train. Through their conversation, he reflects on his life and confronts the loneliness and inner conflict hidden behind his glamorous success. Uttam Kumar, a legendary star of the Bengali film industry at the time, plays the lead role of Arindam, while Sharmila Tagore (The World of Apu) portrays the journalist Aditi. In Japan, the film will make its theatrical debut in July 2025 as part of the "Satyajit Ray Retrospective 2025," a special screening series commemorating the 70th anniversary of the director's debut.
title:久里洋二 短篇アニメーション作品集: Yoji Kuri pioneered the possibilities of Japanese independent animation with his stark, razor-sharp lines and a boundless imagination fueled by absurdity and eros. Throughout the 1960s and 70s, he collaborated with avant-garde luminaries from various fields, including musicians Toru Takemitsu, Toshi Ichiyanagi, and Isao Tomita, and the poet Shuntaro Tanikawa. This program presents a collection of his award-winning works from international animation festivals—masterpieces that sent shockwaves through the global creative community.
title:二代目はクリスチャン: Kyoko, a nun at St. Saffron Church on Mount Rokko, plays hymns on the organ. Haruhiko Tenryu, the second-generation head of the Tenryu-gumi yakuza clan, is deeply in love with Kyoko because of her refined beauty, and has even forced his underlings to be baptized as Christians. Also harboring feelings for Kyoko is Detective Jindai, whose family runs a Tendai sect temple, presenting another formidable obstacle. However, Kyoko herself secretly harbors feelings for Eiji, whom she met fatefully one stormy day. As the feelings of those around her intertwine, Kyoko's destiny begins to move in an unexpected direction.
title:二十四時間の情事: An actress, once condemned for having an affair with an enemy soldier in a French village under German occupation, visits Hiroshima for a film shoot and indulges in a one-day affair with a Japanese architect. Through this, she learns of Hiroshima's tragedy. The date is August 6th. Against the backdrop of the anti-nuclear movement, their lonely conversation continues. The city, miraculously rebuilt from the ashes, can never forget the shadow of death.
title:五月の雨:
This film explores the issues surrounding the post-divorce joint custody system, set to be introduced in Japan in April 2026, through a blend of drama and documentary. By weaving together a fictional narrative set in a future where the system is in effect with real-life cases, testimonies from domestic violence survivors, and interviews with legal experts, the film exposes the inherent dangers of post-divorce joint custody.

Kaori Hasegawa, a housewife and mother to a young son, suffers from the psychological abuse of her husband, Naoki. He constantly criticizes her over trivial matters, such as the seasoning of her cooking or her choice of clothing; even when she apologizes, he relentlessly interrogates her for explanations. Driven to a breaking point by his control, Kaori flees their home and seeks legal help. After three years of deadlocked mediation due to conflicting claims, the divorce is finally granted. However, having conceded to her husband’s demand for "joint custody," Kaori finds herself still under his psychological thumb. From visitation rights to decisions about their son’s education, Naoki continues to exert control at every turn, leaving Kaori increasingly cornered.

Mari Yasukawa, who appeared in the NHK morning drama series *The Tiger and Her Wings*, stars as Kaori. Director Leo Tomita, a veteran of numerous television programs, makes his feature film directorial debut with this work.
title:人情紙風船: The final work of renowned early Showa period director Tomu Uchida, who died of illness at just 28, this is a humanistic period drama. In the Edo period, Shinzo, a barber living in a poor tenement, runs a gambling den and catches the eye of yakuza. Strapped for cash, he tries to pawn his barber tools but is refused. Meanwhile, Matajuro, a ronin living in the same tenement, seeks employment with a samurai his father once served, but is completely ignored. One day, Shinzo accidentally kidnaps the pawnshop owner's daughter and brings her back to the tenement... An adaptation of Kawatake Mokuami's kabuki play "Kamiyui Shinzo."
title:人間の証明: A black man is murdered in an elevator at a luxury hotel in Tokyo, leaving behind the word 'Stoha' and a poetry collection by Saijo Yaso. Fashion designer Kyoko Yasugi and her son appear and disappear along the investigative trail. Detective Muneyori travels to the United States to trace the black man's past. The unexpected relationship between Kyoko and the black man, as well as the connection between the American detective and Detective Muneyori, comes to light.
title:今は昔、栄養映画館の旅:
This documentary follows Akira Emoto and Tatsuki Nishimoto of the theatrical troupe Gekidan Tokyo Kandenzu as they tour independent cinemas across Japan with their staged reading of "Ima wa Mukashi, Eiyo Eigakan" (Once Upon a Time, the Nutrition Cinema).

Originally a masterpiece of absurdist theater by playwright Juichiro Takeuchi that premiered in 1983, the play was performed in its entirety as a staged reading by the duo of Emoto and Nishimoto in November 2024. It went on to have multiple encore performances at "Atelier Kandenzu," the troupe's rehearsal space and theater in Shimokitazawa, Tokyo. Because the play depicts the banter between a director and an assistant director waiting for a film's completion ceremony to begin in a movie theater, screenwriter and director Haruhiko Arai—who attended a performance—conceived the idea of staging the reading in actual cinemas. A month-long tour of 24 independent cinemas across the country took place from May 1 to 31, 2025, receiving critical acclaim from film and theater enthusiasts in every region.

This film captures their journey, showing Emoto, Nishimoto, and fellow members of Gekidan Tokyo Kandenzu as they travel to cinemas across Japan in a single van. Masaaki Takeda, who has served as an assistant director on works by directors Haruhiko Arai and Sang-il Lee, handled the direction, cinematography, and editing.
title:今日からぼくが村の映画館:
Set in a small village nestled within the majestic Andes Mountains of Peru, this drama follows the coming-of-age of a young boy captivated by the magic of cinema. Sistu, an inquisitive boy living in the highlands, happens upon a movie advertisement carried by the wind on the first day of the new school term. Guided by the flyer, he finds his way to a mobile cinema, where he experiences film for the first time and is instantly enchanted by its storytelling. From that day forward, Sistu becomes the village’s weekly storyteller, recounting the films he has seen to the local residents. However, when the mobile cinema suddenly vanishes into thin air, events begin to take an unexpected turn.

Directed by Cesar Galindo in his second feature film, the story weaves complex themes—the realities of the Peruvian education system, the marginalization of Andean highland communities, discrimination within a multicultural society, and the lingering scars of civil war—into a heartwarming narrative. Featuring a cast largely comprised of non-professional actors, including breakout lead Victor Acurio as Sistu, the film is spoken in Quechua, one of Peru’s official languages. It went on to become the highest-grossing Quechua-language film in the history of Peruvian cinema.
title:今日の空が一番好き、とまだ言えない僕は: Director Akiko Oku, known for "Dating My Daughter" and "Stop Me," adapts Shusuke Fukutoku's 2020 romance novel, originally written by the comedy duo Jarujaru. College student Toru Konishi lives a dull life far from his imagined campus experience. One day, he is captivated by the dignified appearance of a bun-haired female student, Hana Sakurada, and musters the courage to speak to her. Through a series of coincidences, they quickly hit it off. Amid their endless conversations, Hana casually says, "I want to feel that every day is fun. I want to feel that today's sky is the best," a phrase that pierces Toru's heart—because it is the same words his late grandmother, whom he loved dearly, used to say. Toru rejoices at meeting Hana, but soon an incident strikes them. Toru is played by Riku Hagiwara, popular for the "Beautiful Man" series, and Hana is played by Yuumi Kawai, a rising young talent known for "Extremely Inappropriate!" and "Namibia no Sabaku." The film was selected for the competition section of the 37th Tokyo International Film Festival in 2024.
title:何食わぬ顔（long version）濱⼝⻯介監督特集上映突然、偶然:
Nomura begins filming his late brother’s posthumous 8mm project at the urging of his friends. His non-committal attitude, however, leaves those around him bewildered. Shot entirely on 8mm film by the University of Tokyo Film Study Group, the work is heavily influenced by John Cassavetes’ *Husbands* (1970), a director Hamaguchi deeply admires. From its intricate film-within-a-film structure to its core sensibilities, the essence of Hamaguchi’s cinema is already fully present in this work.

*Note: The source material is an SD digitization of the original 8mm film.
title:侠客道: A small city on the outskirts of Osaka. The Teramitsu-gumi, backed by the Kansai crime syndicate Josei-kai, proposes a merger to their rivals, the Ishida-gumi, but is rejected by the lieutenant, Ibuki. In retaliation, the Teramitsu-gumi begins a campaign of harassment. Around that time, Prosecutor Nakagami is assigned to the city. Although Nakagami was Ibuki’s university classmate and had married the daughter of the Ishida boss, Tatsunosuke, he remains cold toward them. Meanwhile, Teramitsu summons Tatsunosuke, and when he refuses the deal once more, Teramitsu murders him...
title:偏向報道: A social drama directed and written by Kinshirō Ogino ('Ikushima Tanga,' 'My Bone MY BLOOD BONE'), focusing on 'biased reporting'—how news organizations edit and emphasize information based on specific stances or intentions to sway public opinion. Drawing from his own experience as a TV program director, Ogino depicts a rigid, top-down society where a director at a subcontracting production company confronts the corrupt practices of TV network executives. Suzuko Aburakami, a blunt-speaking director working for a subcontractor of the local TV station 'TV Top,' is asked to stop the broadcast of a fabricated video produced by the network's subsidiary, based on dubious information about the governor's harassment. Comedian and actress Miyuki Torii stars as Suzuko, with Seiya Makoto as the news director who intimidates subsidiaries and subcontractors. The cast includes Sayaka Higashi, Ippei Ōsako, Ami Tokitō, Hozumi Gōda, Shinya Ono, and Setsujirō Hotaru.
title:健康ちえのわトランポリン教室: A psycho-therapy thriller set against the backdrop of modern society, rife with self-validation needs and codependency, depicting the unraveling daily life of an ordinary couple after they stumble upon a bizarre 'hobby class.' Yui, a housewife in her second year of marriage, is forced by her seemingly gentle husband Kōhei to be a 'wife who needs protecting,' suffering from the 'non-malicious violence' lurking in everyday life while maintaining a facade of peace. One day, she discovers a strange class called the 'Kenkō Chienowa Trampolin Kyōshitsu' (Healthy Wisdom Ring Trampoline Class) and starts attending. Through interactions with the teacher and classmates, Yui begins to confront her suppressed 'true self,' but her marital relationship with Kōhei grows increasingly distorted, and the two are swallowed by the darkness hidden in their daily lives. Directed by Kōichi Ishikawa, who co-founded the film production group 'Heisei Nanook' with producer Dai Miyazawa, this feature debut took two years to conceive and three years to complete, winning the Semi-Grand Prix at the 13th Shitamachi Film Festival. Starring Mayu Tano, Tō Shimoegō, and Takano Kōga.
title:偶然と想像: Trivial love talk between best friends, a student seeking guidance from a professor, female friends reuniting after 20 years... A first 'short story collection' woven from three tales themed around 'coincidence.' With a small production system ensuring ample rehearsal and shooting time, it carefully captures the actors' light yet delicate expressions. Won the Silver Bear Grand Jury Prize at the 71st Berlin International Film Festival.
title:偶然と想像濱⼝⻯介監督特集上映突然、偶然、必然: Trivial love talk between best friends, a student seeking guidance from a professor, female friends reuniting after 20 years... A first 'short story collection' woven from three tales themed around 'coincidence.' With a small production system ensuring ample rehearsal and shooting time, it carefully captures the actors' light yet delicate expressions. Won the Silver Bear Grand Jury Prize at the 71st Berlin International Film Festival.
title:僕のなかのブラウニー:
A touching human drama that follows a boy who lost his younger sister in a disaster and the people around him, told through a warm and compassionate lens.

Kazuki Morimoto, a fifth-grader who lost his sister in an earthquake several years ago, has moved to a new town with his single father, Yosuke, who runs a ramen shop. However, Kazuki struggles to fit in at school and with his new surroundings. One day, after learning about the existence of fairies called "Brownies," Kazuki begins to truly believe that his sister didn't die, but was instead spirited away by them. He sets out on a quest to find the Brownies. While those around him are bewildered by his behavior, his classmate Toko Izumi decides to help him, joined by her relative, a translator named Daisuke Izumi. Eventually, sparked by a lie from a "young carer" named Sota, Kazuki embarks on a journey to find the Brownies. Toko, Sota, and a truant boy named Masato follow after him.

Ayaki Hirano, known for the NHK morning drama series *The Tiger and Her Wings*, stars as the protagonist Kazuki. Junnosuke Taguchi plays Daisuke, the translator who holds the key to the story, while comedian Akira 100% portrays Kazuki’s father, Yosuke. The screenplay is written by Yuiko Miura (*Memories of Tomorrow*), and director Yuta Soma, who has created numerous short films centered on the theme of "children and social issues," makes his feature film directorial debut.
title:億万長者の不都合な終末: A thriller dripping with black humor that depicts the collapse of capitalist society following the outbreak of a mysterious disease called "Rich Flu" that only infects the wealthy. Directed and written by Galder Gaztelu-Urrutia of the "The Platform" series, which sharply depicted social inequality, it thrillingly portrays the chaos brought about by a reversal of values. Laura, a high-ranking producer at a streaming platform company, prioritizes her career over her family and is on the verge of success in the glamorous film industry. But just then, a mysterious disease called "Rich Flu" suddenly spreads worldwide, killing wealthy people one after another. As wealth transforms from a symbol of success into a "mark of elimination," capitalist society collapses and the world descends into chaos. In this extreme situation, Laura makes a decision. Mary Elizabeth Winstead, known for films like "Gemini Man" and "Birds of Prey," plays the career-driven Laura who neglects her family. Raf Spall, who has appeared in major works like "Life of Pi" and "Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom," plays Tony, her husband who is exasperated with her yet gets caught up in the unprecedented pandemic alongside her. Timothy Spall, known for the "Harry Potter" series and "Mr. Turner," plays the billionaire Sebastian Snail.
title:光る校庭:
A story of one summer, told with a warm perspective, about the meeting of a boy contemplating death and a boy suffering from a serious illness, and how they and their families gradually move forward. Up-and-coming director Kazushi Higa set the film in his hometown of Toyota City, Aichi Prefecture.

Tomoya Oba, whose father was declared dead after going missing, moves from Tokyo to his mother’s family home in Toyota City during the summer of his fifth year in elementary school. A new life begins with his mother, who has yet to accept her husband's death, his reliable older sister, and his cheerful grandfather. At his new school, Tomoya meets Tsubasa Nishikawa, a classmate battling a serious illness. While feeling a sense of unease toward the teacher and classmates who treat the frail Tsubasa with excessive caution, Tomoya grows closer to him. Tsubasa’s presence begins to awaken a new perspective on life and death within Tomoya.

The film stars Yumi Adachi as Tomoya’s mother and Ken Mitsuishi as his grandfather.
title:免許返納!?: A comedy starring Hiroshi Tachi, depicting a 70-year-old movie star caught up in a major uproar over surrendering his driver's license. Nanjo Hiroshi, who has enjoyed a smooth acting career and recently won numerous film awards for art films, secretly longs to appear in action movies. When his longtime actor friend Ozaki Makoto gets into a motorcycle accident, Nanjo is asked by the media for comment as a fellow actor of the same generation. His remarks admonishing Ozaki unexpectedly attract public attention, and the narrative takes on a life of its own, involving his manager and family, and being interpreted in ways far from his original intent. Although Nanjo wants to continue performing action scenes with cars and motorcycles, those around him expect him to surrender his license, plunging him into the biggest crisis of his life. Hiroshi Tachi comically plays actor Nanjo Hiroshi, the same name as the character he played in the 1994 film "License!". Nishino Nanase plays his manager Kawauna Mai, who is thrown into chaos by Nanjo; Kurokawa Sooya plays young man Kugami Ryo, whose life changes dramatically after meeting Nanjo; Yoshida Kotaro plays Mita Atsushi, the president of Nanjo's talent agency; and Uzaki Ryudo plays Ozaki Makoto, an actor friend who built an era alongside Nanjo. Directed by Kawai Yuji of "Kaguya-sama: Love Is War" fame, with screenplay by Hayashi Tamio of "From the Land of Love to the Land of Sorrow".
