title:八月十五日の動乱: On August 6, 1945, the atomic bomb was dropped on Hiroshima, and Japan's defeat became all but certain. The Prime Minister's secretary, Nakajima, sounds out senior statesmen about accepting the Potsdam Declaration. But this peace faction's moves provoke the resistance-minded military officers. Unable to persuade the army and out of options, the Prime Minister petitions for an Imperial Conference to be held.
title:六つの顔:
Director Isshin Inudo (*Josee, the Tiger and the Fish*, *The Floating Castle*) presents a documentary following Living National Treasure and Kyogen master Nomura Mansaku. A leading figure in Kyogen—a traditional Japanese performing art with a history of over 650 years—Mansaku continues to take the stage even today, with a career spanning more than 90 years. Following his receipt of the Order of Culture in 2023, a commemorative performance was held in June 2024, where he performed "Kawakami," a masterpiece he has polished as his lifework.

The film follows him through that special day of performance while employing a bold yet delicate approach to explore his artistic realm, using animation to depict the "six faces" Mansaku envisions when reflecting on his past. In addition to Mansaku himself speaking on his devotion to Kyogen, the film features interviews with his son, Nomura Mansai, and grandson, Nomura Yuki. Furthermore, the camera captures the majestic, primordial scenery of Kongo-ji Temple in Kawakami Village, Nara—the setting of "Kawakami"—bringing Mansaku’s long-pursued worldview to the screen alongside his supreme artistry.

The animation is handled by Koji Yamamura, who was nominated for an Academy Award for Best Animated Short Film for *Mt. Head*, with narration by actor Joe Odagiri. Nomura Mansaku and Nomura Mansai served as supervisors for the film.
title:共に、世界一へ デフサッカー日本代表の軌跡: Together, to the Top of the World: Japan National Deaf Soccer Team... Watch related works: THE FIRST SLAM DUNK, Mixed Doubles, Let's Go, JETS! (The True Story of High School Girls Who Conquered America with Cheer Dance), Creed II, I, Tonya, King Richard, Creed, OVER DRIVE, Ping Pong, Minding the Gap.
title:兵隊やくざ: An entertainment film based on Arima Yorichika's original work "Kisaburo Ichidai," adapted by Kikushima Ryuzo and directed by Masumura Yasuzo. Its success led to a series of nine films. The dynamic duo of the outrageous protagonist played by Katsu Shintaro and the intellectual officer played by Tamura Takahiro are the highlight.
title:兵隊やくざ: An entertainment film based on Arima Yorichika's original work "Kisaburo Ichidai," adapted by Kikushima Ryuzo and directed by Masumura Yasuzo. Its success led to a series of nine films. The dynamic duo of the outrageous protagonist played by Katsu Shintaro and the intellectual officer played by Tamura Takahiro are the highlight.
title:冬の旅: A film by renowned French filmmaker Agnès Varda, tracing the steps of a young girl who freezes to death after wandering, which won the Golden Lion, the top prize, at the 42nd Venice International Film Festival in 1985. In winter in southern France, the body of an 18-year-old girl, Mona, is found frozen to death in a roadside ditch in the countryside. The film traces Mona's journey over the final weeks of her life as she hitchhikes aimlessly and continues a solitary journey, through the testimonies of the people she met on the road. Starring Sandrine Bonnaire (from "The Hairdresser's Husband"), with co-stars Macha Méril (from "Belle de Jour"), Stéphane Freiss (from "The Five Senses"), and Yolande Moreau (from "Séraphine"). It recorded over one million admissions in France at the time, becoming Varda's biggest hit.
title:冬よ: A documentary in which the confessions of East German women illuminate the contradictions of the regime on the eve of the fall of the "Wall." This film captures the lives of women from various backgrounds living in East Germany just before the collapse of the Berlin Wall. The breakthrough work of director Helke Misselwitz, it features women speaking candidly about their lives before the camera; their words, filled with hardship and regret, bring to light a quiet critique of the socialist ideal of gender equality. Winner of the Silver Dove at the 1988 International Leipzig Festival for Documentary and Animated Film (DOK Leipzig).
title:別れる決心: From Park Chan-wook, director of 'Oldboy' and 'The Handmaiden', comes a suspense drama about a detective investigating a murder and the victim's wife, a suspect to whom he finds himself drawn. When a man falls to his death from a mountain peak, Detective Hae-joon suspects it may be murder rather than an accident. He focuses on the victim's mysterious wife, Sore, but she has an alibi. As the investigation proceeds, Hae-joon finds himself attracted to Sore, and she develops special feelings for him too. Just when a lead emerges and the case seems solved... Park Hae-il plays Hae-joon, Tang Wei plays Sore, with Lee Jung-hyun and Go Kyung-pyo in supporting roles. The film won the Best Director award at the 75th Cannes Film Festival in 2022.
title:創造と神秘のサグラダ・ファミリア: A documentary about the Sagrada Família, the century-spanning architectural project conceived by Catalan architect Antoni Gaudí, under construction since 1882 for over 130 years. Registered as a World Heritage Site in 2005, the Sagrada Família continues to captivate over three million visitors annually from around the world. As construction continues towards a projected completion in 2026, computers have been introduced on site, and staff repeatedly experiment to determine how to best reproduce Gaudí's vision with current technology. Incorporating footage from inside the site, inaccessible to outsiders, and interviews with architectural staff, the film unravels the project surrounding the Sagrada Família, including how the construction period, once said to require '300 years until completion,' has been shortened to a projected completion in 2026.
title:劇場版 とっとこハム太郎 ハムハムハムージャ! 幻のプリンセス: Hamtaro had a dream. It was a dream of a beautiful hamster princess... 'Help me... Please... Come here quickly...' The princess was trapped inside a soap bubble, tears in her eyes. Even after waking up, Hamtaro can't stop worrying about the princess from his dream. So, he and the Ham-Hams decide to go rescue her. They arrive at the 'Hamja Kingdom,' the homeland of hamsters with a history of 8686 in the Ham Calendar, surrounded by desert. The sky is dark, and the hamsters living there seem downcast. No wonder—Princess Shera of the Hamja Kingdom, who was engaged to Prince Hamuha of the neighboring country, has been kidnapped by a mysterious cat that suddenly appeared and trapped her just like in Hamtaro's dream. That cat wants to marry Princess Shera and take over the kingdom! At this rate, the princess and the kingdom are in danger! Can Hamtaro and the Ham-Hams save the princess and protect the hamsters' homeland? An adventure of love and courage begins now.
title:劇場版 とっとこハム太郎 ハムハムランド大冒険: It's Laura's birthday. Hamtaro has prepared a present, but Laura ignores him, and in frustration he runs away from home. Seeing this, the Ham-Hams are about to help Hamtaro run away when a mysterious fairy hamster appears and takes everyone to Ham-Ham Land, a dream world where only hamsters live. But Hamtaro can't stop thinking about Laura. Hearing from the fairy hamster about 'magic sunflower seeds' that allow hamsters to talk to humans, Hamtaro sets out on an adventure to find them. But what awaits?
title:劇場版 アイカツ スターズ！: The theatrical film of the TV anime 'Aikatsu Stars!', which began airing in April 2016 as a new series following the popular idol anime 'Aikatsu!'. It depicts the struggles of girls, including the protagonist Yume Nijino, who enrolls at Yotsusei Gakuen aiming to become the top idol. In this first theatrical film of 'Aikatsu Stars!', the story is set on a southern island where the characters come for an event. It revolves around the rumored 'Legendary Dress' said to be sleeping on the island, and depicts the friendship between Yume and Laura Sakuraba, as well as the school's top four-idol unit 'S4' taking the stage together. The short film 'Aikatsu! The Targeted Magical Aikatsu! Card' is shown simultaneously.
title:劇場版 仮面ライダーディケイド オールライダー対大ショッカー: Kamen Rider Decade, aka Kadoya Tsukasa, arrives in a "certain world." In this world, for some reason, the photos Tsukasa takes do not distort the image. Suddenly, a certain Western-style mansion comes to mind. Following faint memories, Tsukasa reaches the mansion, where he meets a girl who calls herself his sister, Kadoya Sayo. Tsukasa becomes convinced this is his own world. However, even in this world, the "collapse of worlds" is progressing. Sayo's servant, Tsukikage Nobuhiko, claims that the cause of the world's collapse lies in the Riders born in each world, and declares that to stop it, they must decide on a single "strongest Rider."
title:劇場版 仮面ライダー響鬼と7人の戦鬼: In present-day Japan, the giant demonic monster Orochi appears on a coast. Hibiki and Asumu rush to fight it, but Hibiki is defeated by Orochi and falls into a coma. Asumu seeks clues to save Hibiki in the Takeshi's ancient documents describing Orochi, but there he finds the name "Asumu," the same as his own, along with the stories of Oni... The ancient document tells of a village in the Sengoku period. There, Orochi demanded a human sacrifice every year. When Asumu's acquaintance Hitoe is chosen as the sacrifice, Asumu consults Tobei Tachibana to find a way to save her. Following the idea of asking an Oni for help, Asumu and the others set out to search for an Oni.
title:劇場版 魔法少女まどか☆マギカ [前編] 始まりの物語: The first part of a two-part theatrical film reconstruction of the 12-episode TV anime 'Puella Magi Madoka Magica,' which aired from January to April 2011. One day, a mysterious transfer student named Homura Akemi arrives at the middle school attended by Madoka Kaname, an ordinary girl living a mundane life. After school that day, guided by a mysterious voice, Madoka encounters a strange creature calling itself Kyubey, who tells her, 'I want you to make a contract with me and become a magical girl.' The staff from the TV series, who built its unique worldview, including chief director Akiyuki Shinbo, screenwriter Gen Urobuchi (Nitroplus), and the otherworldly space design team Gekidan Inu Curry, have reunited for this film.
title:劇場版 ほんとうにあった怖い話 ゾク変な間取り:
The second installment in the omnibus horror series "The Movie: True Scary Stories - Strange Floor Plans," which depicts inexplicable events occurring in houses with bizarre layouts.

Director Matsumura and cameraman Fujii are reviewing footage for a documentary following Rinko Soma, a "Seikashi" (House Organizer)—a professional who specializes in "arranging" homes. As Soma "loosens" the pillars and floors of a house where a gruesome incident once occurred, the camera captures something unexpected (Episode 1: "The House Organizer").

Okudera, who works for a real estate management company, tracks the whereabouts of a missing rookie employee named Mishima to a vacant house that has failed to find a buyer. On the floor plan of that house, suspicious marks—not standard legal symbols—were inscribed (Episode 2: "Site Investigation").

Having lost his fiancée Mari just before their wedding, Ohno spends his final moments in the room where they were supposed to share a peaceful life together... (Episode 3: "Newlywed Life").

Funyao Harada of the comedy duo "Danbi Ramucho," Koji Ito of "Lanjatai," and solo artist Sui star in each respective episode.
title:劇場版 ロッキンミュージカル シン・シャドウブラウン＆ブラックパイレ:
"Rockin' Musical: The Adventures of Shin Shadow Brown & Black Pirates" is a filmed theatrical release of the rock musical directed, staged, structured, and composed by musician Diamond Yukai.

The project traces its roots back to 1992, when Yukai conceived the story and music for "Shadow Brown & Black Pirates," a concept album released under the theme of "Rock x Adventure x Musical Theater." In 2025, 33 years after its debut, the original band members reunited to reconstruct the work into a rock musical that seamlessly blends music and drama. Capturing the performance held in Tokyo on March 15, 2025, this film brings to the big screen the exhilarating tale of a rockin' pirate band sailing through time and space.

Shadow Brown and his crew arrive at Jenny Island, a place where music has been banned. Though the island was once overflowing with song, all sound and smiles have since vanished, leaving the hearts of its people frozen in silence. After meeting a young girl who has lost her hope and light, Shadow Brown rises up to restore the joy of music to the world.

title:劇場版 宇野昌磨アイスショー「Ice Brave 新横浜 Speci:
This theatrical release captures "Ice Brave," the first ice show produced by professional figure skater Shoma Uno, specifically filmed during its final performance at the KOSÉ Shin-Yokohama Skate Center on February 1, 2026.

Shoma Uno, a world-class athlete who won silver at the 2018 PyeongChang Olympics and bronze at the 2022 Beijing Olympics before retiring from competition in May 2024, has crafted a show that reimagines his iconic competitive programs as elevated performances that only he can deliver today. Highlights include a collaborative performance with his former coach, world-renowned Swiss skater Stéphane Lambiel, and his first-ever ice dance with popular skater Marin Honda. Their program, "Four Seasons," was a special performance exclusive to the Shin-Yokohama show.

The entire production was captured using nine high-definition 4K cameras, including drones, to ensure every moment was caught in exquisite detail. With audio mixed in 5.1ch surround sound for the theatrical release, this film brings the beauty and power of the ice show to the big screen for an immersive experience.
title:劇場版 旅人検視官 道場修作: The first film adaptation of the popular travel suspense series "Traveling Forensic Examiner: Shusaku Michiba," a BS Nippon TV original two-hour suspense drama starring Takeshi Naito. The story follows Shusaku Michiba, a retired former Metropolitan Police Department forensic examiner, who encounters incidents during his travels while holding his late wife's notebook, and delves into the truth. After retiring, former forensic examiner Shusaku Michiba travels across Japan with his late wife's notebook. Visiting Matsuyama and Uchiko in Ehime Prefecture, he meets people who love haiku and expects to spend a peaceful time. However, the shadow of an unsolved case from 20 years ago hangs over the area. As fragmented memories and people's feelings intertwine, Michiba draws closer to the truth that connects the past and present. Takeshi Naito reprises his role as the protagonist Michiba, joined by a talented cast including Machiko Hada, Ken Ishiguro, Akira Emoto, and Kotaro Satomi. Additionally, Kaho Minami plays Michiba's late wife Yumiko, a character who did not appear in the TV series, shedding light on Michiba's largely untold past. Directed by Ryosuke Kanezaki, who also directed the sixth installment of the TV series.
title:劇場版 盗るな撮れ 罪と少年とケーブルTV: The Movie: Don't Steal, Shoot – Sin, Boys, and the Cell... View related works: Minding the Gap, FLEE, The Biggest Little Farm, The Act of Killing, Navalny, Citizenfour, Assassins, Documentary of Baby Assassins, The Yokai's Grandson, The Unnameable Dance.
title:劇場版 米寿の伝言:
A heartwarming comedy depicting the chaos that ensues when a deceased grandfather and his grandson swap bodies. The film is an adaptation of the stage play "The Message of the 88th Birthday," which garnered attention for featuring Masakatsu Nishimoto—an 81-year-old former teacher who had once given up on acting—alongside his two real-life grandsons, both professional actors. Now 85, Nishimoto takes on his first leading film role.

Yonezo, an eccentric inventor, passes away just before his 88th birthday. While his grandson Kyohei and younger brother Kippei are sorting through the inventions their grandfather left behind, a malfunction causes the grandfather in the coffin and Kippei to swap souls. Their joy at reuniting with Yonezo is short-lived when the device breaks, making it impossible to switch them back. Kyohei scrambles to save his brother before the cremation, but...

Kentaro Nishimoto of "Popran" and Ginjiro Nishimoto of the TV drama "Mr. Hiiragi's Homeroom" reprise their roles as Kyohei and Kippei from the stage version, supported by Kasumi Hasegawa, Hina Yamada, Nakagawa Paradise, and Kenta Hamano. Masakatsu Nishimoto's real-life daughter, Hiroko Nishimoto, serves as producer, while screenwriter Gaku Kawasaki ("Walking Time: Waiting for That Day") makes his feature-length directorial debut.
title:劇場版 魔法少女まどか☆マギカ 前編 始まりの物語: The first part of a two-part theatrical film reconstruction of the 12-episode TV anime 'Puella Magi Madoka Magica,' which aired from January to April 2011. One day, a mysterious transfer student named Homura Akemi arrives at the middle school attended by Madoka Kaname, an ordinary girl living a mundane life. After school that day, guided by a mysterious voice, Madoka encounters a strange creature calling itself Kyubey, who tells her, 'I want you to make a contract with me and become a magical girl.' title:劇場版「HAMAツアーズpresents “おもてなしライブ” Sp:
"HAMA Tours presents 'Omotenashi Live' Sparkle" brings the live event featuring the cast of the mobile game *18TRIP* to the big screen.

Set in near-future Yokohama, *18TRIP* is a "near-future hospitality adventure" where players work to revitalize the tourism industry of HAMA's 18 wards—once a premier special tourism zone that has since fallen into decline—alongside a colorful cast of tourism mayors. To commemorate the game's first anniversary, its first-ever live event, "HAMA Tours presents 'Omotenashi Live' Sparkle," was held on February 21 and 22, 2026, at Pacifico Yokohama in Kanagawa.

This film is a compilation of the three performances held over the two-day event, featuring a curated selection of highlights and performances from each show.
title:劇場版アイカツスターズ！: The theatrical film of the TV anime 'Aikatsu Stars!', which began airing in April 2016 as a new series following the popular idol anime 'Aikatsu!'. It depicts the struggles of girls, including the protagonist Yume Nijino, who enrolls at Yotsusei Gakuen aiming to become the top idol. In this first theatrical film of 'Aikatsu Stars!', the story is set on a southern island where the characters come for an event. It revolves around the rumored 'Legendary Dress' said to be sleeping on the island, and depicts the friendship between Yume and Laura Sakuraba, as well as the school's top four-idol unit 'S4' taking the stage together. The short film 'Aikatsu! The Targeted Magical Aikatsu! Card' is shown simultaneously.
title:劇場版モノノ怪 第三章 蛇神: The concluding chapter of the theatrical trilogy based on the TV anime "Mononoke," itself a spin-off from the "Bakeneko" segment of the 2006 Fuji TV Noitamina omnibus anime "Ayakashi." It delves into the greatest secret long hidden within the Ooku (the shogun's harem) and depicts the fierce battle between the protagonist, the Medicine Seller, and the most fearsome mononoke of all, the Serpent God, which threatens to shake the Ooku to its foundations. After a deadly struggle with the Medicine Seller, who carries a exorcism sword, and a Tengu umbrella, followed by a decisive battle with the Fire Rat, peace finally seems to have returned to the Ooku. However, the Medicine Seller senses a lingering presence and remains on guard. Around this time, the shogun's official wife, Sachiko, gives birth to a long-awaited son, but the infant soon dies. Sachiko, who had hoped to change her formal marriage to the shogun by bearing an heir, is physically and emotionally exhausted and becomes entangled in a conspiracy that could overturn the Ooku's very existence. Hokuto Mizorogi, the priest of the "Mizusama" faith within the Ooku, watches the events unfold with a solemn expression. At the same time, unnatural earthquakes, as if a giant creature is crawling, occur frequently within the Ooku, and bizarre incidents happen where maids are twisted and crushed to death. Before the Medicine Seller, who rushes to the scene, appears the mononoke Serpent God, taking the form of a giant snake.

title:功夫: A wuxia fantasy action film directed by Taiwanese director Giddens Ko of 'The Secrets in the Lattice' and 'You Are the Apple of My Eye,' starring Ko Chen-tung, who collaborated with Ko on those two previous films. Director Giddens Ko, also active as a novelist, adapts his own internet-published novel 'Kung Fu' for the screen, weaving in homages to Hong Kong and Taiwanese wuxia films from the 1980s and 90s throughout. Underachieving high school student Yuan Zai and his best friend A Yi encounter a mysterious drifter, Huang Jun, who has awakened from a 500-year slumber. Witnessing Huang Jun's overwhelming martial arts prowess as a kung fu master, Yuan Zai and A Yi become his disciples. Their classmate Yi Jing, on whom Yuan Zai has a secret crush, also joins their training. They soon learn of the centuries-old feud between Huang Jun and his junior disciple Lan Jin, and uncover a momentous secret hidden within 'kung fu' that could shake heaven and earth. Ko Chen-tung plays Yuan Zai, Berant Zhu of 'Black Education' plays A Yi, Wang Jing of 'The Secrets in the Lattice' and 'The Return of the Condor Heroes' plays Yi Jing, veteran actor Tai Li-len plays the mysterious kung fu master Huang Jun, and Liu Kuan-ting of 'The Girl Who Robbed Time' plays Huang Jun's nemesis Lan Jin.
title:北浦兄弟: A dark-toned road movie that blends humor and pathos to depict two social outcasts—a pair of brothers—as they spiral through a series of irreversible blunders. Sota, a middle-aged man living a reclusive life under his art teacher father, accidentally kills him in a sudden turn of events. Alongside his estranged younger brother Akira, Sota struggles to cover up their father's death, even as the two remain constantly at odds. However, nothing goes according to plan. As they drag their uncle and their father’s lover into the mess, the situation continues to spiral out of control. Masaaki Nakano (*Ojisan, Gekidan Hajimemashita*) stars as the elder brother Sota, while Hirota Otsuka (*The Moon*) plays the younger brother Akira. The film is directed by Masaki Tsujino (*Woman of the Kappa*).
title:医の倫理と戦争: This documentary delves into the issues facing modern medicine while tracing the dark history of medical professionals' complicity in war crimes. At the root of the various problems plaguing Japan's contemporary medical landscape lies the reality of medical professionals' participation in World War II war crimes and the subsequent cover-up. Doctors belonging to "Unit 731," led by Shiro Ishii, transformed the "findings" gained through human experimentation into personal achievements, rising to the center of Japan's post-war medical establishment. Confronting this dark history, there are medical professionals who continue to speak out against war under the banner of "medical ethics." This film uncovers the truth of Unit 731 while documenting the current efforts of medical professionals as they tackle various issues. Directed by Sosuke Yamamoto (*Monshen*).
title:原発をとめた裁判長 そして原発をとめる農家たち: This documentary follows a former chief judge who campaigns to warn of the dangers of nuclear power, and the people of Fukushima who are reviving the agriculture they once abandoned due to radiation through solar power. In 2014, Chief Judge Hideaki Higuchi of the Fukui District Court issued a landmark ruling ordering the suspension of operations at the Ohi Nuclear Power Plant. Following his retirement, he began a mission to explain the structural vulnerabilities common to all nuclear plants in Japan. Hiroyuki Kawai, a leading lawyer in nuclear litigation, launches a new legal battle based on the "Higuchi Theory," which argues that nuclear plants are structurally incapable of withstanding the country's frequent earthquakes. Meanwhile, in Fukushima, farmer Megumi Kondo, who was forced out of business by radioactive contamination, finds a path to agricultural revival through "solar sharing"—generating electricity above active farmland. With the help of environmental scholar Tetsuya Iida, she launches one of Japan’s largest agrivoltaic projects. The film is directed by Hiroyasu Obara, director of *Voices of the Abandoned*.
title:友だちのうちはどこ?: An Iranian film that vividly captures a boy's journey to find his friend's house to return a precious notebook he accidentally took home, bringing director Abbas Kiarostami international fame. At a primary school in the village of Koker in northern Iran, Mohammad is severely scolded by his teacher for doing his homework on a piece of paper instead of a notebook and is told he will be expelled if it happens again. However, his best friend Ahmad, who sits next to him, accidentally takes Mohammad's notebook home. Panicked that Mohammad will be expelled without his notebook, Ahmad searches for his friend's house in a distant neighboring village to return it, but struggles to find it... A digital remastered version was screened as part of the special program "And Kiarostami Continues" (from October 16, 2021, at Eurospace in Tokyo and other venues).

A digital remastered version was screened as part of the special program "And Kiarostami Continues" (from October 16, 2021, at Eurospace in Tokyo and other venues).
title:友だちの恋人: The sixth film in Éric Rohmer's "Comedies and Proverbs" series. Set in a new town on the outskirts of Paris, it lightly depicts the romantic affairs of four men and women. Blanche, a shy woman working at city hall, and Léa, a pragmatic female student, hit it off and become friends. Léa lives with her boyfriend Fabien, but their relationship isn't going well. Meanwhile, Blanche develops feelings for Alexandre, a playboy and friend of Fabien's, but her timid nature prevents her from confessing. Eventually, Fabien finds himself drawn to Blanche... The colorful 1980s fashion is also a highlight.
title:受忍の国 報道1930劇場版:
The Land of Endurance: Houdou 1930 The Movie
Watch related works: Minding the Gap, FLEE, The Biggest Little Farm, The Act of Killing, Navalny, Citizenfour, Assassins, Documentary of Baby Assassins, The Spectre's Grandson, The Unnameable Dance
title:口に関するアンケート: A film adaptation of the bestselling novel 'A Survey About the Mouth' by author Senkin, who sparked the mockumentary horror boom with 'About a Certain Place in the Kinki Region.' Published in 2024, the palm-sized, 60-page story became a huge sensation on social media for delivering a solid scare in such a short format. Directed by Takashi Shimizu of the 'Ju-On' series, it marks Rihito Itagaki's first solo lead role in a live-action film. A group of university students hear a rumor about a 'cursed tree' in a cemetery known as a haunted spot and visit it for a test of courage. The next day, one of the group members mysteriously disappears. Since then, inexplicable phenomena begin to occur around the students who visited the cemetery, and they are gradually driven into a corner. Guided by the baffling testimonies of the five students, a terrifying truth emerges. Rihito Itagaki plays Shota Murai, one of the university students. The cast also includes Keito Tsuna as Tatsuya, Ai Yoshikawa as An, MOMONA (ME:I) as Mirei, Shuto Mori (BUDDiiS) as Horita, a student who visits the cemetery for fun, Tomoki Nishiyama (TAGRIGHT) as Kawase, who is forcibly taken to the cemetery by Horita, Shido Nakamura as Detective Kusabe, who pursues the missing student, and Tokio Emoto as journalist Nishi.
title:口蹄疫から生きのびた豚:
A dark fantasy anime inspired by the mass culling of pigs during the 2010 foot-and-mouth disease outbreak in South Korea. The film allegorically depicts the intersection of two fates—a pig that survived the cull and a man driven to despair by human society—weaving in social issues such as the spread of disease, environmental destruction, bullying, lookism, and generational divides through a variety of expressive styles.

In modern South Korea, as countless pigs are slaughtered following an outbreak of foot-and-mouth disease, a single pig with an extraordinary instinct for survival rises from a mass grave where it was buried alive. The pig longs to become human: "To survive, I want to become a 'human'—a creature of absolute power. I will stop at nothing to achieve it." Meanwhile, Choi Jong-seok, a man who has endured brutal bullying since childhood, wishes for the opposite: "I want to cast aside my life as a human and become a 'beast' instead." These two destinies, never meant to meet, intertwine like a spiral, leading them toward an unimaginable transformation.

The film is directed by South Korea's Huh Bum-wook, marking his second feature-length work.
title:台湾ハリウッド:
Set against the backdrop of the Taiwanese film industry between 1955 and 1981—a period that saw the production of numerous "B-movies"—this comedy portrays the filmmakers of the era who staked their dreams on the silver screen. 

An 18-year-old grandson cares for his grandmother, who is living with dementia. His grandfather, a screenwriter, tells
title:名探偵コナン ハイウェイの堕天使: The 29th theatrical film in the nationally hit series "Detective Conan", based on the manga by Gosho Aoyama. Conan, Ran, Sonoko, and Kogoro, along with motorcycle enthusiast Sera Masumi, encounter a mysterious black motorcycle speeding out of control while on their way to the "Kanagawa Motorcycle Festival" in Yokohama's Minato Mirai district. Kanagawa Prefectural Police traffic officer Hagiwara Chiharu chases the black bike but narrowly misses catching it. Conan and the others arrive at the festival venue, where a new white motorcycle called "Angel" equipped with cutting-edge technology is being unveiled. News then arrives that the runaway black bike has appeared in Tokyo. After evading the Metropolitan Police Department's pursuit, the black bike, whose body closely resembles the "Angel", is dubbed the "Black Angel" or "Lucifer", and the chase continues. In Chiharu's mind, memories of her younger brother Hagiwara Kenji and his colleague Matsuda Jinpei flash by. Hagiwara Chiharu, praised by Ran as the "Goddess of the Wind" for her driving skills, makes her first appearance in a theatrical film, engaging in intense motorcycle action against the mysterious black bike "Lucifer". Chiharu is voiced by Miyuki Sawashiro, who took over the role from Atsuko Tanaka, who passed away in August 2024. Guest voice actors Ryusei Yokohama and Mei Hata make their voice acting debuts. Directed by Takahiro Hasui, who handled direction for "Detective Conan: Black Iron Submarine".

title:名無し: A film adaptation of the psycho-violent manga "Nanashi" by Sato Jiro—who is active not only as an actor but also as a screenwriter and film director—marking his first work based on a manga. Sato stars and wrote the script, with Hideo Shijo of "Bad Summer" directing. A brutal murder occurs at a family restaurant in the afternoon. Security cameras capture a bald middle-aged man who appears to be the culprit, but he holds no weapon. The footage records the bizarre sight of people spurting blood and collapsing just from the man approaching and lightly touching them. Investigating police identify the bald man as "Taro Yamada," who was questioned for shoplifting 11 years earlier. When investigators rush to Yamada's home address, they find a decomposed female corpse. Sato plays the protagonist, serial killer Yamada. Takaya Kamikawa plays Teruo, the patrol officer who becomes the namesake for the nameless orphaned young Yamada. MEGUMI plays Hanako Yamada, who grew up with Yamada in the same children's home and lives with him. Kuroudo Yashima plays Detective Kunieda, who works tirelessly to stop Yamada.
title:名無しの子:
Director Ryo Takeuchi, an influencer in China known for documentaries like "The Yangtze River" that capture the nation's reality, turns his lens toward the Japanese orphans left behind in China.

1945, the end of World War II. Tens of thousands of young children living in former Manchuria were left behind, losing their nationality and becoming "nameless children." Yet, there were Chinese foster parents who, despite their own poverty, raised these orphans as their own children.

Traveling between Japan and China, this documentary features interviews with 100 people across three generations, including the orphans and their families. It portrays the harsh realities of those still at the mercy of fate 80 years later: the first generation who returned to Japan in the 1990s only to be driven to suicide attempts after failing to integrate into society; the second generation who, facing discrimination in both countries, formed the quasi-gang "Chinese Dragon" as a means of resistance; and the third generation who hide their mixed roots, unable to reveal their true identities even to their closest friends.
title:君と僕の5分: Set in early 2000s South Korea, when Japanese pop culture was restricted, this coming-of-age drama tenderly follows a shy transfer student and a popular class president who bond over J-Pop. In 2001, Gyung-hwan transfers to a high school in Daegu, Korea's most conservative city. A huge fan of then-taboo Japanese music and anime, he secretly listens to Japanese songs on his MP3 player during lunch. Teased as an 'otaku' by classmates, he discovers that his deskmate, class president Jae-min, also secretly loves Japanese culture. Sharing earphones on the bus after school while listening to J-Pop, they gradually grow closer. One day, Gyung-hwan confesses a secret to Jae-min, but afterward, Jae-min's attitude suddenly changes. Making his feature debut, director Eom Ha-nul wrote the script based on his own teenage experiences as a fan of Japanese culture, weaving in diverse Japanese pop culture from the 1990s. Shim Hyun-seo, a child actor known for 'The King of Pigs', plays transfer student Gyung-hwan, and Hyun Woo-seok, from 'The School Nurse Files', plays class president Jae-min. Gong Min-jung ('Kim Ji-young: Born 1982') and Lee Dong-hwi ('The Roundup: Punishment') co-star.
title:君と僕の５分: Set in early 2000s South Korea, when Japanese pop culture was restricted, this coming-of-age drama tenderly follows a shy transfer student and a popular class president who bond over J-Pop. In 2001, Gyung-hwan transfers to a high school in Daegu, Korea's most conservative city. A huge fan of then-taboo Japanese music and anime, he secretly listens to Japanese songs on his MP3 player during lunch. Teased as an 'otaku' by classmates, he discovers that his deskmate, class president Jae-min, also secretly loves Japanese culture. Making his feature debut, director Eom Ha-nul wrote the script based on his own teenage experiences as a fan of Japanese culture, weaving in diverse Japanese pop culture from the 1990s. Shim Hyun-seo, a child actor known for 'The King of Pigs', plays transfer student Gyung-hwan, and Hyun Woo-seok, from 'The School Nurse Files', plays class president Jae-min. Gong Min-jung ('Kim Ji-young: Born 1982') and Lee Dong-hwi ('The Roundup: Punishment') co-star.
title:君と私:
A story of love between high school girls, woven against the backdrop of the Sewol Ferry tragedy.

*The Dream Songs* is set on the day before the Sewol Ferry sinking on April 16, 2014—a disaster that claimed over 300 lives, including 250 students from Ansan’s Danwon High School. Highly acclaimed for its delicately woven screenplay, crafted over seven years, and its meticulous direction that indirectly evokes the tragedy, the film achieved the remarkable feat of winning both Best Screenplay and Best New Director at the 45th Blue Dragon Film Awards, despite being a feature directorial debut.

The film was written and directed by Cho Hyun-chul, an actor known for his brilliant supporting roles in works such as Season 1 of the drama *D.P.* Director Cho elevated his personal experiences into a love story between two high school girls set against the backdrop of the Sewol disaster.

The role of the protagonist Semi, who harbors secret feelings in her heart, is played by Park Hye-su, whose performance in the film *Swing Kids* was widely praised. Starring as Ha-eun, the object of Semi’s affection, is rising star Kim Si-eun, who delivered a powerful performance in Season 2 of the global phenomenon *Squid Game*. The cinematography was handled by DQM, a cutting-edge visual director primarily active in commercials and music videos. The music was composed by Oh Hyuk, the vocalist of the four-piece band HYUKOH, who recently drew significant attention for their performance at the Fuji Rock Festival.

Expanding on Director Cho’s vision of "wanting to blur the boundaries between dream and reality," this unforgettable film is born from a tapestry of ethereal visual beauty and a floating, melancholic sound.
title:君のクイズ: An adaptation of the 2022 bestselling mystery novel "Your Quiz" by Naoki Prize-winning author Satoshi Ogawa. The stage is the grand finale of "Q-1 Grand Prix," a live quiz show with a 10-million-yen prize. As the nation watches with bated breath, Reo Mishima, the "Absolute King of Quizzes," and Kizuna Honjo, "The Man Who Saved the World in His Head," are both one step away from victory. On the final buzzer question, Honjo presses his button before a single character of the question has even been read. To the shock of the audience, he correctly identifies the answer and claims the championship. Unable to hide his bewilderment at this impossible feat, Mishima launches his own investigation to uncover how Honjo achieved a "zero-character correct answer." Tomoya Nakamura stars as the protagonist Reo Mishima, a man of vast knowledge and logical thinking; Ryunosuke Kamiki portrays the enigmatic genius player Kizuna Honjo; and Tsuyoshi Muro plays Yasuhiko Sakata, the show’s producer who will stop at nothing to create a spectacle. Directed by Kohei Yoshino (*Anime Supremacy!*, *The Silent Service*), the film utilizes stylish VFX to depict the labyrinthine thought processes unfolding within a quiz player's mind.
title:君は映画: A youth comedy directed by Makoto Ueda, head of the theater group "Europe Kikaku," known for writing screenplays for numerous hit films like "Summer Time Machine Blues" and "River, Don't Flow On." This is his feature directorial debut, set in the real-life building "Shelbo Shimokitazawa" in Shimokitazawa, employing innovative gimmicks. At the cinema Tollywood on the second floor of "Shelbo Shimokitazawa," Madoka, a playwright from Shimokitazawa, and Kazuma, a band musician from Sangenjaya, each go to see a movie. An impossible structure emerges where each other's events are projected onto the screen as a film. Meanwhile, problems arise at the shops adjacent to the cinema, "Good Heavens" and "Mikazuki Rock." Madoka and Kazuma try to solve the problems using this structure, but their films influence each other, and the situation spirals in unexpected directions. Starring Maria Ito ("Summer Film ni Notte") as Madoka the playwright and Kai Inowaki ("Musicophilia") as Kazuma the band musician. The cast also includes Oshiro Maeda and Hinako Kikuchi as members of Madoka's theater troupe, Suzuyuki Kaneko and Yusuke Mikawa as members of Kazuma's band, Takafumi Imai as a semi-delinquent who frequents "Mikazuki Rock," and the comedy duo "The Geese" as a pair of detectives. Additionally, members of Europe Kikaku, including Gota Ishida, Shintaro Kanamaru, and Riko Fujitani, play unique characters.
title:君は行く先を知らない: A car races across the desolate landscape of Iran. In the back seat, the father entertains his exuberant younger son; in the passenger seat, the mother sways to an old pop song; and in the driver's seat, the eldest son stares silently ahead. While the younger son, unaware of the purpose of the trip, frolics innocently, the family arrives near the Turkish border...
title:君も出世ができる: The pinnacle of Japanese musicals, depicting a salaryman struggling in the battle for foreign tourists in Tokyo just before the Olympics. Throughout the film, talented performers sing and dance, and Frankie's astonishing physical abilities leave you in awe. The grand group dance in 'Man Alone' is especially breathtaking.
title:唯心: The short film collection "Yuishin"—comprising four works starting with "20db" (produced and released in 2019), the second film "breath," the third "Sky, White, Waves, and Mother," and the fourth "Blue and White"—will be screened at Kichijoji Uplink for one week from Friday, June 5 to Thursday, June 11, 2026!
title:喜劇 逆転旅行: Conductor Goichi (Frankie) on the Tohoku Main Line receives passionate advances from his childhood friend, geisha Sakura (Baisho), but secretly has his eye on another woman. The third installment of the 11-film "Travel Series" starring Frankie Sakai, directed by comedy master Segawa.
title:喜劇 駅前漫画: The 15th installment of the 'Ekimaé Series,' which produced 24 films starring Frankie, Morishige, and Bando. Riding the unprecedented manga boom, this film features Frankie as a manga artist and is a legendary oddity, with appearances by 'Obake no Q-taro' and 'Osomatsu-kun' within the story.
title:四つのいのち: Italian filmmaker Michelangelo Frammartino tells the story of four lives that are born and die. Based on the Pythagorean concept of "four transmigrations," the film presents humans, animals, plants, and minerals with equal weight from a fundamentally egalitarian perspective that does not center the human world. After an elderly shepherd quietly dies in a mountain village in Calabria, southern Italy, his young goat dies beside a large fir tree. The tree is cut down for a village festival and eventually becomes charcoal. With no dialogue and long takes, the film captures nature as it is. In Japan, it screened in the natural TIFF section of the 23rd Tokyo International Film Festival in 2010 and was released theatrically in 2011. It will be released in 2026 as part of the special screening series "The Amazing World of Michelangelo Frammartino."
title:四月の余白: Directed by Keisuke Yoshida of "Himeanole" and "Missing," this drama portrays boys who cannot understand pain or common sense, and the adults who continue to confront them head-on. Yoshida wrote the original script based on the juvenile delinquents he encountered during his own sensitive adolescence and the community surrounding them. Nishiken Go, a former half-gray area gangster and ex-convict, runs a full-time residential rehabilitation facility called "Mirai no Sato" in a coastal provincial town. Drawing on his own experiences, Nishiken tackles troubled children with all his might, but his rehabilitation methods, which do not shy away from corporal punishment, are criticized by educators. One day, a middle school teacher named Fuyuko consults him about an uncontrollable student, Kaito, and Yu, who has just been released from a juvenile detention center. Meeting the two, Nishiken instantly sees through Kaito's madness. Kaito's mother, exhausted by his severe domestic violence, decides to entrust her son to "Mirai no Sato." However, Kaito causes trouble with the other residents, escapes, and is arrested for assault. Wataru Ichinose of the Netflix drama "Sanctuary" stars as Nishiken, while the newcomer Hayato Uesaka is cast as the delinquent boy Kaito. Kaho plays middle school teacher Fuyuko, Atsushi Shinohara and Fusako Urabe play Kaito's parents, Iori Wada plays Kaito's delinquent friend Yu, and Nanami Yamazaki and Mansaku Takada play the facility's residents.
title:国宝: A human drama depicting the tumultuous life of a man born into a yakuza family who dedicates his life to the path of art as a Kabuki actor. A talked-about sensation that has taken the Japanese film world by storm, finally screening!
title:土と兵隊［最長版］: One of Tomotaka Tasaka's pre-war masterpieces, this is the longest extant version of the film, produced in 2024 by supplementing the previously held 144-minute version—sourced from returned films—with missing footage from Nikkatsu’s original master (the original length was 155 minutes). The singularity of its depiction, which relentlessly captures the soldiers' march to an almost obsessive degree, is unprecedented and stands out in the history of war cinema. This screening follows the 2024 retrospective "Film Director Tomotaka Tasaka."
title:土曜日の男:
This unique action film follows a man struggling with anger management who unleashes his fury only once a week—on Saturdays—as he takes a stand against a corrupt police officer abusing his power. 

Raised in a coastal town in Andhra Pradesh, India, Surya has been quick-tempered since childhood. His worried mother taught him to record his anger in a notebook rather than acting on it immediately, advising him that if the feeling persists after time has passed, then the anger is truly justified. Even after his mother’s passing, Surya maintains this habit, but with a personal twist: he designates Saturday as the day he finally lets out a week’s worth of pent-up rage. 

Now an adult working as an insurance agent in Hyderabad, Surya leads a seemingly ordinary life, yet his ritualistic Saturday outbursts continue. His path eventually crosses with Inspector Dayanand, a man who treats the local citizens with utter brutality... 

Starring Nani (*Eega*) as Surya, the film features S.J. Suryah, a renowned character actor in Tamil cinema, as the villainous Inspector Dayanand.
title:在日ミャンマー人: Following the 2021 military coup, this film follows the struggles and activism of young Myanmar nationals living in Japan. Through demonstrations in Japan, support for displaced persons, and investigations into interest groups, it sheds light on the dire situation in their homeland.
title:在日ミャンマー人 －私たちの自由－: On February 1, 2021, a military coup took place in Myanmar. Commander-in-Chief Min Aung Hlaing seized full power and assumed leadership of the nation. The military invalidated the 2020 general election and declared a state of emergency, detaining Aung San Suu Kyi and other leaders of the National League for Democracy (NLD), the party that had won the election. In response to the coup, citizens across Myanmar fiercely resisted through non-violent protests. Many civil servants left their posts to join the Civil Disobedience Movement (CDM) as a sign of resistance. However, the military responded with a violent crackdown, resulting in numerous casualties, including deaths from torture. As a result, an estimated 3.5 million people or more fled the military's oppression, becoming internally displaced persons. In Japan as well, many of the approximately 40,000 Myanmar residents living in the country at the time rose up in protest immediately following the coup. Young technical interns working across the country gave up their days off to travel from rural areas to join protests in Tokyo, while also working tirelessly to raise funds for support efforts on the ground.
title:在日ミャンマー人 わたしたちの自由:
Director Toshikuni Doi, who helmed the 2012 documentary "Living in a Foreign Land: Burmese in Japan"—which followed Kyaw Kyaw Soe, an exile who fled to Japan for the Myanmar democratization movement—returns with this sequel focusing on young Myanmar residents in Japan. On February 1, 2021, a military coup occurred in Myanmar, with Commander-in-Chief Min Aung Hlaing seizing power. The military invalidated the previous year’s general election and detained leaders of the victorious National League for Democracy, including Aung San Suu Kyi. While the public resisted through non-violent protests, the military’s brutal crackdown resulted in numerous casualties and over 3.5 million internally displaced persons. In Japan, many of the roughly 50,000 Myanmar residents began staging protests immediately after the coup. Young technical interns from across the country flocked to Tokyo to join the demonstrations and worked tirelessly to raise funds for support back home.

The first part of the film captures the raw emotions of the youth participating in these protests and provides an update on Kyaw Kyaw Soe’s life. The second part follows a Myanmar woman in Japan who supports a school for children displaced to towns along the Thai border. The third part investigates the Japan Myanmar Association, which is rumored to have connections with the military.
title:地底への旅: Director Michelangelo Frammartino, whose "Four Lives" depicting the cycle of life earned high praise at the Cannes Film Festival, questions the meaning of humanity's venture into the unknown against the historical context of Italy's economic boom. This film won the Special Jury Prize in the Competition section of the 78th Venice International Film Festival in 2021. Young explorers descend 683 meters underground without maps, using acetylene lamps to measure and map the cave structure. Above ground, an elderly shepherd on the Pollino Plateau prepares for a quiet death amidst vast nature, suffering from illness. The shepherd's death coincides with the explorers reaching the deepest abyss, creating a grand cycle of life and death, time and space. The cinematographer is the renowned Renato Berta, known for collaborations with masters like Jean-Luc Godard, Éric Rohmer, Daniel Schmid, and Manoel de Oliveira. In Japan, it screened under the title "Cave" in the World Focus section of the 34th Tokyo International Film Festival. It will have its theatrical premiere in Japan in 2026 under the title "Journey to the Depths of the Earth" as part of the special screening series "The Amazing World of Michelangelo Frammartino."
title:地方記者: A pollution issue arises in a town in the Tohoku region, and the media war heats up... An excellent film in which Frankie plays a newspaper reporter, depicting the struggles of journalists who, while grappling with the difficulties of maneuvering in a rural setting, burn with passion for producing community-focused articles.
title:地球の静止する日: A flying saucer suddenly arrives in Washington. An alien named Klaatu lands and, concerned for Earth's future, demands that humanity abandon nuclear weapons. He declares that if his demand is not accepted, he will shut down all energy on Earth...
title:夏の夜の人々: Screened as part of the special program "Finnish Films Loved by Aki Kaurismäki" (November 25 – December 1, 2017, at Eurospace in Shibuya, Tokyo).
title:夏の終わりの訪問者: Screened at "EU Film Days 2026" (Tokyo: May 16–29, 2026 at Theater Image Forum, May 19–24 at National Film Archive; Nagoya: June 6–19 at Nagoya Cinema Neu; also held in Hiroshima, Kyoto, and Fukuoka).
title:夜に現れた女: To be screened at EU Film Days 2026 (Tokyo: May 16–29, 2026 at Theater Image Forum, May 19–24 at National Film Archive; Nagoya: June 6–19 at Nagoya Kinema Noi; also to be held in Hiroshima, Kyoto, and Fukuoka).
title:夜のまにまに:
Set in Osaka, this youth romance depicts the relationship between a serious, melancholic young man and an unconventional, proactive woman. Shinpei, a part-time worker who has just broken up with his girlfriend Saki, hits it off with Kasumi after meeting her at a movie theater, and they spend the night wandering the city together. Later, Kasumi unexpectedly begins working at the same cafe as Shinpei. Surprised by the reunion, Shinpei ends up playing amateur detective when Kasumi asks for his help investigating her boyfriend’s infidelity. Despite being swept up in Kasumi’s assertive pace, Shinpei gradually finds himself drawn to her.

Amon Kabe (*Being Good*, *Chihayafuru* series) stars as Shinpei, with Nairu Yamamoto (*The Cat Escaped*) playing Kasumi. The supporting cast includes Hisao Kurozumi (*Manji*), Miru Nagase (*The Last Judgment*), Nagiko Tsuji (*Nagi’s Blues*), and Masatoshi Kihara (*Tokyo Disaster*). The film is directed by Teppei Isobe (*Cornflakes*, *Nagi’s Blues*).
title:夜中のポップコーン: A single-location comedy about an awkward, movie-loving girls' night that unfolds when three women gather for a TV broadcast of a B-movie. It won the Kinemaister Award at the 19th Tanabe-Benkei Film Festival, known as a gateway for independent films. One Friday night, three women gather at Misawa's home to watch a TV broadcast of "The Growth," a cult-favorite B-movie monster panic film. Nagata and Matsuno, invited by the host Misawa, are meeting for the first time, but due to Misawa's unexpected absence, they end up spending an awkward viewing party together. However, as time passes, they begin to open up to each other, and as they share memories related to movies, the connections and regrets binding the three of them on this day come to light. The director is Takumi Fujimoto, who also works as a stage director and made his feature-length film debut in 2021 with "Home Security Guard and Housework Fairy." The screenplay is by Saku Tanikaze, who works as an actor while also planning, writing, and directing stage productions. The film will be screened in theaters as part of the "Tanabe-Benkei Film Festival Selection 2026" (May 8–28, 2026 at Theatre Shinjuku / June 13–18, 2026 at Theatre Umeda), which showcases award-winning works from the festival.
title:夜鶯 ―ある洋館での殺人事件―:
That night, the case begins to move once more—

A group of film industry insiders, each harboring their own secrets, are summoned to a mysterious mansion. Their mission: adapt a gruesome, real-life murder case into a movie. But there is a twist—the "real killer" is right there in the room! An unpredictable masterpiece of mystery entertainment has finally arrived.

Shanghai, 1940s—a city in the throes of post-war chaos. A washed-up director, a struggling screenwriter, a former starlet seeking a comeback, and a shrewd producer. Hungry for fame and fortune, these industry figures gather at a luxurious estate at the invitation of a mysterious tycoon. Their task is to craft a blockbuster screenplay in a single night, based on an unsolved, sensationalized murder case. However, this top-secret meeting includes a guest who knows the truth better than anyone: the actual murderer.

Driven by both terror and ambition, the group engages in a life-or-death battle of wits to extract the truth from the killer and weave it into their script. In a locked room where fact and fiction blur, the truth they uncover begins to intertwine with their own dark pasts and dangerous secrets. Will they complete a cinematic masterpiece for the ages, or the final chapter of their own destinies?
title:夢物語 The Living Dragon: Bruce Lee, Jackie Chan, Jet Li, Donnie Yen... Yasuaki Kurata is the one and only active action actor who has engaged in fierce battles with countless legends. Now 80 years old and celebrating 60 years as an action actor, this legend takes on a new challenge! Directors Koichi Sakamoto, Kenji Tanigaki, and Yuji Shimomura—three currently active talents who are graduates of the Kurata Action Club—have taken the helm. Filming also took place in Hong Kong, resulting in a historic reunion on screen with Sammo Hung! The miraculous film 'Dream Story' follows a man who has dedicated his life to action. Be sure to see its full scope on the big screen!
title:大丈夫、大丈夫、大丈夫！: A human drama set in a Seoul arts troupe in Korea, depicting the heartwarming connection between a high school girl who lost her mother and a perfectionist teacher. In-yeon, a member of the dance department at the Seoul International Arts Troupe, receives news of her mother's death. Raised in a single-parent household, she is evicted for unpaid rent and begins secretly sleeping in the troupe's practice room. Amid intense training for the troupe's 60th-anniversary performance, the cold-hearted artistic director Sora, known as the "witch," discovers In-yeon's living situation and takes her in as a live-in guest. Despite their differences in age, personality, and lifestyle, the two gradually open their hearts to each other as they spend time together. Meanwhile, problems arise within the team when Nari, the troupe's ace who is hostile toward In-yeon, falters, causing the feelings of In-yeon and the other members to diverge from Sora's. Lee Re from "Hope" plays the protagonist In-yeon, Jin Seo-yeon from "Believer" plays the teacher Sora called the "witch," and Son Seok-koo from "The Roundup" co-stars. Directed by Kim Hye-young, known for the TV drama "Be Melodramatic," in her feature-length debut. It won the Crystal Bear (Best Film) in the Generation Kplus section at the 74th Berlin International Film Festival in 2024, the first Korean film to do so.
title:大丈夫であるように: A documentary born from a letter sent to Kore-eda by singer Cocco. Interweaving her journey across Japan, singing as if in prayer, with the song 'Jugon no Mieru Oka' inspired by the sight of a dugong appearing in the sea at the planned relocation site for the US military base in Henoko, Okinawa, and her daily life in her hometown of Okinawa. The film records the sincere figure of Cocco, celebrating her 10th debut anniversary, as she resonates with the pain of the land and devotes herself to singing.
title:大丈夫と約束して: Official Selection, Competition Section of the 37th Tokyo International Film Festival (2024).
title:大乗の國: Following the enactment of the Film Law in October 1939, the government mandated the nationwide screening of "culture films" the following year. Within Toho’s Culture Film Department, the Toho National Policy Film Association was established, with auditor Hirohisa Ikenaga serving as its chairman. This film was produced by the association as a follow-up to *Kodo Nippon* (The Imperial Way of Japan, 1939, dir. Taisuke Aoki). It depicts the introduction of Buddhism to Japan and its subsequent spread and development, interweaving footage of temples and artworks from across the country. The script was written by film historian Junichiro Tanaka, with Eiji Tsuburaya handling cinematography and composition. It was released to the public at the Toho 4th Floor Theater, which opened that same year. Although the Toho National Policy Film Association ceased operations after producing only these two films, Masaru Takamura of the publicity department, who had been instrumental in the production, hid the film after the war, allowing it to escape confiscation by the occupation forces.
title:大濛: Directed by Taiwan's Yu-Hsun Chen, known for "The Girl Who Leapt Through Time" and "The Tropical Fish," this is a story of hope and rebirth set against the backdrop of the "White Terror" era in 1950s Taiwan, when many citizens were arrested and executed on suspicion of being anti-government. In the 1950s, under martial law in Taiwan. A young girl named A-Yue, living in Chiayi, learns that her brother, captured as an anti-government element, has been executed in Taipei. With a small amount of money and her brother's keepsake watch in hand, she heads to Taipei alone, only to find that a hefty fee is required to claim his body. At her wit's end, she is tricked by a suspicious man and nearly sold into a brothel, but is rescued by a rickshaw puller named Zhao Gongdao. Originally from Guangdong, China, he came to Taiwan as a soldier for the Nationalist army and has been unable to return home, living hand-to-mouth ever since. Having lost his army comrades to the White Terror and finding no direction in life, Gongdao is moved by A-Yue's determination and decides to lend her a hand. Caitlin Fang ("A Girl from America") plays A-Yue, Will Or ("The Staggering Girl") plays Zhao Gongdao, and popular Taiwanese singer and actor 9m88 co-stars. The film won four awards, including Best Feature Film, at the 62nd Golden Horse Awards in 2025.
title:大統領のケーキ: Lamia, chosen as the 'honorable' cake maker, goes out to town with her grandmother and friend the rooster to search for cake ingredients──
title:大統領暗殺裁判 16日間の真実:
Based on historical events, this suspense film centers on the trial following the 1979 assassination of South Korean President Park Chung-hee by the Director of the KCIA. It depicts three men caught in the whirlwind of events between the assassination on October 26, 1979, and the military coup on December 12 of the same year.

Jung In-hu, an ace lawyer who stops at nothing to win, takes on the defense of Park Tae-ju, the chief secretary to the KCIA Director who was involved in the assassination following orders from his superior. As a military man, Park is tried alone in a court-martial, where a final verdict is set to be delivered a mere 16 days after the first hearing. However, it soon emerges that the trial is being unfairly manipulated by Chun Sang-doo, the head of the Joint Investigation Team and the central figure of the massive power that would eventually orchestrate the military coup.

Jo Jung-suk (Hospital Playlist) stars as the protagonist Jung In-hu. Lee Sun-kyun (Parasite), who passed away in December 2023, plays Park Tae-ju in what became his final film. Yoo Jae-myung, known for Itaewon Class and The Solitary Gourmet Movie, portrays Chun Sang-doo. The film is written and directed by Choo Chang-min (Masquerade).
title:天井 ／ 袋いっぱいの蚤: A screening of two rare works by Věra Chytilová, the standard-bearer of the Czech New Wave renowned for *Daisies* (1966). *Ceiling*, her graduation project from the Film and TV School of the Academy of Performing Arts in Prague (FAMU), employs cinéma vérité-style cinematography to portray the inner void felt by a woman who transitions from a medical student to a successful model, trading her glamorous lifestyle for a series of imposed constraints. Her subsequent film, *A Bagful of Fleas*, also utilizes a cinéma vérité approach to vividly capture the everyday lives of girls in a dormitory.
title:天使たち: Set in Shinjuku's Kabukicho, this film portrays two girls working at a girls' bar alongside women from various backgrounds. As they continue to sell their youth and perform the roles demanded of them, they gradually lose sight of what they truly want. The film won the Movie.com Award at the 18th Tanabe Benkei Film Festival, a gateway for new directors. Naru, 19, starts working at a girls' bar after high school to leave her parents' home. Maria, 21, works at the same bar while attending university to repay her student loans. Bathed in the neon lights of the night town, Naru wishes to become someone special, while Maria longs to be a normal college student. One day, Naru meets a host on the streets of Kabukicho, and Maria is approached by a customer for an off-the-books deal. The director and screenwriter is Naima Kimura, for whom this is her second directorial work and first feature film. Kimura drew inspiration from her own experience working at a girls' bar as a student. The film was screened in theaters as part of the "Tanabe Benkei Film Festival Selection 2024" (May 9–June 5, 2024 at Theatre Shinjuku; June 20–26, 2024 at Theatre Umeda).
title:天外者: A historical ensemble drama starring Haruma Miura, depicting the life of Tomoatsu Godai, a visionary who built the foundations of modern Japan's economy and was hailed as a 'Tengaramon' (a person of extraordinary talent). Written by Eriko Komatsu and directed by Mitsutoshi Tanaka, the film presents an original story. In the late Edo period, Japan is shocked by Perry's arrival. Young samurai Saisuke Godai (later Tomoatsu), sensing the dawn of a new era, ignores internal conflicts over expulsion or opening of the country and looks to the world. After meeting the courtesan Haru, he is driven by the desire for 'free dreams' and joins forces with Ryoma Sakamoto, Yataro Iwasaki, Hirobumi Ito, and others to build a nation where everyone can dream. Shohei Miura plays Ryoma Sakamoto, Godai's ally; Takanori Nishikawa plays Yataro Iwasaki, who later founded the Mitsubishi conglomerate; Yuki Morinaga plays a young Hirobumi Ito, who becomes the first Prime Minister; and Mei Nagano plays the courtesan Haru.

title:天文館探偵物語: Takuto Teranishi of the idol group "timelesz" makes his film starring debut in this heartwarming human drama set in Tenmonkan, Kagoshima Prefecture—renowned as southern Kyushu's premier entertainment district. The film depicts the bonds between a young detective and the local townspeople. Tenmonkan is a nostalgic district where people from all walks of life cross paths. While working as
title:太陽（2005）: Russian visionary director Alexander Sokurov, known for *Spiritual Voices* and *Russian Ark*, presents this provocative film as the third installment in his tetralogy exploring 20th-century leaders, following *Moloch* (Hitler) and *Taurus* (Stalin). The film depicts the internal conflict of Emperor Showa, who was revered as a deity, leading up to his "Humanity Declaration" at the end of the war. Issey Ogata stars as the Emperor, alongside Kaori Momoi as the Empress and Shiro Sano as the Grand Chamberlain.
title:太陽（ティダ）の運命: Director Tadahiko Sako, known for "Kamejiro: The Man the U.S. Military Feared Most," delves into modern Okinawan history through the lives of two governors who fiercely confronted the national government. Masahide Ota (the 4th governor after Okinawa's reversion to Japan, serving 1990–98) and Takeshi Onaga (the 7th governor, serving 2014–18) held opposing political positions, yet both garnered broad support from the people and managed the prefecture by transcending the traditional conservative-liberal divide. Ota fought the state in court in 1995 over his refusal to sign for the forced use of military land, while Onaga did the same in 2015 regarding the revocation of the Henoko landfill approval; their battles brought to light the nature of democracy, local autonomy, and the contradictions of the nation. Incorporating testimonies from many who were involved in their lives, the film highlights their personal charisma and depicts the indomitable struggle of two men who lived by their convictions. The title "Tida" means "Sun" in the Okinawan dialect, a word that anciently referred to a chief or leader.
title:奇跡: Director Hirokazu Kore-eda of "Nobody Knows" and "Air Doll" depicts a family drama set in Kyushu, which is buzzing with excitement over the full opening of the Kyushu Shinkansen line in March 2010. Starring the comedy brother duo Maeda Maeda's Koki Maeda and Koshiro Maeda. The story follows two brothers, separated by their parents' divorce to live in Kagoshima and Fukuoka respectively, who strive to reunite their broken family, spurred on by the full opening of the bullet train line. Co-stars include regulars from Kore-eda's films such as Yui Natsukawa, Atsushi Abe, Yoshio Harada, and Kirin Kiki.
title:女たちの庭: Soichiro Ishizuka, the head of Kikumaru Textiles—a venerable establishment in Nihonbashi—has three daughters, Hatsuko, Yuko, and Izumi, with his wife Ayako. Hatsuko has taken Yoshio as her husband to serve as the family heir, and the parents are now searching for a suitable match for Yuko. One day, Soichiro’s old schoolmate Furusawa arrives with news that another classmate, Mayama—a potter living in Imari, Kyushu—is rumored to be terminally ill with cancer...
title:女たちの証言 －「労働運動のなかの先駆的女性たち」: In 1982, under the sponsorship of socialist researcher Kiyomizu Ishidō, a roundtable discussion was held with pioneering female activists who had participated in the launch of the popular labor movement from the Taishō to Shōwa eras. Those gathered were Setsu Tanno (wife of Masanosuke Watanabe), Utako Nabeyama (wife of Sadachika Nabeyama), Misao Fukuoka (wife of Kyōji Koreeda), and Mina Yamauchi (wife of Naokazu Tachibana). Although they had once worked together in the movement, decades later, after the war, some held different positions, making such a gathering rare. At the request of the host, Mr. Ishidō, who said, 'I want to record this for posterity,' director Haneda filmed the discussion. Time passed without the footage being released, but driven by the director's strong desire to 'preserve the history of these women,' additional filming was done as much as possible to compile the work. In this film, the discrimination and subjugation experienced by these female activists are told in their own words. It is a work that quietly questions what true women's liberation really is.
title:女たちの証言－労働運動のなかの先駆的な女性たち－: In 1982, under the sponsorship of socialist researcher Kiyomizu Ishidō, a roundtable discussion was held with pioneering female activists who had participated in the launch of the popular labor movement from the Taishō to Shōwa eras. title:女鹿: Directed by Claude Chabrol, a leading figure of the Nouvelle Vague known for films such as *Les Cousins* and *The Third Lover*, this suspense drama explores the mysterious relationship and the web of love and hate woven by two contrasting women. The story begins when Frédérique, a wealthy bourgeois woman, becomes infatuated with Why, a young woman she spots drawing on the pavement of the Pont des Arts over the Seine. Frédérique is assertive, flamboyant, and lives a life of leisure on her father’s inheritance; Why is a quiet, struggling aspiring artist. Despite their opposite natures, Why—weary of her impoverished life—accepts Frédérique’s invitation to live at her villa. However, when Why finds herself drawn to Paul, an architect attending one of their parties, Frédérique notices and decides to seduce him herself, sparking a tense affair. Frédérique is played by Stéphane Audran, who was married to Chabrol at the time, appearing here alongside her former husband Jean-Louis Trintignant. The film earned Audran the Silver Bear for Best Actress at the 18th Berlin International Film Festival.
title:妻の病 レビー小体型認知症: This documentary captures the ten-year journey and the profound bond between Dr. Koichi Ishimoto, a pediatrician in Nankoku City, Kochi Prefecture, and his wife, Yayoi, as they navigate her battle with dementia. After being diagnosed with schizophrenia in 2004, it was discovered three years later that Yayoi actually had early-onset Lewy body dementia. Since then, Dr. Ishimoto has meticulously recorded his wife’s daily life, utilizing the keen observational eye unique to a physician. Director Shinichi Ise, who first met Dr. Ishimoto during the production of his pediatric cancer documentary "Kaze no Katachi," provides a warm portrayal of the doctor caring for Yayoi with deep affection while supported by family and the local community. Through the story of a couple whose bond deepens through illness, the film asks what is truly important when a loved one—or oneself—is faced with dementia.
title:宇宙からのメッセージ: A bandwagon film made by Kinji Fukasaku during the Star Wars boom. Though the story is simplistic, borrowing from the Tale of the Eight Dog Warriors, it generated buzz with the casting of Vic Morrow and the construction of a full-scale replica of the Riave ship. While the special effects fall short compared to Star Wars, the chase scenes created without compositing were highly praised overseas. The planet Jirusia in the Andromeda Galaxy has been transformed into a "Planet Fortress" by the invading Gabanas Empire, led by Emperor Roxeia XII. Jirusia's Great Chief Kido seeks a hero of miraculous salvation, releasing eight "Sacred Riave Fruits" into space and instructing his granddaughter Emeralida and two warriors, Urokko, to pursue the fruits and retrieve the hero. However, Roxeia launches pursuit warships without delay. The Riave fruits reach five individuals on the Earth Federation colony planet Miraseria: Galda, a former general who resigned in disillusionment; Shiro and Aron, young space bikers; Jack, a thug; and Meia, a wealthy heiress. The youths find Emeralida's damaged ship while collecting "Space Fireflies" and rescue her and Urokko, but are bewildered by their mission. Galda returns the fruit and declines to join. Shiro and the others, keeping Meia in the dark, lie about introducing other heroes and sell Emeralida to an old woman seeking a bride for her son. The old woman and Emeralida are later captured by Gabanas pursuit forces. Meia, furious upon learning of their actions, inspires the repentant youths to prepare for Jirusia's rescue. They modify Meia's space boat to carry Shiro and Aron's small craft and head for Jirusia. Along the way, they are joined by Hans, a Gabanas man who holds a Riave fruit and is the rightful heir to the Gabanas throne, usurped by Roxeia. Meanwhile, Gabanas, captivated by Earth's beauty, demands unconditional surrender from the Earth Federation. Amid the chaos, Shiro and his six companions, now reunited with Galda, infiltrate the Gabanas fortress to destroy the planet fortress and rescue Emeralida. Gathering the remaining two allies, the eight confront Roxeia.
title:安寿と厨子王丸: Summoned by Toei's top brass seeking a weighty drama, screenwriter Sumie Tanaka was brought on board. The story follows aristocratic siblings reduced to slavery, overcoming their suffering through social advancement. Animators strongly objected to the narrative's obliviousness to societal power structures, yet the breathtakingly beautiful Yamato-e style visuals, where backgrounds and characters harmonize perfectly, captivate the viewer.
title:安楽死特区:
What if a "Euthanasia Bill" were passed in Japan?

Following the passage of the bill in the Diet, a facility named "Hitorishizuka" is established as a National Strategic Special Zone. Designed for those seeking euthanasia to reside and receive care, the facility becomes a lightning rod for controversy at the intersection of ethics and politics.

Shotaro Sako (Katsuya Maiguma), a rapper suffering from an incurable disease with no hope of recovery, continues to weave words together, finding salvation in hip-hop even as his condition worsens. He lives with Ayumi Fujioka (Ayaka Onishi), a journalist he met in Tibet. Despite Shotaro being given only six months to live, the two remain opposed to euthanasia and enter "Hitorishizuka" with the intent of exposing the reality of the special zone from the inside.

The facility is home to various residents, each with their own story: Ikeda (Mitsuru Hirata), who is suffering from terminal cancer, and his wife Tamami (Mariko Tsutsui); and Shinya (Kimiko Yo), a former manzai comedian with dementia who wishes to die before she completely loses her sense of self.

As Shotaro’s physical strength rapidly declines and even speaking becomes a struggle, he abruptly changes his mind without consulting Ayumi, stating, "I want euthanasia." Ayumi is forced to confront the weight of life and death as she encounters the convictions of the specialized doctors—including Ikeda’s physician Torii (Eiji Okuda) and Shotaro’s physicians Ogata (Masaya Kato) and Miura (Yuka Itaya).
title:完全版 ザ・レンチキュラーズ a/b: "Rakkun" has a crush on his classmate "Sawaki-san." After a simple exchange of work gloves brings them closer together, Rakkun is walking on air—until he remembers a rumor that she had a boyfriend in middle school. Director Akira Amemiya of the SSSS.GRIDMAN series presents a relatable, slice-of-life youth romantic comedy.
title:実験映画集: "Dialogue with a White Shadow" is an experimental work created by Minao Kitamura—who has practiced "visual folklore" since the 1970s—during his university years. Set against the backdrop of the defeat of the Anpo protests, the film captures a man tormented by anxiety as he wanders through Tokyo. Featuring music by Takehisa Kosugi and art by Hi-Red Center, the work vividly reflects the atmosphere of its era. "A Kiss for Three" is the follow-up work by Akio Okumura, who formed the collective "Cinema Voyant" and produced a series of experimental films. His first work, "Hesitation, or the Man Who Caresses Shadows" (1967), won the Grand Prix at the legendary 1st Sogetsu Experimental Film Festival. Okumura also translated numerous books by Jean-Luc Godard.
title:宮古島物語ふたたヴィラ かんかかりゃの願い: The third chapter of the "Miyako Island Story: Futatavilla" series, a human drama exploring the bonds and rebirth of people set against the backdrop of a small hotel on Okinawa's Miyako Island. Directed, written by, and starring Yudai Uanishi (known for "Hitokuzu" and "Goro's 400 Million Yen"), the film centers on a small villa called "Futatavilla," where it is said that staying will grant the reunion one truly desires. A couple who lost their daughter to bullying, a man pursued by debt and guilt, and friends burdened by their pasts—each carrying their own pain and prayers—are drawn to the island as if guided by the wind, eventually discovering a glimmer of new hope. The cast includes Katsuya Shibayama, chairman of Resort Life Co., Ltd., which operates hotels in Miyako Island and throughout Japan, alongside returning regulars Yudai Uanishi, Chieko Matsubara, Ai Furukawa, Mika Tokutake, and Ruby Moreno. Guest stars include Ryo Tamura and Tamotsu Ishibashi.
title:家族という病: Writer Shimojo Akiko's 2015 essay, which questioned the concept of 'family worship' and became a bestseller with 600,000 copies, is adapted into a film by director-screenwriter Oyama Chikako of 'My Name is Lucia.' This ensemble piece, laced with black humor, depicts the absurdity and madness of people clinging to normalcy. Bestselling mystery novelist Tahara Junichiro has his life controlled by his intense wife Mariko, leaving his true talent dormant. Former elite salaryman Matsubara Yuji, unable to betray his mother's expectations even after retirement, continues to play the role of a fake executive while dealing with his hikikomori son. High school girl Kuroki Maria is driven into a corner when rumors spread that her mother is an AV actress. Appearing before these three families is Fujita Shin, an up-and-coming writer who won a literary award for a work themed around nudity. Additionally, a homeless woman living freely in the park appears as a completely different presence. Starring Fujimoto Takahiro, Tomochika, Watanabe Eri, Koide Keisuke, Teraishi Ken, Sakakibara Ai, and Hiroi Wakana.
title:寝ても覚めても: The commercial film debut of director Ryusuke Hamaguchi, who gained attention for "Happy Hour," a film that meticulously depicted the daily lives and friendships of four women over more than five hours and won major awards at numerous international film festivals including Locarno and Nantes. This film was entered into the Competition section of the 71st Cannes International Film Festival. It is an adaptation of the award-winning love novel of the same name by Akutagawa Prize-winning author Tomoka Shibasaki, starring Masahiro Higashide and Erika Karata. Asako, a 21-year-old living in Osaka, meets Baku and falls into a fateful love, but one day, Baku suddenly disappears from her life. Two years later, having moved from Osaka to Tokyo, Asako meets Ryohei, who has a face identical to Baku's. Unable to forget Baku, Asako tries to avoid Ryohei, but he develops feelings for her. Despite her hesitation, Asako finds herself drawn to Ryohei. Higashide plays the dual roles of Baku and Ryohei, while Karata plays Asako.
title:寝ても覚めても濱⼝⻯介監督特集上映突然、偶然、必然: The commercial film debut of director Ryusuke Hamaguchi, who gained attention for "Happy Hour," a film that meticulously depicted the daily lives and friendships of four women over more than five hours and won major awards at numerous international film festivals including Locarno and Nantes.
